instructions: Pour 100 ml boiling water over the bulgur and leave to swell for 10 minutes.
Hard-boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool, peel and quarter.
Dice the tomato and cucumber and mix with the bulgur, parsley, olive oil, salt and pepper.
Spoon into a bowl, top with the eggs and feta and sprinkle with za'atar.

title: Yoghurt bowl with pomegranate, walnuts and dates
instructions: Put the yoghurt into a bowl and smooth the surface.
Cut the dates into thin strips and roughly chop the walnuts.
Scatter the pomegranate seeds, dates, walnuts and oats over the yoghurt.
Dust with cinnamon and serve straight away.

title: Protein quark bowl with kiwi, mango and coconut
instructions: Stir the quark with the milk and lime juice until creamy and put it into a bowl.
Peel and dice the kiwi and mango.
Spread the fruit over the quark.
Sprinkle with desiccated coconut and linseed.

title: Vegan avocado mango smoothie bowl with spinach and hemp seeds
instructions: Let the mango soften for 5 minutes.
Blend the mango, avocado, spinach, soy yoghurt and pea protein to a thick cream.
Spoon into a bowl.
Top with kiwi slices and hemp seeds.

title: Vegan strawberry cashew smoothie bowl with silken tofu and buckwheat
instructions: Let the frozen strawberries soften for 5 minutes.
Blend with the silken tofu, banana and half of the cashews to a thick cream.
Toast the buckwheat in a dry pan for 3 minutes until crunchy.
Spoon the cream into a bowl and top with fresh strawberries, the buckwheat and the remaining cashews.

title: Breakfast quesadilla with egg, spinach and mozzarella
instructions: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper and cook them in the rapeseed oil with the spinach to soft scrambled eggs.
Put the scrambled eggs on one half of the wrap, sprinkle with the mozzarella and chilli flakes and fold over.
Fry in a dry pan for 2 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.
Cut into triangles and serve with tomato slices, also good to take away.

title: Vegan spelt apple scones with soy skyr to go
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and finely dice the apple.
Mix the flour, baking powder and cinnamon, add the rapeseed oil, soy milk and maple syrup, knead briefly and work in the apple.
Shape into 2 scones and bake for 15 minutes until golden.
Once cooled take them along in a box with the soy skyr, they keep airtight for 2 days.

title: Breakfast wrap with hummus, egg, cucumber and rocket to go
instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool, peel and slice.
Spread the wrap with hummus and cut the cucumber and pepper into strips.
Lay the rocket, vegetables and egg slices on the wrap and season with sumac, salt and pepper.
Roll up tightly, cut in half and take along wrapped in baking paper.

title: Wholemeal bagel with cottage cheese, smoked trout, radishes and dill
instructions: Halve the bagel and toast it.
Stir the cottage cheese with dill, lemon juice and pepper and spread it on the halves.
Thinly slice the radishes and spread them on top with the flaked trout.
Sprinkle with dill and pepper and serve.

title: Yoghurt granola jar with apple cinnamon compote to go
instructions: Dice the apple and stew with cinnamon and 3 tbsp water for 5 minutes to a compote, then let cool.
Put the compote into a screw-top jar and layer the yoghurt on top.
Pack the granola and chopped walnuts separately in a small bag so they stay crunchy.
Sprinkle the granola and nuts on top before eating.

title: Breakfast roll with egg, chicken breast, tomato and lettuce to go
instructions: Hard-boil the egg for 8 minutes, cool, peel and slice.
Split the roll and spread it with the cream cheese and mustard.
Fill with the lettuce, chicken breast, tomato slices and egg and season with salt and pepper.
Close and take along wrapped in baking paper.

title: Cottage cheese egg bites with pepper and chives to go
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160 °C and put an ovenproof dish of hot water on the bottom shelf.
Blend the eggs, egg whites and cottage cheese until smooth and season with salt and pepper.
Finely dice the pepper, divide it with the chives between 4 silicone muffin moulds and pour the egg mixture over.
Cook for 20 minutes until just set and eat with the bread, they keep chilled for 3 days.

title: Vegan silken tofu French toast with berries and maple syrup
instructions: Blend the silken tofu with the soy milk, cinnamon and vanilla until smooth and pour into a deep plate.
Soak the bread slices in it for 1 minute on each side.
Fry in the rapeseed oil over medium heat for 3 minutes per side until golden and briefly warm the berries.
Serve the toasts with the soy yoghurt, berries and maple syrup.

title: Baked oats to go with apple, cinnamon and walnuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Mix the oats, egg, milk, skyr, cinnamon and baking powder and fold in half of the apple, grated.
Pour into a small ovenproof dish with a lid, top with the remaining apple wedges and walnuts and bake for 25 minutes.
Eat warm or let cool, close and take along, it keeps chilled for 2 days.

title: Light English breakfast with beans in tomato sauce, egg, mushrooms and wholemeal toast
instructions: Simmer the beans with the passata and smoked paprika for 8 minutes until thick and season with salt and pepper.
Halve the mushrooms and fry them with the cherry tomatoes in the rapeseed oil for 5 minutes.
Fry an egg sunny side up in the same pan and toast the bread.
Arrange everything together on a plate.

title: Sweet wholemeal couscous with orange, dates and almonds
instructions: Heat the milk with the cinnamon, pour it over the couscous and leave covered to swell for 5 minutes.
Segment the orange, cut the dates into strips and roughly chop the almonds.
Fluff the couscous with a fork and flavour with a few drops of orange blossom water.
Spoon into a bowl and serve with the yoghurt, orange, dates and almonds.

title: Kefir breakfast bowl with buckwheat crunch, pear and linseed
instructions: Toast the buckwheat with the maple syrup and cinnamon in a pan for 3 minutes until crunchy and let cool.
Stir the kefir with the linseed and pour into a bowl.
Wash the pear and cut it into thin wedges.
Spread the pear and buckwheat crunch over the kefir.

title: Vegan breakfast wrap with smoked tofu, avocado and tomato
instructions: Cut the smoked tofu into strips and fry in the rapeseed oil with smoked paprika for 4 minutes until crisp.
Mash the avocado with the lime juice, salt and pepper and spread it on the wrap.
Lay the spinach, tomato slices and tofu on top.
Roll up tightly and cut in half.

title: Vegan chickpea avocado smash on wholemeal bread with tomato and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Roughly mash the chickpeas and avocado with the lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Toast the wholemeal bread and spread the smash on it.
Slice the tomato and lay it on top.
Sprinkle with pumpkin seeds and chilli flakes.

title: Peach quinoa breakfast jar with skyr and almonds
instructions: Rinse the quinoa in hot water, cook in 100 ml water for 15 minutes and let cool.
Stir the skyr with the vanilla and maple syrup, dice the peach and chop the almonds.
Layer the quinoa, skyr and peach in a screw-top jar and sprinkle with the almonds.
Keeps sealed in the fridge for up to 2 days, enjoy cold.

title: Strawberry vanilla protein shake with whey and milk
instructions: Let the strawberries soften for 5 minutes.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Blueberry muffin protein shake with skyr and oats
instructions: Soak the oats in the milk for 5 minutes.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Apple pie protein shake with quark and cinnamon
instructions: Wash the fruit, peel if needed and cut it into rough pieces.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

instructions: Wash the fruit, peel if needed and cut it into rough pieces.

instructions: Wash the fruit, peel if needed and cut it into rough pieces.

instructions: Soak the dates in 3 tbsp hot water for 5 minutes.

instructions: Let the raspberries soften for 5 minutes.

instructions: Soak the oats in the milk for 5 minutes.

title: Carrot cake protein shake with skyr and walnuts
instructions: Peel the carrot and grate it finely.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.

title: Vegan blackberry vanilla shake with soy yoghurt and pea protein
instructions: Let the blackberries soften for 5 minutes.

instructions: Wash the fruit, peel if needed and cut it into rough pieces.

instructions: Wash the fruit, peel if needed and cut it into rough pieces.

instructions: Wash the fruit, peel if needed and cut it into rough pieces.

instructions: Wash the fruit, peel if needed and cut it into rough pieces.

title: Kiwi banana protein shake with cottage cheese and spinach
instructions: Wash the fruit, peel if needed and cut it into rough pieces.

title: Date almond protein shake with cinnamon and milk
instructions: Soak the dates in 3 tbsp hot water for 5 minutes.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Tiramisu protein shake with espresso, quark and cocoa
instructions: Brew the espresso and let it cool completely.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass, dust with cocoa and drink straight away.

title: Vegan berry oat breakfast shake with soy milk and hemp seeds
instructions: Soak the oats and hemp seeds in the soy milk for 5 minutes.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Apricot vanilla protein shake with kefir
instructions: Wash the fruit, peel if needed and cut it into rough pieces.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Vegan mango passion fruit protein shake with soy yoghurt
instructions: Let the mango soften for 5 minutes, halve the passion fruits and scoop out the pulp.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Vegan raspberry coconut shake with pea protein and oat drink
instructions: Let the raspberries soften for 5 minutes.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Mushroom walnut pâté with cucumber and crispbread
instructions: Finely chop the mushrooms, onion and garlic and fry them in the olive oil with thyme for 8 minutes until the liquid has evaporated.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes.
Blend the mushrooms and walnuts with salt and pepper into a spreadable pâté and let cool.
Serve with cucumber slices and crispbread.

title: Apple cinnamon energy balls with oats and almonds
instructions: Grate the apple very finely and squeeze it out well.
Blitz with the oats, almonds, dates, almond butter and cinnamon in a food processor to a mouldable mixture.
Roll the mixture into 4 balls with damp hands.
Chill for at least 30 minutes, they keep chilled for 5 days.

title: Matcha pistachio bites with dates and coconut
instructions: Blitz the dates, half of the pistachios, the oats, coconut and matcha in a food processor to a sticky mixture.
Roll the mixture into 4 balls with damp hands.
Finely chop the remaining pistachios and roll the balls in them.
Chill for at least 30 minutes, they keep chilled for 5 days.

title: Pumpkin hummus with cucumber and pepper sticks
instructions: Dice the pumpkin and roast in the oven at 200 °C for 20 minutes until soft.
Blend with the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, spices and 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Season with salt and cut the vegetables into sticks.
Spoon the hummus into a small bowl and serve with the sticks.

title: Vegan chocolate hemp protein balls with pea protein and dates
instructions: Blitz the dates, pea protein, oats, cocoa, almond butter, half of the hemp seeds and 1 tbsp water in a food processor to a sticky mixture.
Roll the mixture into 4 balls with damp hands.
Roll the balls in the remaining hemp seeds.
Chill for at least 30 minutes, they keep chilled for 5 days.

title: Beetroot hummus with vegetable sticks
instructions: Blend the chickpeas, beetroot, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper.
Wash and peel the vegetables and cut them into sticks.
Spoon the hummus into a small bowl and serve with the sticks.

title: Edamame mint dip with carrot and cucumber sticks
instructions: Cook the edamame for 3 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Blend with the soy yoghurt, mint, lime juice, olive oil, salt and pepper until smooth.
Wash and peel the vegetables and cut them into sticks.
Spoon the dip into a small bowl and serve with the sticks.

title: Rice cake pizza with tomato, mozzarella and oregano
instructions: Preheat the oven or air fryer to 200 °C.
Spread the rice cakes thinly with the passata and sprinkle with oregano.
Top with mozzarella slices and halved cherry tomatoes and bake for 5 minutes until the cheese melts.
Top with basil and serve immediately.

title: Oven-baked quinoa vegetable patties with herb quark
instructions: Cook the quinoa in 75 ml water for 15 minutes and let cool.
Finely grate the carrot and courgette, squeeze them out and mix with the quinoa, egg, chickpea flour, salt and pepper.
Shape into 4 patties, place on a lined baking tray, brush with rapeseed oil and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes, turning halfway.
Mix the quark with the chopped herbs, salt and pepper and serve alongside.

title: Banana sushi with peanut butter, oat crunch and cacao nibs
instructions: Toast the oats in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden and let cool.
Peel the banana and spread it thinly all over with the peanut butter.
Roll in the oats, cacao nibs and cinnamon.
Cut into 8 slices and serve immediately.

title: Air fryer mushrooms with herb panko and garlic yoghurt
instructions: Clean the mushrooms, whisk the egg and mix the panko with the cheese, chopped parsley and salt.
Dip the mushrooms in the egg and coat them in the panko mixture.
Air-fry at 190 °C for 10 minutes until golden.
Stir the yoghurt with grated garlic and salt and serve as a dip alongside.

title: Air fryer pumpkin fries with paprika skyr dip
instructions: Deseed the pumpkin and cut it with the skin on into 1 cm thick wedges.
Toss with the olive oil, rosemary, half of the paprika and salt.
Air-fry at 200 °C for 15 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
Stir the skyr with the remaining paprika and salt and serve alongside.

title: Air fryer kohlrabi fries with herb yoghurt
instructions: Peel the kohlrabi, cut into chip-sized sticks and pat dry.
Dust with the cornflour, spices and salt and toss with the olive oil.
Air-fry at 200 °C for 15 to 18 minutes until golden, shaking twice.
Stir the yoghurt with the chopped herbs and salt and serve alongside.

title: Chilli lime mango with coconut skyr dip
instructions: Peel the mango and cut it into wedges.
Sprinkle with chilli flakes and plenty of lime zest.
Stir the skyr with the desiccated coconut and serve alongside as a dip.

title: Air fryer rice paper crisps with sesame and lime skyr dip
instructions: Cut the rice paper sheets into quarters, brush thinly with sesame oil and water and sprinkle with sesame and salt.
Air-fry at 200 °C in batches for 1 minute each until puffed.
Stir the skyr with the lime juice, chilli flakes and salt and serve with the crisps.

title: Spinach mozzarella muffins with spelt flour and sun-dried tomatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and line 2 holes of a muffin tin with paper cases.
Finely chop the spinach, dice the mozzarella and cut the sun-dried tomatoes small.
Mix the flour with the baking powder, stir in the egg, yoghurt and olive oil and fold in the spinach, mozzarella and tomatoes.
Fill the cases and bake for 20 minutes until golden.

title: Pepper corn muffins with cheddar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and line 2 holes of a muffin tin with paper cases.
Mix both flours with the baking powder and salt and stir in the egg and milk.
Finely dice the pepper and fold it in with the sweetcorn and half of the cheddar.
Fill the cases, sprinkle with the remaining cheddar and bake for 20 minutes.

title: Courgette carrot muffins with cottage cheese and oats
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and line 2 holes of a muffin tin with paper cases.
Finely grate the courgette and carrot and squeeze them out.
Mix the oats, egg, cottage cheese, baking powder, salt and vegetables.
Fill the cases, sprinkle with sunflower seeds and bake for 22 minutes.

title: Tuna bean cream on crispbread with radishes
instructions: Coarsely blend the tuna, beans, lemon juice and olive oil.
Chop the parsley, stir it in and season with salt and pepper.
Spread the cream on the crispbreads and top with radish slices.

title: Cocoa popcorn with peanuts
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pan, add the popcorn kernels and let them pop covered over medium heat, shaking the pan.
Mix the maple syrup and cocoa and drizzle over the warm popcorn.
Roughly chop the peanuts, add them with a pinch of salt and mix everything well.

title: Stuffed cucumber boats with tuna skyr cream
instructions: Halve the cucumber lengthways and scrape out the seeds with a spoon.
Flake the tuna and mix with the skyr, finely diced onion, capers, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Fill the cucumber halves with the cream, sprinkle with dill, cut into pieces and serve with the crispbread.

title: Light devilled eggs with skyr, mustard and paprika
instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool, peel and halve lengthways.
Remove the yolks and mix them with the skyr, mustard, salt and pepper until creamy.
Pipe or spoon the cream into the egg white halves.
Sprinkle with paprika and chives and serve with cucumber slices.

title: Mini turkey patties with yoghurt mint dip and cucumber
instructions: Knead the mince with the finely diced onion, oats, spices and salt.
Shape into 6 small patties, brush with rapeseed oil and air-fry at 190 °C for 10 minutes until no longer pink inside.
Stir the yoghurt with chopped mint and salt.
Serve the patties with the dip and cucumber slices.

title: Tomato mozzarella skewers with basil and balsamic
instructions: Wash the tomatoes and drain the mozzarella.
Thread tomato, a basil leaf and mozzarella alternately onto 6 small skewers.
Drizzle with balsamic and olive oil and season with salt and pepper.

title: Beetroot carpaccio with fresh goat’s cheese, walnuts and cress
instructions: Slice the beetroot wafer-thin and fan it out on a plate.
Drizzle with balsamic vinegar and olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Roughly chop the walnuts, dot the goat’s cheese over the top and sprinkle with the walnuts and cress.

title: Protein vanilla pudding with raspberry coulis
instructions: Mix the cornflour with 50 ml of the milk until smooth and bring the remaining milk to the boil with the vanilla.
Stir in the cornflour mixture and simmer for 1 minute while stirring, remove from the heat and stir in the protein powder and maple syrup.
Pour into a glass and chill for 1 hour.
Thaw the raspberries, purée them finely and spoon over the pudding as a coulis.

title: Protein chocolate pudding with sour cherries
instructions: Mix the cornflour and cocoa with 50 ml of the milk until smooth and bring the remaining milk to the boil.
Stir in the cocoa mixture and simmer for 1 minute while stirring, remove from the heat and stir in the protein powder and maple syrup.
Pour into a glass and chill for 1 hour.
Serve topped with the sour cherries.

title: Brownie baked oats with cocoa and raspberries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Blend the oats, banana, egg, milk, cocoa and baking powder until smooth.
Pour into a small ovenproof dish and press the chopped chocolate and raspberries into it.
Bake for 20 minutes until the centre is just set and serve warm.

title: Lemon blueberry baked oats with skyr
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Blend the oats, egg, half of the skyr, the almond drink, maple syrup, lemon zest and baking powder until smooth.
Pour into a small ovenproof dish, scatter the blueberries on top and bake for 20 minutes until golden.
Serve warm with the remaining skyr.

title: Microwave apple cinnamon mug cake with vanilla skyr
instructions: Grind the oats finely, mix with the baking powder and cinnamon in a large mug and stir in the egg and apple sauce.
Finely dice the apple and fold in half of it.
Cook in the microwave at 800 watts for 90 seconds.
Stir the skyr with the vanilla and maple syrup and spoon onto the cake with the remaining apple cubes.

title: Banana almond mug cake with dark chocolate
instructions: Mash the banana in a large mug and roughly chop the chocolate.
Stir in the egg, almond butter, almond drink, flour and baking powder.
Sprinkle with the chocolate and cook in the microwave at 800 watts for 2 minutes.
Leave to rest for 1 minute and enjoy warm.

title: Baked pear with ricotta walnut filling and cinnamon
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 °C, halve the pear lengthways and scoop out the core with a spoon.
Stir the ricotta with the vanilla, cinnamon and half of the maple syrup and fill the hollows.
Sprinkle with chopped walnuts and bake for 20 minutes until the pear is soft.
Serve warm drizzled with the remaining maple syrup.

title: Peach raspberry crumble with almond oat topping
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 °C, slice the peach into wedges and put it into a small dish with the raspberries.
Rub the oats, almonds, butter, maple syrup and cinnamon together into crumbs and scatter over the fruit.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden.
Serve warm with the yoghurt.

title: Lemon skyr cream with ladyfingers and blueberries
instructions: Stir the skyr with the lemon juice, lemon zest and maple syrup until creamy.
Break the ladyfingers into rough pieces.
Layer the biscuit, lemon cream and blueberries alternately in a glass and leave for 15 minutes.

title: Coffee panna cotta with agar and cocoa
instructions: Mix the milk with the espresso, maple syrup and agar and boil for 2 minutes while stirring.
Let cool briefly and stir in the yoghurt until smooth.
Pour into a glass and leave to set in the fridge for 2 hours.
Dust with cocoa before serving.

title: Mango passion fruit quark mousse with agar
instructions: Purée the mango finely, boil half of it with the agar for 2 minutes and let cool slightly.
Stir the quark with the maple syrup and the remaining mango purée until smooth and quickly stir in the warm agar mango.
Pour into a glass and chill for 1 hour.
Spoon the passion fruit pulp on top and serve.

title: Grilled pineapple with lime mint skyr and pistachios
instructions: Peel the pineapple and cut it into 2 thick slices.
Grill in a griddle pan for 3 minutes per side until charred and brush with maple syrup.
Stir the skyr with the lime juice, lime zest and finely chopped mint.
Serve the pineapple with the skyr and chopped pistachios.

title: Light banana split with vanilla skyr, berries and dark chocolate
instructions: Thaw the berries and stir the skyr with the vanilla.
Halve the banana lengthways and lay it in an oblong dish.
Place the skyr in 2 scoops between the halves and scatter the berries over the top.
Melt the chocolate, drizzle it over and sprinkle with the flaked almonds.

title: Pumpkin pie cream in a glass with oat biscuit crunch
instructions: Dice the pumpkin, steam for 12 minutes until soft, purée finely and let cool.
Toast the oats and chopped pecans with the butter and cinnamon in a pan for 3 minutes until crunchy.
Stir the pumpkin purée with the quark, maple syrup and spices until creamy.
Layer the crunch and cream alternately in a glass.

title: Strawberry daifuku – Japanese rice cakes with adzuki bean paste
instructions: Mash the adzuki beans finely with the maple syrup, shape into 3 balls and wrap each strawberry with one, leaving the tip free.
Mix the rice flour with 60 ml water until smooth and microwave at 800 watts for 1 minute, stir and cook for another 30 seconds.
Turn the dough onto a surface dusted with cornflour, divide into 3 pieces and press flat.
Wrap the strawberries in the dough, seal well and serve fresh.

title: Chickpea blondies with dark chocolate
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and line a small tin with baking paper.
Blend the chickpeas, peanut butter, maple syrup, oats, vanilla, baking powder and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Fold in the chopped chocolate, spread the batter in the tin and bake for 20 minutes.
Let cool completely and cut into 2 pieces.

title: Berry gratin with yoghurt sabayon
instructions: Thaw the berries and put them in a shallow ovenproof dish.
Whisk the egg yolk with the maple syrup and vanilla over a hot water bath for 4 minutes until thick, foamy and cooked through.
Remove from the water bath, fold in the yoghurt and lemon zest and spoon over the berries.
Brown under a hot grill for 2 to 3 minutes until golden.

title: Red berry compote with vanilla quark
instructions: Bring the fruit to the boil with 50 ml water and the honey and simmer for 3 minutes.
Mix the cornflour with a little cold water, stir in and simmer for 1 minute until it thickens.
Pour into a glass and let cool.
Stir the quark with the vanilla and 2 tbsp water until creamy and spoon onto the compote.

title: Light chocolate fondue with fruit skewers
instructions: Wash and peel the fruit and cut it into bite-sized pieces.
Thread alternately onto 4 small skewers.
Chop the chocolate and melt it with the milk in a small pan over low heat until smooth.
Pour into a small bowl and serve with the skewers for dipping.

title: Vegan lemon silken tofu cream with berries
instructions: Blend the silken tofu with the lemon juice, lemon zest, vanilla and maple syrup until creamy.
Pour into a glass and chill for 30 minutes.
Thaw the berries and scatter them over the cream with the flaked almonds.

title: Light strawberry shortcake with quark cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C, mix the flour with the baking powder and rub in the cold butter.
Add the buttermilk, knead briefly into a dough, shape into one round cake and bake for 12 minutes until golden.
Slice the strawberries and mix with half of the maple syrup, stir the quark with the vanilla and remaining syrup.
Halve the cake horizontally and fill with the quark cream and strawberries.

title: Pomegranate pistachio parfait with skyr and oat crunch
instructions: Toast the oats with half of the maple syrup in a pan for 3 minutes until crunchy and let cool.
Stir the skyr with the cardamom and remaining maple syrup and chop the pistachios.
Layer the skyr, oat crunch and pomegranate seeds in a glass and sprinkle with the pistachios.

title: Shrikhand – Indian saffron yoghurt cream with pistachios
instructions: Soak the saffron in 1 tsp warm water for 10 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt with the saffron water, cardamom and honey until smooth.
Pour into a glass and chill for 30 minutes.
Serve sprinkled with chopped pistachios and flaked almonds.

title: Air fryer apple cinnamon wontons with yoghurt dip
instructions: Finely dice the apple and cook with the cinnamon and half of the maple syrup in a pan for 3 minutes until soft.
Place one teaspoon of filling on each wrapper, moisten the edges and fold into 6 triangles.
Brush with rapeseed oil and air-fry at 190 °C for 6 minutes until golden.
Stir the yoghurt with the vanilla and remaining maple syrup and serve as a dip.

title: Oven-roasted nectarines with almond crunch and vanilla skyr
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, halve and stone the nectarines.
Place cut side up in a dish, drizzle with half of the maple syrup and bake for 15 minutes.
Chop the almonds and toast with the oats, cinnamon and remaining syrup in a pan for 3 minutes.
Stir the skyr with the vanilla and serve with the nectarines and crunch.

title: Light almond cardamom kulfi
instructions: Simmer the milk in a wide pan for 15 minutes while stirring until reduced by about half.
Let cool and stir in the quark, maple syrup, cardamom and chopped almonds.
Pour the mixture into 2 ice lolly moulds, insert the sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours.
Briefly hold the moulds under warm water and release the lollies.

title: Black Forest ice cream with cocoa and sour cherries
instructions: Stir the skyr with the milk, cocoa and maple syrup until smooth.
Roughly chop half of the cherries and fold them in.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Serve with the remaining cherries and shaved chocolate.

title: Gingerbread spice quark ice cream with orange zest and walnuts
instructions: Stir the quark with the milk, honey, orange juice and gingerbread spice until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Serve sprinkled with chopped walnuts and orange zest.

title: Pumpkin cinnamon nice cream with pecans
instructions: Dice the pumpkin, steam for 12 minutes until soft, purée and freeze in portions for at least 4 hours.
Let the frozen fruit soften for 5 minutes.
Blend with the remaining ingredients in a food processor for 1 to 2 minutes until creamy, scraping down in between.
Spoon into a bowl and sprinkle with chopped pecans and cinnamon.

title: Kiwi lime sorbet with mint and pistachios
instructions: Peel the kiwis, cut into pieces and freeze for at least 4 hours.
Let the frozen fruit soften for 5 minutes.
Blend with the lime juice, maple syrup and mint leaves in a food processor for 1 to 2 minutes until smooth.
Spoon into a bowl and sprinkle with chopped pistachios.

title: Grapefruit rosemary granita with coconut yoghurt
instructions: Juice the grapefruit and steep the maple syrup with 3 tbsp hot water and the rosemary sprig for 10 minutes.
Remove the rosemary, mix with the juice and freeze in a shallow dish.
For 3 hours scrape into crystals with a fork every 30 minutes.
Put the coconut yoghurt into a glass and pile the granita on top.

title: Plum cinnamon yoghurt ice cream with almond brittle
instructions: Stone the plums and cook with the cinnamon and 2 tbsp water for 6 minutes until soft, then let cool.
Blend with the yoghurt and two thirds of the maple syrup.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Caramelise the flaked almonds with the remaining syrup in a pan for 2 minutes and crumble over the ice cream.

title: Fig skyr ice cream with pistachios and honey
instructions: Blend 2 figs finely with the skyr, vanilla and two thirds of the honey.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Cut the remaining fig into wedges and arrange on the ice cream with the pistachios and honey.

title: Papaya lime sorbet with coconut flakes
instructions: Peel and deseed the papaya, dice it and freeze for at least 4 hours.
Let the frozen fruit soften for 5 minutes.
Blend with the lime juice, maple syrup and coconut yoghurt in a food processor for 1 to 2 minutes until smooth.
Toast the coconut flakes in a pan until golden and scatter over the sorbet.

title: Honeydew ginger sorbet with a yoghurt quenelle
instructions: Peel and deseed the melon, dice it and freeze for at least 4 hours.
Let the frozen fruit soften for 5 minutes.
Blend with the finely grated ginger and honey in a food processor for 1 to 2 minutes until smooth.
Spoon into a bowl, add a quenelle of yoghurt beside it and sprinkle with chopped pistachios.

title: Rhubarb strawberry ice cream with vanilla quark
instructions: Cut the rhubarb into pieces and cook with the strawberries and 2 tbsp water for 8 minutes until soft, then let cool.
Blend with the quark, maple syrup and vanilla until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.

title: Blueberry cheesecake ice cream with oat crumble
instructions: Stir the cream cheese, quark, maple syrup and lemon zest until smooth and swirl in half of the blueberries.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Toast the oats with the butter for 3 minutes until crisp and scatter over the ice cream with the remaining berries.

title: Orange ricotta ice cream with dark chocolate shavings
instructions: Blend the ricotta with the yoghurt, orange juice, orange zest and honey until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Serve sprinkled with finely grated chocolate.

title: Carrot orange ice lollies with ginger and yoghurt
instructions: Peel the carrot, slice it and steam for 10 minutes until soft.
Juice the orange and blend finely with the carrot, grated ginger and half of the honey.
Stir the yoghurt with the remaining honey and layer both mixtures alternately into the moulds.
Pour the mixture into 2 ice lolly moulds, insert the sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours.
Briefly hold the moulds under warm water and release the lollies.

title: Vegan strawberry cashew ice cream
instructions: Soak the cashews in water for 4 hours and drain.
Let the strawberries soften for 5 minutes.
Blend the cashews with the oat drink, maple syrup and vanilla until very smooth, then add the strawberries and blend for 1 to 2 minutes until creamy.
Spoon into a bowl straight away or freeze for another 30 minutes for a firmer texture.

title: Vegan cherry almond ice lollies with soy yoghurt
instructions: Stir the soy yoghurt with the almond butter and maple syrup until smooth.
Thaw the cherries, purée half and swirl it in, then halve the rest and fold them in.
Pour the mixture into 2 ice lolly moulds, insert the sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours.
Briefly hold the moulds under warm water and release the lollies.

title: Chai spice ice cream with oat drink and dates
instructions: Stone the dates and soak with the oat drink and spices for 10 minutes.
Let the frozen fruit soften for 5 minutes.
Blend with the remaining ingredients in a food processor for 1 to 2 minutes until creamy, scraping down in between.
Spoon into a bowl and sprinkle with chopped cashews and a pinch of cinnamon.

title: Apricot vanilla yoghurt ice cream with almonds
instructions: Stone the apricots and blend finely with the yoghurt, vanilla and maple syrup.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Serve sprinkled with chopped almonds.

title: Poppy seed quark ice cream with sour cherries
instructions: Stir the quark with the milk, honey, poppy seeds and lemon zest until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Serve with the sour cherries.

title: Cranberry orange sorbet with flaked almonds
instructions: Cook the cranberries with the maple syrup and 3 tbsp water for 5 minutes until they burst.
Juice the orange, blend finely with the cranberries and zest and press through a sieve.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Toast the flaked almonds in a dry pan until golden and scatter over the sorbet.

title: Pomegranate granita with mint and yoghurt
instructions: Blend 170 g of the pomegranate seeds with the lime juice, maple syrup and 50 ml water and press through a sieve.
Freeze in a shallow dish and for 3 hours scrape into crystals with a fork every 30 minutes.
Put the yoghurt into a glass, pile the granita on top and garnish with the remaining seeds and mint.

title: Light ice cream sandwich with vanilla quark and oat cookies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C, mash the banana and knead with the oats, melted butter and cinnamon.
Shape 4 flat round cookies, bake for 12 minutes and let cool completely.
Stir the quark with the vanilla and maple syrup until smooth, spread onto 2 cookies and top with the other 2 cookies.
Wrap individually, freeze for 3 hours and let soften for 5 minutes before eating.

title: Pear ginger sorbet with cacao nibs
instructions: Peel and core the pears and cook with the ginger, lemon juice and 3 tbsp water for 8 minutes until soft.
Blend finely with the maple syrup and let cool.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Serve sprinkled with cacao nibs.

title: Kefir raspberry ice lollies with pistachios
instructions: Stir the kefir with the honey, thaw the raspberries and roughly crush them with a fork.
Layer the raspberries and kefir alternately into the moulds.
Pour the mixture into 2 ice lolly moulds, insert the sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours.
Release them and dip the tips into chopped pistachios.

title: Cottage cheese protein ice cream with berries and dark chocolate
instructions: Blend the cottage cheese with the maple syrup and vanilla until completely smooth.
Stir in the chopped chocolate.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Serve with the thawed berries.

title: Peanut banana mass gainer shake with oats, whey and whole milk
instructions: Briefly grind the oats finely in the blender.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Mocha mass gainer shake with oats, whey and cashews
instructions: Let the espresso cool and grind the oats and cashews finely in the blender.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Vegan mass gainer shake with pea protein, oats, dates and almond butter
instructions: Briefly grind the oats finely in the blender and roughly chop the dates.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Cherry chocolate mass gainer shake with quark, oats and cocoa
instructions: Grind the oats and walnuts finely in the blender.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Mango coconut mass gainer shake with skyr, oats and whey
instructions: Let the mango soften for 5 minutes and grind the oats and coconut flakes finely in the blender.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Blueberry mass gainer shake with cottage cheese, oats and almonds
instructions: Grind the oats and almonds finely in the blender.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Turkey gyros plate with roast potatoes and tzatziki
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 °C, cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with 1 tsp oil and salt and roast for 30 minutes until golden.
For the tzatziki grate the cucumber, squeeze it out and stir with the yoghurt, half of the garlic and salt.
Mix the turkey strips with the gyros spice, remaining garlic and oil and fry hard with the onion strips for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through.
Serve the gyros with the potatoes, tomato wedges and tzatziki.

title: Chicken pesto pasta with cherry tomatoes and rocket
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente according to the packet, reserving 50 ml of the cooking water.
Dice the chicken and fry in the oil for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and fry with the chicken for 2 minutes.
Mix in the pasta, pesto and cooking water and serve topped with rocket.

title: Chicken mac and cheese with cottage cheese and peas
instructions: Cook the macaroni in salted water until al dente, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Dice the chicken and fry in the oil for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through.
Blend the cottage cheese with the milk, mustard and paprika until smooth and melt it in a pan with the cheddar over medium heat.
Fold in the pasta, peas and chicken and serve hot.

title: Light Philly cheesesteak with beef, peppers and onions in a baguette
instructions: Slice the pepper, onion and mushrooms and fry in half of the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Fry the beef hard in the remaining oil for 2 minutes until no longer pink, season and mix with the vegetables.
Lay the sliced mozzarella on top and let it melt covered for 1 minute.
Split the baguette lengthways, toast briefly and fill.

title: Moussaka with beef mince, aubergine and potatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, slice the potatoes and aubergine, brush with oil and pre-bake on a tray for 15 minutes.
Fry the mince with the onion and garlic until crumbly and cooked through, add the tomatoes, cinnamon and oregano and simmer for 10 minutes.
Layer the potatoes, mince and aubergine in a dish, whisk the yoghurt with the egg and Parmesan and pour over.
Bake for 30 minutes until golden and leave to rest for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken paella with green beans and peppers
instructions: Cut the chicken into pieces, salt and fry in the oil in a large pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
Add the pepper, beans, garlic and grated tomato and fry for 4 minutes.
Stir in the rice, saffron and paprika, pour in the stock and simmer without stirring for 18 minutes until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through.
Leave to rest for 5 minutes and serve with lemon.

title: Jambalaya with chicken and prawns
instructions: Dice the chicken, mix with the Cajun spice and fry in the oil for 5 minutes.
Dice the onion, pepper, celery and garlic and fry for 4 minutes.
Stir in the rice, tomatoes and stock and simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Fold in the prawns and cook for 4 minutes until pink and cooked through.

title: Light chicken parmigiana with wholewheat spaghetti
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C, flatten the chicken breast, dip in the beaten egg and coat in the panko mixed with Parmesan.
Drizzle with half of the oil and bake for 15 minutes.
Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic, remaining oil and oregano for 10 minutes, spoon half onto the chicken, top with mozzarella and bake for 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Cook the spaghetti until al dente, toss with the remaining sauce and serve with the chicken and basil.

title: Orange sesame chicken with jasmine rice and sugar snap peas
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Dice the chicken, toss with half of the cornflour and fry in the oil for 6 to 8 minutes until crisp and cooked through.
Stir the orange juice with the soy sauce, honey, grated ginger and remaining cornflour, pour into the pan and let thicken for 1 minute.
Steam the sugar snap peas for 3 minutes and serve everything with the rice and sesame.

title: Keema matar – beef mince and pea curry with basmati
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Finely chop the onion, garlic and ginger and fry in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the mince and fry until crumbly and cooked through, stir in the garam masala and tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cook the peas in it for 4 minutes and serve with the rice and yoghurt.

title: Turkey spinach cannelloni with ricotta and tomato sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, fry the turkey mince in the oil until crumbly and cooked through, add the spinach and let it wilt.
Let cool, mix with the ricotta, nutmeg, salt and pepper and fill the 6 cannelloni.
Season the tomatoes with the garlic and oregano, put half into a dish, lay the cannelloni on top and cover with the remaining sauce.
Top with mozzarella and bake covered for 25 minutes, then uncovered for 10 minutes.

title: Light chicken fettuccine Alfredo with mushrooms
instructions: Cook the fettuccine in salted water until al dente.
Slice the chicken and fry in the oil for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through, then fry the sliced mushrooms with it for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic, milk and cream cheese and stir until a smooth sauce forms, then stir in the Parmesan.
Toss in the pasta, season with pepper and serve straight away.

title: Prawn linguine with tomatoes, garlic and chilli
instructions: Cook the linguine in salted water until al dente and reserve 50 ml of the cooking water.
Sweat the garlic and chilli in the oil for 1 minute, add the halved tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until pink and cooked through.
Toss in the pasta and cooking water and serve with parsley and Parmesan.

title: Turkey shashlik with pepper sauce and rice
instructions: Cut the turkey, pepper, onion and mushrooms into pieces and thread alternately onto 3 skewers.
Cook the rice according to the packet.
Fry the skewers in the oil for 10 to 12 minutes until the turkey is cooked through.
Simmer the tomatoes with the tomato purée and paprika for 5 minutes and serve with the skewers and rice.

title: Steak and eggs with fried potatoes and tomatoes
instructions: Slice the potatoes and fry in 2 tsp oil for 12 minutes until golden.
Pat the steak dry, salt it and fry in the remaining oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side until cooked through, then rest for 3 minutes.
In the same pan fry 2 eggs until the whites are set and briefly fry the tomato slices.
Slice the steak and serve with the eggs, potatoes and chives.

title: Chicken risotto with peas and Parmesan
instructions: Dice the chicken, fry in the oil for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through and set aside.
Finely dice the onion and sweat in the same pan until translucent, add the rice and stir for 1 minute.
Add the hot stock gradually and cook for 18 minutes while stirring until creamy, adding the peas for the last 4 minutes.
Stir in the chicken, butter, Parmesan and lemon zest and serve.

title: Beef ragù with wholewheat pappardelle
instructions: Cut the beef into small cubes and brown in the oil for 5 minutes.
Finely dice the onion, carrot, celery and garlic, fry for 5 minutes and deglaze with the red wine.
Add the tomatoes, rosemary, bay leaf and 200 ml water and braise covered for 90 minutes until the meat falls apart.
Cook the pappardelle until al dente, toss with the ragù and serve with Parmesan.

title: Chicken gyros bake with rice, peppers and cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and cook the rice according to the packet.
Slice the chicken, mix with the gyros spice and fry with the onion and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes.
Put the rice into a dish, spread the gyros over it, stir the cream with the tomatoes and pour over.
Sprinkle with mozzarella and bake for 20 minutes until golden and the chicken is cooked through.

title: Salmon potato gratin with spinach
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 °C, slice the potatoes thinly and parboil in salted water for 5 minutes.
Wilt the spinach with the garlic and dice the salmon.
Layer the potatoes, spinach and salmon in a dish, whisk the milk with the egg, nutmeg, salt and pepper and pour over.
Sprinkle with the mountain cheese and bake for 30 minutes until golden and the salmon is cooked through, then serve with dill.

title: Creamy chicken spaetzle pan with mushrooms and leek
instructions: Slice the chicken and fry in half of the oil for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through, then set aside.
Fry the sliced mushrooms and leek in the remaining oil for 5 minutes.
Add the spaetzle and fry for 3 minutes until slightly crisp.
Stir in the cream, chicken and paprika, simmer for 2 minutes and serve with parsley.

title: Beef mince and potato bake with savoy cabbage and mountain cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 °C, slice the potatoes and parboil in salted water for 8 minutes.
Fry the mince with the onion in the oil until crumbly and cooked through, add the shredded savoy cabbage and caraway and fry for 5 minutes.
Layer the potatoes and mince cabbage mixture in a dish, whisk the milk with the egg and nutmeg and pour over.
Sprinkle with the mountain cheese and bake for 25 minutes until golden.

title: Chili mac with turkey mince, kidney beans and wholewheat macaroni
instructions: Dice the onion, pepper and garlic and fry in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the turkey mince and fry until crumbly and cooked through, then stir in the spices.
Add the tomatoes, beans, macaroni and 250 ml water and simmer covered for 12 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Sprinkle with the cheddar and let melt covered for 1 minute.

title: Mie goreng with chicken, egg and pak choi
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the packet and drain.
Slice the chicken and stir-fry in the oil in a wok for 5 to 6 minutes until cooked through.
Stir-fry the garlic, carrot sticks and pak choi for 3 minutes, crack the egg at the side and let it set.
Toss in the noodles, soy sauce, honey and sambal and serve hot.

title: Murgh aloo – chicken potato curry with spinach
instructions: Finely chop the onion, garlic and ginger and fry in the oil for 5 minutes until golden, then toast the spices for 1 minute.
Cut the chicken into pieces and the potatoes into cubes, add and fry for 4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and 150 ml water and simmer covered for 20 minutes until the potatoes are soft and the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the spinach, let it wilt and serve with the yoghurt.

title: Salmon tagliatelle with lemon ricotta and peas
instructions: Cook the tagliatelle in salted water until al dente, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes, and reserve 50 ml of the cooking water.
Fry the salmon in the oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side until cooked through and flake into pieces.
Stir the ricotta with the lemon juice, lemon zest and cooking water until smooth.
Fold in the pasta, peas and salmon and serve with dill and pepper.

title: Bún bò xào – lemongrass beef on rice noodles with herbs and peanuts
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to the packet, rinse cold and drain.
Marinate the beef with the finely chopped lemongrass, garlic and half of the fish sauce and stir-fry hard in the oil in a wok for 3 minutes until cooked through.
Stir the remaining fish sauce with the lime juice, honey and 2 tbsp water into a sauce.
Put the noodles into a bowl with the lettuce, cucumber and carrot strips, top with the beef, herbs and chopped peanuts and drizzle with the sauce.

title: Protein calzone with chicken, spinach and ricotta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 °C and knead the flour, quark, oil, baking powder and a pinch of salt into a smooth dough.
Dice the chicken and fry in a pan for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through, then briefly wilt the spinach.
Roll the dough into a round, top one half with the tomatoes, chicken, spinach, ricotta, mozzarella and oregano, fold over and press the edge firmly.
Bake for 18 minutes until golden.

title: Mexican tortilla lasagne with beef mince, beans and sweetcorn
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and fry the mince with the onion until crumbly and cooked through.
Add the tomatoes, beans, sweetcorn and spices and simmer for 5 minutes.
Layer the wraps and filling alternately in a small round dish, finish with cheddar and bake for 15 minutes.
Cut into pieces and serve with a dollop of yoghurt.

title: Galinhada – Brazilian turmeric rice with chicken, sweetcorn and tomatoes
instructions: Cut the chicken into pieces, salt and fry in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the onion, garlic and diced tomato, fry for 3 minutes and stir in the turmeric.
Add the rice, sweetcorn and stock and simmer covered for 18 minutes until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through.
Serve with parsley and lime.

title: Pastel de choclo – Chilean mince and sweetcorn bake with chicken and egg
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and fry the mince with the onion and spices in the oil until crumbly and cooked through.
Dice the chicken and fry for 6 minutes until cooked through, put everything into an ovenproof dish and top with the egg quarters, olives and raisins.
Blend the sweetcorn finely with the milk and basil, thicken for 3 minutes while stirring and salt.
Spread the corn cream over the top and bake for 25 minutes until golden.

title: Light feijoada with beef, black beans and rice
instructions: Dice the beef and brown in the oil for 5 minutes, then fry the onion and garlic with it for 3 minutes.
Add the beans, bay leaf, cumin and 400 ml water and braise covered for 75 minutes until the meat is tender.
Cook the rice and cut the kale into fine strips and steam with a little water for 2 minutes.
Serve the feijoada with the rice, kale and orange slices.

title: Chicken leek pie with a potato topping
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, peel the potatoes, boil for 18 minutes until soft and mash with 50 ml of the milk, half of the butter and nutmeg.
Dice the chicken and fry in the remaining butter for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through, then fry the leek and mushrooms with it for 4 minutes.
Stir the remaining milk with the cornflour and thyme, pour in and simmer for 2 minutes until thickened, then transfer to a dish.
Spread the mash on top, sprinkle with the mountain cheese and bake for 20 minutes until golden.

title: Oven nachos with chicken, black beans and cheddar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, cut each tortilla into 8 triangles, brush with oil and bake for 8 minutes until crisp.
Dice the chicken and fry with the spices in a pan for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through.
Top the chips on a tray with the chicken, beans and cheddar and bake for 5 minutes.
Serve with diced tomato and avocado, yoghurt and lime.

title: Chicken pumpkin curry with chickpeas and brown rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Chop the shallot and ginger and sweat with 3 tbsp of the coconut milk for 3 minutes, add the chicken cubes and fry for 5 minutes.
Add the pumpkin cubes, chickpeas, curry powder and coconut milk and simmer covered for 15 minutes until the pumpkin is soft and the chicken is cooked through.
Serve with the rice.

title: Soba noodle salad with chicken, edamame and peanut lime dressing
instructions: Cook the soba noodles according to the packet, rinse cold and drain, cooking the edamame with them for 3 minutes.
Fry the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through, let cool and dice.
Finely shred the carrot and red cabbage and stir the peanut butter with the lime juice, soy sauce and 2 tbsp water into a dressing.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Take the dressing separately in a small screw-top jar.
Eat cold straight from the container, mixing in the dressing just before eating.

title: Glass noodle salad with turkey, mango, mint and lime
instructions: Soak the glass noodles in hot water for 5 minutes, rinse cold and cut shorter with scissors.
Fry the turkey strips in the oil for 5 to 6 minutes until cooked through and let cool.
Cut the mango, cucumber and pepper into strips and stir the lime juice with the fish sauce and honey.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Take the dressing separately in a small screw-top jar.
Eat cold, mixing in the dressing, herbs and chopped cashews just before.

title: Pesto pasta salad with mini mozzarella, tomatoes and rocket
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente, rinse cold and drain.
Mix with the pesto, beans, halved tomatoes, mozzarella and lemon zest.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Pack the rocket separately and mix it in cold just before eating.

title: Sweet potato bean salad with sweetcorn, lime and feta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C, dice the sweet potato, toss with half of the oil and the spices and roast for 25 minutes.
Rinse the beans, dice the pepper and mix with the sweetcorn, lime juice and remaining oil.
Let the sweet potatoes cool, fold them in and sprinkle with crumbled feta.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Eat cold straight from the container, mixing in the dressing just before eating.

title: Wild rice salad with chicken, pomegranate and pecans
instructions: Cook the wild rice according to the packet for about 40 minutes and let cool.
Fry the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through, let cool and dice.
Mix the rice with the chicken, celery, pomegranate and chopped pecans and whisk the oil, vinegar and mustard.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Take the dressing separately in a small screw-top jar.
Pack the lamb’s lettuce separately and mix in with the dressing just before eating.

title: Cold peanut noodles with tofu, cucumber and carrot
instructions: Cook the noodles until al dente, rinse cold and drain.
Dice the tofu and fry in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Stir the peanut butter with the soy sauce, rice vinegar, maple syrup, ginger, chilli and 3 tbsp water until smooth and toss with the noodles, tofu, cucumber and carrot sticks.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Eat cold from the container, loosening with a splash of water if needed.

title: Mexican rice salad with turkey, kidney beans and sweetcorn
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet and cool it quickly.
Dice the turkey, season with cumin and chilli and fry in half of the oil for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through.
Mix the rice with the turkey, rinsed beans, sweetcorn, diced pepper and tomato, lime juice and remaining oil.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Eat cold straight from the container, mixing in the dressing just before eating.

title: White chili with chicken, white beans and green chilli
instructions: Dice the onion, pepper and garlic and fry in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the whole chicken breast with the stock, beans, sweetcorn and spices and simmer covered for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Remove the chicken, shred it with two forks, mash a quarter of the beans and stir everything back in with the cream cheese.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Salmon patties with cucumber dill salad and potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes, mash 50 g of them and slice the rest.
Finely chop the salmon and shape into 4 patties with the mashed potato, egg, oats, dill, lemon zest and salt.
Fry in the oil for 4 minutes per side until cooked through, then shave the cucumber and mix with the yoghurt and dill.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Keep the cucumber salad separate and eat the patties and potatoes cold or briefly warmed in the microwave.

title: Sanshoku don – Japanese three-colour box with chicken soboro, egg and beans
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet and let cool.
Fry the chicken mince with the soy sauce, honey and grated ginger in a pan for 6 minutes while stirring until crumbly and cooked through.
Whisk the eggs and scramble finely in the oil until set, then blanch the beans for 4 minutes and slice diagonally.
Put the rice into the container and arrange the mince, egg and beans in three stripes on top.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Millet salad with cucumber, pepper, feta and mint
instructions: Rinse the millet with hot water and simmer with twice the amount of water for 10 minutes, leave to swell for 10 minutes and let cool.
Dice the cucumber and pepper, rinse the chickpeas and chop the herbs.
Mix everything with the lemon juice and oil and sprinkle with crumbled feta.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Eat cold straight from the container, mixing in the dressing just before eating.

title: Red cabbage orange salad with chicken, bulgur and walnuts
instructions: Pour 120 ml boiling water over the bulgur, leave to swell for 15 minutes and let cool.
Fry the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through, let cool and dice.
Finely shred the red cabbage and knead firmly with salt, vinegar and oil, segment the orange and mix in with the bulgur, chicken and walnuts.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Eat cold straight from the container, mixing in the dressing just before eating.

title: Wholewheat pasta salad with tuna, capers, olives and tomatoes
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente, rinse cold and drain.
Drain the tuna, halve the tomatoes and finely slice the olives and onion.
Mix everything with the capers, oil, lemon juice and herbs.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Eat cold straight from the container, mixing in the dressing just before eating.

title: Turkey broccoli pasta pan with cream cheese and lemon
instructions: Cook the pasta until al dente, adding the broccoli florets for the last 3 minutes, and reserve 80 ml of the cooking water.
Dice the turkey and fry with the garlic in the oil for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in the cream cheese with the cooking water, lemon juice and lemon zest and toss in the pasta and broccoli.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Chicken fajita pasta with peppers and sweetcorn
instructions: Cook the pasta until al dente and drain.
Slice the chicken, peppers and onion and fry with the spices in the oil for 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the tomatoes, cream and sweetcorn, simmer for 3 minutes and toss in the pasta.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Chicken gnocchi soup with spinach and carrots
instructions: Dice the onion, carrot, celery and garlic and sweat in the oil for 4 minutes.
Dice the chicken, add with the stock and thyme and simmer for 12 minutes until cooked through.
Add the milk and gnocchi, simmer gently for 3 minutes and stir in the spinach.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Dirty rice with turkey mince, peppers and celery
instructions: Fry the turkey mince in the oil until crumbly and cooked through.
Finely dice the onion, pepper, celery and garlic and fry with the Cajun spice for 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice and stock and cook covered for 15 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Three bean salad with chicken and mustard vinaigrette
instructions: Cook the green beans in salted water for 6 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Fry the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through, let cool and dice.
Mix all the beans with the onion, chicken and herbs, whisk the mustard with the vinegar and oil and stir in.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Eat cold straight from the container, mixing in the dressing just before eating.

title: Lentil sweet potato curry with spinach and brown rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Chop the onion and ginger and fry in the oil with the curry powder for 3 minutes.
Add the sweet potato cubes, lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk and 200 ml water and simmer for 18 minutes, then stir in the spinach.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Djuvec rice with chicken, peppers and peas
instructions: Dice the chicken and fry in the oil for 5 minutes, then dice the onion and pepper and fry for 3 minutes.
Briefly toast the tomato purée and paprika, stir in the rice and stock and cook covered for 15 minutes.
Fold in the peas and leave for 3 minutes until the rice and chicken are cooked through.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Edamame bulgur salad with rocket, radishes and lemon
instructions: Pour 140 ml boiling water over the bulgur, leave to swell for 15 minutes and let cool.
Boil the edamame for 3 minutes and refresh in cold water, then dice the radishes and cucumber.
Mix everything with the lemon juice, oil, herbs and toasted sunflower seeds.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Pack the rocket separately and mix it in cold just before eating.

title: Cold sesame rice salad with chicken, edamame and spring onions
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet, spread it out on a tray and cool it quickly.
Fry the chicken in a non-stick pan without oil for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through and boil the edamame for 3 minutes.
Toast the sesame, dice the chicken and mix everything with the pepper, spring onions, sesame oil, rice vinegar and soy sauce.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Eat cold straight from the container without reheating the rice.

title: Potesara – Japanese potato salad with egg, cucumber and carrot
instructions: Peel and dice the potatoes and boil for 15 minutes, adding the diced carrot for the last 5 minutes, and hard boil the eggs for 10 minutes.
Drain the potatoes, roughly mash with the rice vinegar and let cool, then thinly slice the cucumber, salt it and squeeze it out.
Stir the mayonnaise with the yoghurt and mix with the potatoes, cucumber, chopped eggs and cooked edamame.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Eat well chilled straight from the container.

title: Salpicão – Brazilian chicken salad with apple, carrot and sweetcorn
instructions: Simmer the chicken gently in salted water for 15 minutes until cooked through, let cool and shred.
Grate the carrot and apple and finely dice the celery.
Stir the mayonnaise with the yoghurt and mix with the chicken, vegetables, apple, sweetcorn, raisins and parsley.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Take the wrap separately and roll the cold salad up in it.

title: Chicken karahi with tomatoes, ginger and basmati rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Dice the chicken and fry hard in the oil with the garlic and half of the ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes, pepper and spices and reduce for 12 minutes until the chicken is cooked through, stir in the yoghurt and sprinkle with the remaining ginger in thin strips.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Baked empanadas with chicken, peppers and olives
instructions: Knead the flour with the yoghurt, oil and a pinch of salt into a dough and rest for 15 minutes, then preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Finely dice the chicken, pepper and onion and fry with the spices in a non-stick pan for 7 minutes until the chicken is cooked through, then mix in the olives.
Roll the dough into 3 circles, fill, fold into half moons, press the edges, brush with egg and bake for 20 minutes until golden.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
At the office eat cold or reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot.

title: Vegetable strudel with pumpkin, leek and goat cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, finely dice the pumpkin with its skin, slice the leek into rings and fry both in 1 tsp oil for 6 minutes.
Let the vegetables cool and mix with the crumbled goat cheese, quark, egg, chopped walnuts and spices.
Brush the filo sheets with the remaining oil and stack them, spread the filling on top, roll up and bake for 30 minutes until golden, then cut into 3 pieces.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
At the office eat cold or reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot.

title: Frittata di pasta with courgette, peas and hard cheese
instructions: Cook the spaghetti until al dente and drain, then grate the courgette and fry in half of the oil for 3 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, grated cheese, salt and pepper and mix with the spaghetti, courgette and peas.
Set in the remaining oil in a small pan covered for 8 minutes, flip, fry for 4 more minutes and cut into 4 wedges.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
At the office eat cold or reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot.

title: Green Thai curry with turkey, bamboo shoots and jasmine rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Toast the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute, add the turkey strips and fry for 4 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, 80 ml water, beans, courgette and bamboo shoots and simmer for 8 minutes until the turkey is cooked through, then season with the fish sauce.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Broccoli quinoa bake with chicken and cheddar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 °C, cook the quinoa in 120 ml water for 12 minutes and divide the broccoli into small florets.
Dice the chicken and onion and fry in the oil for 5 minutes.
Mix everything with the egg, milk and spices, fill into a small dish, sprinkle with cheddar and bake for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Carrot stew with beef, potatoes and parsley
instructions: Cut the beef into small cubes and brown all over in the oil for 5 minutes, briefly frying the onion with it.
Deglaze with the stock and braise covered for 40 minutes.
Add the diced carrots and potatoes, simmer for 20 minutes until tender, season with marjoram and stir in the parsley.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Kohlrabi potato stew with turkey and dill
instructions: Dice the onion and sweat in the oil until translucent, then dice the turkey and fry for 4 minutes.
Dice the kohlrabi, potatoes and carrot, add with the stock and simmer for 18 minutes until the turkey is cooked through.
Stir in the cream and chopped dill and season.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Beetroot barley salad with chicken and horseradish yoghurt
instructions: Cook the barley in three times the amount of water for 30 minutes, drain and let cool.
Fry the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through, let cool and dice.
Dice the beetroot and apple and mix with the barley, chicken, oil and vinegar, then stir the yoghurt with the horseradish.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Pack the horseradish yoghurt and lamb’s lettuce separately and eat cold with the salad.

title: Curry rice salad with chicken, pineapple and peas
instructions: Cook the rice with a pinch of turmeric according to the packet and cool quickly, cooking the peas with it for 3 minutes.
Fry the chicken in a non-stick pan without oil for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through and dice.
Stir the yoghurt with the mayonnaise and curry powder and mix with the rice, chicken, diced pineapple and pepper.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Eat well chilled straight from the container.

title: Baked taquitos with turkey, sweet potato and peppers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 °C, peel and dice the sweet potato, steam for 10 minutes until soft and mash.
Finely dice the turkey and pepper and fry with the spices in a non-stick pan for 6 to 8 minutes until the turkey is cooked through, then mix with the sweet potato and cream cheese.
Divide the filling over 4 tortillas, roll up tightly, place seam side down on the tray, brush with oil and bake for 15 minutes until crisp, then cut the cucumber into sticks with the lime juice.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Keep the cucumber sticks separate and eat the taquitos cold or warm them for 2 minutes in the microwave.

title: Kale lentil salad with apple, chicken and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Cook the lentils in water for 20 minutes until al dente, drain and let cool.
Fry the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through, let cool and dice.
Finely slice the kale, knead with the oil, vinegar, mustard and salt for 2 minutes until soft and mix with the lentils, chicken, diced apple and toasted pumpkin seeds.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Eat cold straight from the container, mixing in the dressing just before eating.

title: Salmon pasta salad with broccoli, peas and dill yoghurt
instructions: Cook the pasta until al dente, adding the broccoli and peas for the last 3 minutes, and rinse cold.
Bake the salmon at 200 °C for 12 minutes until cooked through, let cool and flake.
Stir the yoghurt with the lemon juice and dill and mix with the pasta, vegetables and salmon.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Eat well chilled straight from the container.

title: Mushroom pasta bake with chicken, peas and mountain cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and cook the pasta 2 minutes less than stated.
Dice the chicken, onion and mushrooms and fry in the oil for 6 minutes, then whisk the milk with the starch, pour in and thicken for 2 minutes while stirring.
Mix in the pasta and peas, fill into a dish, sprinkle with grated mountain cheese and bake for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Asian chicken noodle soup with pak choi and shiitake
instructions: Bring the stock to the boil with the ginger, garlic and soy sauce, poach the chicken in it gently for 12 minutes until cooked through, remove and slice.
Add the mushrooms, carrot and pak choi to the stock, cook for 4 minutes and stir in the sesame oil.
Cook the rice noodles separately according to the packet, rinse cold and toss with a little sesame oil so they do not stick.
Let the broth with vegetables and chicken and the noodles cool separately and keep them in two containers in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Reheat the soup in the microwave for 3 minutes until piping hot and pour over the noodles.

title: Pumpkin quinoa salad with feta, rocket and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C, dice the pumpkin with its skin, toss with half of the oil, rosemary and salt and roast for 25 minutes.
Cook the quinoa in 120 ml water for 12 minutes and let cool, then toast the pumpkin seeds.
Mix the quinoa with the pumpkin, rinsed chickpeas, remaining oil and balsamic and crumble the feta over the top.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Pack the rocket separately and mix it in cold just before eating.

title: Chicken thigh souvlaki with tzatziki and cucumber olive salad
instructions: Cut the chicken into cubes, mix with half of the oil, the lemon juice, oregano and salt and marinate for 10 minutes.
Thread onto 3 skewers and cook in a grill pan for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until the meat is cooked through.
Grate a third of the cucumber, squeeze it out and stir with the yoghurt, garlic and mint into tzatziki.
Dice the remaining cucumber, mix with the olives, crumbled feta and remaining oil and serve everything together.

title: Lamb kofta skewers with tahini sauce, pine nuts and cucumber
instructions: Finely grate the onion and knead with the lamb mince, cumin, a pinch of cinnamon, chopped parsley and salt.
Divide the mixture into 3 portions, shape them lengthwise around 3 skewers and fry in the oil for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Stir the tahini with the lemon juice, garlic and 2 tbsp water until smooth and toast the pine nuts in a dry pan.
Serve the skewers with cucumber slices and lettuce, drizzle with the tahini sauce and sprinkle with the pine nuts.

title: Tandoori chicken thighs with cucumber raita and roasted cauliflower
instructions: Mix the chicken with half of the yoghurt, the ginger, garlic, lemon juice, tandoori spice and salt and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 220 °C, toss the cauliflower florets with the melted ghee and cumin and place on a tray with the chicken.
Roast for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and charred at the edges.
Grate the cucumber, stir with the remaining yoghurt, mint and salt into raita and serve alongside.

title: Courgette boats with tuna mozzarella filling and pine nuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, halve the courgette lengthwise and scoop out the centre with a spoon.
Chop the scooped courgette flesh and fry in half of the oil for 3 minutes, then mix with the tuna, cream cheese, oregano, salt and pepper.
Brush the courgette halves with the remaining oil, fill them, top with the mozzarella and pine nuts and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve sprinkled with fresh basil.

title: Lemon cheesecake fat bombs with cream cheese and coconut
instructions: Warm the coconut oil gently until liquid and stir with the cream cheese, lemon juice, lemon zest and vanilla until smooth.
Let the mixture firm up in the fridge for 20 minutes.
Shape 4 balls with damp hands and roll them in the desiccated coconut.
Serve chilled and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Matcha coconut fat bombs with macadamia
instructions: Finely grind the macadamia nuts in a mini chopper.
