Put the beans and tofu cubes into a small dish, pour the sauce over and bake at 190 °C for 30 minutes.
Serve sprinkled with plenty of dill.

title: Lecsó with smoked tofu, peppers, tomatoes and edamame
instructions: Dice the smoked tofu and fry in a non-stick pan without oil for 4 minutes.
Add the onion in strips and the peppers in rings and braise for 8 minutes until soft.
Dice the tomatoes, add them with the edamame and paprika and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir the pea protein smooth with 3 tbsp water, stir it in, season with salt and chilli and serve.

title: Sopa negra – black bean soup with tofu, celery and lime
instructions: Dice the onion, pepper, celery and garlic and sweat them in a pot with 2 tbsp water for 5 minutes.
Add the beans, cumin, oregano and stock and simmer for 12 minutes.
Blend half the soup with the pea protein and return it to the pot.
Warm the tofu cubes in it for 3 minutes, season with the lime juice and serve with coriander.

title: Chocolate peanut protein shake with soy drink and date
instructions: Chop the date and put it into a blender with the soy drink, soy protein, peanut butter and cocoa.
Blend very smoothly for 45 seconds.
Pour into a glass and drink straight away.

title: Berry vanilla shake with silken tofu, pea protein and linseed
instructions: Put the silken tofu, soy drink, pea protein, berries, linseed and vanilla into a blender.
Blend very smoothly for 40 seconds.
Pour into a glass and serve cold.

title: Matcha mango protein shake with soy drink
instructions: Put the soy drink, soy protein, mango and matcha into a blender.
Blend for 30 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and serve straight away.

title: Mocha protein shake with espresso, soy skyr and cocoa
instructions: Brew the espresso and leave to cool.
Blend with the soy drink, soy protein, soy skyr, cocoa and date for 40 seconds until smooth.
Pour into a glass with ice cubes.

title: Green spinach pineapple protein smoothie with pea protein and ginger
instructions: Put the soy drink, pea protein, pineapple, spinach, banana and ginger into a blender.
Blend very smoothly for 45 seconds.
Pour into a glass and drink fresh.

title: Cherry almond shake with soy skyr and pea protein
instructions: Put the soy skyr, soy drink, pea protein, cherries, almond butter and bitter almond flavouring into a blender.
Blend for 40 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and serve cold.

title: Gingerbread protein shake with soy drink, date and almond butter
instructions: Chop the date and soak it in 50 ml of the soy drink for 5 minutes.
Blend with the remaining soy drink, soy protein, almond butter and spices for 40 seconds until smooth.
Pour into a glass and dust with a pinch of cinnamon.

title: Peach ginger shake with silken tofu and pea protein
instructions: Stone the peach and cut it into pieces.
Blend with the silken tofu, soy drink, pea protein, ginger and vanilla for 40 seconds until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve cold.

title: Strawberry basil shake with silken tofu and soy skyr
instructions: Hull and halve the strawberries.
Blend with the soy skyr, silken tofu, soy protein, basil and 4 tbsp cold water for 40 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and serve with a basil leaf.

title: Golden milk protein shake with soy drink, turmeric and cashews
instructions: Put the soy drink, soy protein, banana, cashews and spices into a blender.
Blend for 30 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and dust with cinnamon.

title: Silken tofu chocolate pudding with soy protein and raspberries
instructions: Drain the silken tofu.
Blend with the soy protein, cocoa and maple syrup for 1 minute until very smooth.
Spoon into a jar, chill for 30 minutes and top with the raspberries.

title: Vanilla panna cotta with agar, soy drink and raspberry sauce
instructions: Stir the soy drink with the agar, vanilla and maple syrup, bring to the boil and boil for 2 minutes.
Leave to cool slightly, then whisk in the soy protein until free of lumps.
Pour into a jar and chill for 2 hours.
Thaw the raspberries, crush them with a fork and spoon them on as a sauce.

title: Lemon cheesecake cream made from soy skyr with blueberries and oat crumble
instructions: Toast the gluten-free oats in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden.
Stir the soy skyr smooth with the soy protein, maple syrup, lemon zest and vanilla.
Put the oats into a jar, layer the cream on top and finish with the blueberries.

title: Rhubarb compote with vanilla silken tofu cream and soy skyr
instructions: Cut the rhubarb into 2 cm pieces and stew with half the maple syrup, cinnamon and 2 tbsp water for 6 minutes until soft, then leave to cool.
Blend the silken tofu with the pea protein, remaining maple syrup and vanilla until smooth.
Spoon the cream into a jar, add the soy skyr and finish with the compote.

title: Dark chocolate espresso mousse made from silken tofu with pea protein
instructions: Melt the chocolate over a warm water bath.
Blend the silken tofu with the pea protein, cocoa, espresso and maple syrup until smooth.
Add the melted chocolate, blend briefly and spoon into a jar.
Chill for at least 1 hour until the mousse has set.

title: Roasted lupin and edamame snack mix with smoked paprika
ingredients: Smoked paprika, garlic powder, sea salt
instructions: Pat the lupins and thawed edamame thoroughly dry.
Toss with the oil, paprika, garlic powder and sea salt and spread on a baking tray.
Roast at 200 °C for 25 minutes until crisp, turning 2 times.
Leave to cool so they crisp up further.

title: Crispy oven lupins with lemon, rosemary and chilli
ingredients: Lemon zest, rosemary, chilli flakes, sea salt
instructions: Rinse the lupins and pat them very dry.
Toss with the oil, chopped rosemary, chilli flakes and salt.
Roast on a tray at 210 °C for 25 minutes, turning halfway.
Toss with the lemon juice and lemon zest and leave to cool.

title: Tropical soy skyr with kiwi, passion fruit and coconut chips
instructions: Stir the soy skyr smooth with the soy protein and lime zest and put into a bowl.
Peel and slice the kiwi, halve the passion fruit and scoop out the pulp.
Arrange the kiwi and passion fruit on the skyr and sprinkle with the coconut chips.

title: No-bake coconut almond protein bars with gluten-free oats
instructions: Mix the pea protein, oats and desiccated coconut in a bowl.
Add the almond butter, maple syrup and soy drink and knead into a firm dough.
Shape into 2 bars and chill for 30 minutes.

title: Tofu lupin hummus with vegetable sticks
instructions: Blend the tofu, lupins, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and 3 tbsp water until very smooth.
Season with salt, put into a bowl and dust with paprika.
Cut the carrot, cucumber and kohlrabi into sticks and serve alongside.

title: Smoked tofu cucumber bites with soy skyr dill cream
instructions: Cut the cucumber into 12 thick slices and the smoked tofu into 12 cubes.
Stir the soy skyr with the dill, lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Put 1 dollop of cream onto each cucumber slice and top with a tofu cube.
Garnish with radish slices and dill.

title: Oven tofu nuggets in nutritional yeast chickpea coating with tomato dip
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut it into 10 bite-sized pieces.
Mix the chickpea flour, nutritional yeast, paprika, garlic powder and salt, coat the tofu with the oil and toss it in the mixture.
Bake on a tray at 220 °C for 20 minutes until crisp, turning halfway.
Simmer the passata with oregano and salt for 5 minutes and serve as a dip.

title: Frozen soy skyr berry bark with pistachios
instructions: Stir the soy skyr smooth with the soy protein and maple syrup.
Spread it 1 cm thick on a small board lined with baking paper.
Press the berries and pistachios into it and freeze for 3 hours.
Break into pieces and serve straight away.

title: Mango chia protein pudding with soy drink and soy skyr
instructions: Whisk the soy drink with the pea protein and vanilla until free of lumps.
Stir in the chia seeds, leave to swell for 10 minutes, stir again and chill for at least 2 hours.
Purée the mango, spoon the pudding into a jar, layer the soy skyr and mango purée on top and sprinkle with lime zest.

title: Raspberry banana nice cream with pea protein and soy skyr
instructions: Slice the frozen banana.
Blend with the frozen raspberries, pea protein, soy skyr and 3 tbsp cold water in a blender for 1 minute until creamy.
Serve immediately as soft serve or freeze for 20 minutes.

title: Poached pear with vanilla soy skyr and dark chocolate
instructions: Peel, halve and core the pear and poach gently in 300 ml water with the cinnamon stick and clove for 12 minutes.
Stir the soy skyr with the soy protein and vanilla until creamy.
Melt the chocolate, arrange the pear halves on the cream and drizzle with the chocolate.

title: Peanut chocolate protein balls with gluten-free oats and dates
instructions: Chop the date very finely.
Knead with the pea protein, oats, peanut butter, cocoa and soy drink into a firm dough.
Shape 6 balls and chill for 20 minutes.

title: Pumpkin spice pudding made from silken tofu with pecans
instructions: Blend the silken tofu, pumpkin purée, soy protein, maple syrup, soy drink and spices for 1 minute until smooth.
Spoon into a jar and chill for 1 hour.
Serve with chopped pecans and a pinch of cinnamon.

title: Chocolate hazelnut protein spread on rice cakes
instructions: Stir the soy skyr, soy protein, hazelnut butter and cocoa into a thick cream.
Spread the cream onto the 2 rice cakes.
Top with strawberry slices and eat straight away.

title: Black bean brownies with pea protein and dark chocolate
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Blend the beans, pea protein, cocoa, maple syrup, almond butter, soy drink, baking soda and vanilla until smooth.
Spread the batter into a small lined tin, scatter the chopped chocolate on top and bake for 20 minutes.
Leave to cool and cut into 2 pieces.

title: Egg white omelette with spinach, mushrooms and light feta
instructions: Fry the sliced mushrooms in the oil for 4 minutes, wilt the spinach for 1 minute and remove.
Whisk the egg and egg white with salt, pepper and nutmeg and pour into the pan.
Let it set over medium heat for 4 minutes, then put the vegetables and crumbled feta on one half.
Fold the omelette over and serve with chives.

title: Shakshuka with eggs, egg white, chickpeas and peppers
instructions: Dice the onion and pepper and sweat in a non-stick pan with 2 tbsp water for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and spices and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Stir the egg white into the sauce, make 2 hollows and crack the 2 eggs into them.
Cook covered for 6 minutes until the whites are set and serve with coriander.

title: Cottage cheese buckwheat pancakes with berries
instructions: Stir the cottage cheese, egg, buckwheat flour, vanilla and baking powder into a thick batter.
Brush the pan with the oil and cook 4 small pancakes over medium heat for 2 minutes on each side.
Serve with the skyr and berries.

title: Çılbır – poached eggs on garlic skyr with pul biber oil and cucumber
instructions: Stir the skyr with the crushed garlic and salt and spread it on a plate.
Poach the eggs in simmering vinegar water for 4 minutes and place them on the skyr.
Briefly warm the oil with the pul biber and drizzle it over.
Serve with dill and cucumber slices.

title: Scrambled eggs with egg white, smoked tofu, cherry tomatoes and lamb’s lettuce
instructions: Finely dice the smoked tofu and toast in a non-stick pan without oil for 3 minutes.
Whisk the eggs and egg white with salt and pepper, pour in and let set creamily over low heat for 3 minutes.
Serve with halved cherry tomatoes, lamb’s lettuce and chives.

title: Buckwheat quark porridge with apple, cinnamon and walnuts
instructions: Rinse the buckwheat and simmer in the milk with 50 ml water for 12 minutes until soft.
Take off the heat, leave to cool slightly and stir in the quark with the cinnamon.
Dice the apple, scatter it over and sprinkle with chopped walnuts.

title: Spinach feta egg muffins with peppers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and set out 4 cups of a silicone muffin tray.
Chop the spinach, finely dice the pepper and divide between the 4 cups with the crumbled feta.
Whisk the eggs and egg white with oregano, salt and pepper and pour over.
Bake for 20 minutes until the muffins are set and golden.

title: Gluten-free overnight oats with quark, skyr, plums and cinnamon
instructions: Stir the gluten-free oats with the milk, quark, skyr and cinnamon.
Cover and leave to soak overnight in the fridge.
Stone the plums, cut them into wedges and arrange on the oats.

title: Protein crêpes made from egg white and buckwheat with cottage cheese and spinach
instructions: Whisk the egg white smooth with the buckwheat flour and a pinch of salt and leave to rest for 5 minutes.
Brush the pan with the oil and cook 2 thin crêpes from the batter for 1 minute on each side.
Wilt the spinach in the pan and season with nutmeg.
Fill the crêpes with the cottage cheese and spinach, fold and serve with chives.

title: Courgette and pea frittata with mint
instructions: Coarsely grate the courgette, salt it, leave for 5 minutes and squeeze out well.
Fry the courgette and peas in the oil in a small ovenproof pan for 3 minutes.
Whisk the eggs, egg white, mint, lemon zest and pepper and pour over.
Let it set on the hob for 4 minutes and finish in the oven at 200 °C for 6 minutes.

title: Poached eggs on spinach with cottage cheese dill sauce
instructions: Blend the cottage cheese finely with the dill, lemon juice, salt and 1 tbsp water.
Wilt the spinach with the garlic in a pan for 2 minutes and season with nutmeg.
Poach the eggs in simmering vinegar water for 4 minutes.
Set the eggs on the spinach and spoon over the dill sauce.

title: Egg and lentil breakfast bowl with spinach and cherry tomatoes
instructions: Cook the lentils in water for 20 minutes until al dente, drain and season with cumin, lemon juice and salt.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes until jammy, cool and peel.
Let the egg white set in the oil in a pan for 2 minutes and break it up, then toss in the spinach for 1 minute.
Put the lentils, spinach egg white and halved tomatoes into a bowl, halve the eggs, place them on top and sprinkle with chilli flakes.

title: Tamagoyaki with egg white, edamame and cucumber salad
instructions: Whisk the eggs and egg white with half the tamari.
Let it set in a non-stick pan in 3 thin layers one after the other, rolling up each time.
Slice the cucumber thinly and mix with the rice vinegar, remaining tamari and sesame, then cook the edamame for 4 minutes.
Cut the omelette roll into 6 slices and serve with the cucumber salad and edamame.

title: Egg white frittata with broccoli, cherry tomatoes and light feta
instructions: Divide the broccoli into small florets and blanch for 3 minutes.
Fry the broccoli and halved cherry tomatoes in the oil in an ovenproof pan for 2 minutes.
Whisk the egg and egg white with oregano, salt and pepper, pour over and crumble the feta on top.
Cook for 4 minutes on the hob and 8 minutes in the oven at 200 °C, then serve with parsley.

title: Cottage cheese lentil bowl with cucumber, tomatoes, edamame and mint
instructions: Cook the lentils in water for 20 minutes until al dente, adding the edamame for the last 4 minutes, then drain.
Toss with the oil, lemon juice, salt and half the mint.
Dice the cucumber and tomatoes and put them into a bowl with the lentils.
Top with the cottage cheese and sprinkle with sumac and the remaining mint.

title: Palak with cottage cheese and chickpeas
instructions: Blanch the spinach for 2 minutes, refresh in cold water and blend finely.
Toast the cumin in the oil for 30 seconds, then sweat the onion, ginger, garlic and tomatoes for 6 minutes.
Add the spinach purée, chickpeas, garam masala and chilli and simmer for 5 minutes.
Take off the heat, fold in the cottage cheese and season with salt.

title: Egg and tofu curry with tomatoes and spinach
ingredients: Garam masala, turmeric, cumin, chilli, coriander
instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and score them lightly all over.
Brown the onion and ginger in a non-stick pot without fat for 5 minutes and toast the spices for 1 minute.
Add the passata and diced tofu and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the eggs and spinach, leave to steep for 3 minutes and serve with coriander.

title: Cauliflower fried rice with egg, edamame and tofu
instructions: Coarsely grate the cauliflower and finely dice the tofu.
Fry the tofu in the oil for 4 minutes, then fry the ginger, garlic and cauliflower with it for 5 minutes.
Push everything to the side, add the egg and egg white to the middle and let it set while stirring.
Mix in the edamame and tamari, fry for 2 minutes and serve with spring onions.

title: Tandoori roast cauliflower with skyr marinade, chickpeas and cottage cheese raita
ingredients: Tandoori spice, garlic, lemon juice, mint
instructions: Stir the skyr with the tandoori spice, garlic, lemon juice and salt.
Toss the cauliflower florets and chickpeas in it and spread on a tray.
Roast at 220 °C for 25 minutes until the edges are dark.
Finely grate the cucumber, mix with the cottage cheese, mint and salt and serve alongside.

title: Low-carb pizza with quark and egg base, mushrooms, peppers and mozzarella
instructions: Stir the quark, egg, egg white, psyllium husk and salt together and leave to swell for 5 minutes.
Spread the mixture into a circle on baking paper and pre-bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Spread with the passata and oregano and top with the mushrooms, pepper and torn mozzarella.
Bake for another 10 minutes and serve with basil.

title: Courgette lasagne with cottage cheese and lentil tomato sauce
instructions: Cook the lentils for 20 minutes until al dente and simmer with the onion, garlic, passata and oregano for 10 minutes.
Slice the courgette lengthwise into thin strips.
Layer the courgette, lentil sauce and cottage cheese in a small dish and finish with the mozzarella.
Bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes and serve with basil.

title: Oven peppers stuffed with lentils, quark and egg
instructions: Cook the lentils in water for 20 minutes until al dente and drain.
Halve the peppers lengthwise and deseed them.
Mix the lentils with the quark, egg, herbs and spices and fill the 4 halves.
Bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes until the filling has set and is lightly browned.

title: Light Spanish tortilla with egg white, potatoes and peppers
instructions: Slice the potato thinly and cook in salted water for 8 minutes.
Fry the onion and pepper in the oil in a small pan for 5 minutes until soft and add the potatoes.
Whisk the eggs and egg white with the paprika and salt, pour over and let set covered over low heat for 8 minutes.
Turn it using a plate, cook for another 2 minutes and serve with parsley.

title: Lentil spinach pan with light feta, cottage cheese and a poached egg
instructions: Cook the lentils in water for 20 minutes until al dente and drain.
Sweat the garlic, cumin and diced tomatoes in a non-stick pan for 3 minutes, then toss in the lentils and spinach for 2 minutes.
Poach the egg in simmering vinegar water for 4 minutes.
Put the lentils onto a plate, scatter the cottage cheese and crumbled feta over, set the egg on top and sprinkle with chilli flakes.

title: Gyeran-jjim – steamed egg custard with tofu, courgette and spring onions
instructions: Whisk the eggs and egg white smooth with the stock and salt and pour through a sieve.
Finely dice the tofu and courgette, put into a heatproof bowl and pour the egg mixture over.
Steam gently covered in a pot over simmering water for 12 minutes.
Serve with spring onions, sesame, gochugaru and sesame oil.

title: Baked sweet potato with herb cottage cheese, skyr and chickpeas
instructions: Halve the sweet potato lengthwise and bake at 200 °C for 35 minutes until soft.
Roast the chickpeas with the paprika and cumin for the last 15 minutes.
Stir the cottage cheese with the skyr, herbs and salt.
Press open the sweet potato halves, fill with the herb cream and scatter the chickpeas on top.

title: Vegetarian niçoise salad with eggs, green and white beans
instructions: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool, peel and quarter them, then set the egg white into a thin omelette in a non-stick pan and cut into strips.
Cook the green beans in salted water for 7 minutes and refresh.
Stir the mustard, vinegar, 1 tbsp water and salt into a dressing.
Arrange the lettuce, beans, tomatoes, olives, egg white strips and eggs, drizzle with the dressing and sprinkle with capers.

title: Courgette fritters with light feta and skyr dip
instructions: Grate the courgette, salt it, leave for 10 minutes and squeeze out firmly.
Mix with the egg, egg white, chickpea flour, crumbled feta, dill and mint.
Fry 6 fritters in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes on each side until golden.
Stir the skyr with the garlic and salt and serve alongside.

title: Egg foo young with bean sprouts, shiitake and spring onions
instructions: Slice the shiitake and mix with the sprouts and spring onions.
Whisk the eggs and egg white with the ginger, pepper and half the tamari and fold in the vegetables.
Fry 2 omelettes one after the other in the oil for 2 minutes on each side until golden.
Bring the remaining tamari with the cornflour and 80 ml water to the boil and pour over as a sauce.

title: Huevos rancheros without tortilla with black beans and egg white
instructions: Dice the onion and pepper and sweat in a non-stick pan with 2 tbsp water for 4 minutes.
Add the passata, beans, cumin and chipotle and simmer for 6 minutes.
Stir in the egg white, make 2 hollows, crack in the 2 eggs and cook covered for 6 minutes.
Serve with coriander and lime juice.

title: Cauliflower gratin with cottage cheese, egg and light grated cheese
instructions: Precook the cauliflower florets in salted water for 8 minutes and drain well.
Stir the cottage cheese with the egg, nutmeg, mustard powder and salt.
Put the cauliflower into a small dish, spread the cream over and sprinkle with the grated cheese.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes until golden and serve with chives.

title: Crustless broccoli quiche with quark, eggs and light grated cheese
instructions: Divide the broccoli into small florets and blanch for 3 minutes.
Stir the eggs smooth with the quark, nutmeg, thyme and salt.
Put the broccoli into a small quiche dish, pour the egg mixture over and sprinkle with the grated cheese.
Bake at 180 °C for 30 minutes until the quiche has set.

title: Green asparagus with poached eggs and skyr hollandaise
instructions: Cut off the woody ends and cook the asparagus in salted water for 5 minutes.
Warm the skyr with the mustard, lemon juice, turmeric and salt in a water bath for 3 minutes while stirring until lukewarm.
Poach the eggs in simmering vinegar water for 4 minutes.
Arrange the asparagus, set the eggs on top, coat with the sauce and sprinkle with the herbs.

title: Green shakshuka with spinach, courgette, leek and light feta
instructions: Slice the leek into rings and dice the courgette and sweat in a non-stick pan with 2 tbsp water for 5 minutes.
Add the spinach, garlic and cumin, wilt for 2 minutes and stir in the egg white.
Make 2 hollows, crack in the 2 eggs and cook covered for 6 minutes.
Serve with crumbled feta, coriander and chilli flakes.

title: Egg and tofu salad in lettuce cups with radishes and chives
instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes, set the egg white in a non-stick pan, let both cool and chop.
Blend the tofu with the mustard, turmeric, salt and 1 tbsp water until creamy.
Fold the chopped eggs, finely diced cucumber and chives into the tofu cream.
Fill the salad into the 6 leaves and garnish with radish slices and paprika.

title: Stuffed mushrooms with cottage cheese, spinach and light grated cheese
instructions: Twist out the mushroom stalks and chop finely, then sweat the spinach with the garlic and stalks in the oil for 3 minutes.
Mix with the cottage cheese, thyme and salt and fill the 8 mushroom caps.
Sprinkle with the grated cheese and bake at 200 °C for 18 minutes.
Arrange the sliced tomatoes with basil and salt alongside.

title: Pumpkin lentil soup with skyr and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Deseed and dice the pumpkin and chop the onion.
Simmer the pumpkin, onion, lentils, ginger, cumin and stock for 20 minutes until soft.
Blend finely, leave to cool slightly and stir in two thirds of the skyr.
Serve with the remaining skyr, toasted pumpkin seeds and chilli flakes.

title: Khai jiao – Thai omelette with tofu and cucumber tomato salad
instructions: Finely crumble the tofu and whisk vigorously with the eggs, egg white and tamari.
Heat the oil in a pan until very hot, pour in the egg mixture and let it puff up for 2 minutes, turn and fry for 1 more minute.
Dice the cucumber and tomatoes and mix with the lime juice, chilli and coriander.
Serve the omelette with the salad.

title: Roast vegetables with light feta, chickpeas and garlic skyr
instructions: Cut the courgette, pepper and onion into large pieces and toss with the chickpeas, oil, oregano and salt.
Roast on a tray at 220 °C for 20 minutes.
Add the feta in cubes and bake for another 8 minutes.
Stir the skyr with the garlic, lemon zest and salt and serve alongside.

title: Šaltibarščiai – cold beetroot soup with skyr, cucumber and egg
instructions: Hard-boil the egg for 9 minutes, cool and halve.
Finely grate the beetroot and cucumber.
Stir the skyr smooth with the milk, mix in the vegetables, dill and salt and chill for 30 minutes.
Pour into a bowl, set the egg halves on top and sprinkle with spring onion greens.

title: Cottage cheese with cucumber, radishes, chives and linseed
instructions: Cut the cucumber and radishes into small cubes.
Mix with the cottage cheese, chives, salt and pepper.
Put into a bowl and sprinkle with the linseed.

title: Lemon quark cream with raspberries, honey and pistachios
instructions: Stir the quark with the honey, lemon juice, lemon zest, vanilla and 1 tbsp water until creamy.
Spoon into a jar and top with the raspberries.
Sprinkle with the chopped pistachios.

title: Savoury egg muffins with peppers, edamame and chives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C, finely dice the pepper and divide it with the edamame between 4 cups of a silicone muffin tray.
Whisk the eggs and egg white with the chives, paprika and salt and pour over.
Bake for 20 minutes and enjoy warm or cold.

title: Crustless protein cheesecake made from quark with lemon
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 °C.
Stir the quark, egg, cornflour, honey, lemon zest and vanilla until smooth.
Pour into a small greased dish and bake for 35 minutes.
Leave to cool in the switched-off oven and serve chilled.

title: Blueberry lemon skyr shake with linseed
instructions: Put the skyr, milk, blueberries, linseed and lemon zest into a blender.
Blend for 40 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and serve cold.

title: Cottage cheese with peach, basil and pistachios
instructions: Stone the peach and cut it into wedges.
Put the cottage cheese into a bowl and arrange the peach wedges on top.
Sprinkle with the pistachios, basil and a little pepper.

title: Deviled eggs with skyr mustard cream and cucumber sticks
instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and halve lengthwise.
Remove the yolks and stir smooth with the skyr, mustard and salt.
Fill the cream into the 6 egg white halves and sprinkle with paprika and chives.
Serve with cucumber sticks and halved radishes.

title: Edamame with light feta, mint and lemon
instructions: Cook the edamame in salted water for 4 minutes and drain.
Toss with the lemon juice, lemon zest and chopped mint.
Crumble the feta over and sprinkle with chilli flakes.

title: Herb quark dip with carrot, kohlrabi and pepper sticks
instructions: Stir the quark with the herbs, garlic, salt and 2 tbsp water until creamy.
Cut the carrot, kohlrabi and pepper into sticks.
Spoon the dip into a small bowl and serve with the vegetable sticks.

title: Matcha skyr cream with kiwi and coconut chips
instructions: Stir the matcha smooth with 1 tbsp warm water and mix with the skyr and honey.
Peel and slice the kiwi.
Put the cream into a bowl and top with the kiwi and coconut chips.

title: Cottage cheese plate with nectarine, blackberries and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Wash and stone the nectarine and cut it into thin wedges, briefly rinse the blackberries.
Put the cottage cheese on a plate and arrange the fruit next to it.
Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan for 2 minutes, scatter them over and dust with cinnamon.

title: Smoked salmon and cucumber plate with skyr dill cream and crispbread
instructions: Stir the skyr with chopped dill, lemon juice, a little lemon zest and pepper until smooth.
Wash the cucumber and cut it into thin slices.
Arrange the loosely folded smoked salmon on a plate with the cucumber slices, skyr dill cream and the 2 crispbread slices.

title: Tomato and spinach scrambled eggs on rye bread
instructions: Dice the tomato and whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a pan and sweat the spinach and tomato for 2 minutes until the spinach wilts.
Pour in the eggs and let them set slowly over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes into creamy scrambled eggs.
Toast the rye bread if you like and pile the scrambled eggs on top.

title: Soy yoghurt with plums, pea protein and walnuts
instructions: Stir the soy yoghurt with the pea protein in a bowl until smooth.
Wash, halve and stone the plums.
Top the yoghurt with the plums and roughly broken walnuts and dust with cinnamon.

title: Turkey breast avocado toast with radishes and cucumber
instructions: Toast the bread until golden.
Mash the avocado with the lemon juice, salt and pepper and spread it on both slices of toast.
Cut the radishes and cucumber into thin slices.
Lay the turkey breast on the avocado and top with the radish and cucumber slices.

title: Quark with grapefruit, orange and pistachios
instructions: Stir the quark with the vanilla and 2 tbsp water until creamy and spoon it into a bowl.
Peel the grapefruit and orange with a knife and cut out the segments between the membranes.
Lay the segments on the quark, chop the pistachios and scatter them over, then drizzle with the honey.

title: Tofu scramble with peppers and spring onions
instructions: Dice the pepper, slice the spring onions into rings and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Heat the oil in a pan, fry the pepper and tomatoes for 3 minutes and push the tomatoes to the side.
Crumble in the tofu with your hands, season with turmeric, kala namak and pepper and fry for 4 minutes, stirring.
Fold in the spring onions and serve everything together on a plate.

title: Egg white omelette with mushrooms, cherry tomatoes and chives
instructions: Slice the mushrooms and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan, fry the mushrooms for 3 minutes until golden, then remove.
Whisk the egg whites with the egg, salt and pepper, pour into the pan and let set over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes.
Put the mushrooms on one half, fold the omelette over and serve with the tomatoes and chives.

title: Skyr with kiwi, banana and linseed
instructions: Stir the skyr until smooth and spoon it into a bowl.
Peel the kiwi and cut it into slices, and slice the banana too.
Arrange the fruit on the skyr and sprinkle with the linseed.

title: Cottage cheese crispbread with cucumber, tomato and chives
instructions: Cut the cucumber and tomato into thin slices and snip the chives into fine rings.
Spread the cottage cheese evenly over the 3 crispbread slices.
Top with the cucumber and tomato, sprinkle with chives and pepper and eat straight away.

title: Chocolate protein porridge with raspberries
instructions: Bring the oats and milk to the boil in a small pan and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Take the pan off the heat, stir in the protein powder and cocoa and loosen with a splash of water if needed.
Spoon into a bowl and top with the raspberries.

title: Fried eggs on wholegrain toast with avocado and cherry tomatoes
instructions: Heat the oil in a pan, crack in the 2 eggs and fry over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes until the whites are set.
Meanwhile toast the bread and slice the avocado.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and season lightly with salt.
Top the toast with the avocado, place a fried egg on each slice, season with pepper and serve with the tomatoes.

title: Skyr with grated apple, cinnamon and hazelnuts
instructions: Wash, quarter and core the apple and coarsely grate it with the skin on.
Spoon the skyr into a bowl and spread the grated apple on top.
Roughly chop the hazelnuts, scatter them over and dust with cinnamon.

title: Chicken breast slices on wholegrain bread with cucumber and pepper strips
instructions: Spread the 2 slices of bread thinly with the cream cheese.
Slice the cucumber and cut the pepper into strips.
Top the bread with the chicken breast and cucumber, sprinkle with chives and pepper and serve with the pepper strips.

title: Caprese breakfast bread with egg
instructions: Hard-boil the egg in boiling water for 8 minutes, cool under cold water and peel.
Meanwhile slice the tomato and mozzarella.
Top the bread with alternating tomato and mozzarella slices and lay the sliced egg on top.
Drizzle with the olive oil and balsamic vinegar, season with salt and pepper and top with basil.

title: Pistachio protein ice cream with skyr
instructions: Grind half of the pistachios very finely in a mini chopper, roughly chop the rest and set aside.
Blend the skyr, ground pistachios, banana, honey and vanilla until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Spoon into a bowl and sprinkle with the chopped pistachios.

title: Peanut chocolate protein ice cream with banana
instructions: Slice three quarters of the banana and freeze for at least 4 hours, keeping the rest for decoration.
Let the frozen banana soften for 5 minutes, then blend with the soy yoghurt, pea protein and cocoa in a food processor for 1 to 2 minutes until creamy.
Spoon into a bowl, swirl the slightly warmed peanut butter over the top and add the remaining banana slices.

title: Crispy air fryer broccoli florets with sriracha skyr dip
instructions: Divide the broccoli into small florets, wash and pat dry well.
Toss the florets with the oil, yeast flakes, garlic powder, paprika and salt.
Roast in the air fryer at 190 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes until crispy, shaking halfway through.
Stir the skyr with the sriracha and serve as a dip.

title: Air fryer halloumi fries with pomegranate and yoghurt mint dip
instructions: Cut the halloumi into finger-thick sticks, pat dry and dust all over with a thin layer of cornflour and paprika.
Cook in the air fryer at 200 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes until golden, turning halfway through.
Stir the yoghurt with finely chopped mint.
Arrange the halloumi fries, scatter with pomegranate seeds and mint and serve with the dip.

title: Air fryer chicken nuggets in almond crumb with yoghurt dip
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into about 8 bite-sized pieces and season with salt, paprika and garlic powder.
Dip the pieces first in the whisked egg white, then in the almond flour, pressing it on well.
Cook in the air fryer at 200 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes until golden and cooked through, turning halfway.
Stir the yoghurt with the mustard, salt and pepper and serve as a dip.

title: Green protein smoothie with spinach, pineapple and whey
instructions: Peel the pineapple and cut it into pieces, keeping a small wedge for the rim, and wash the spinach.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Coffee banana protein shake
instructions: Make the espresso and let it cool completely, then peel the banana and break it into pieces.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass, dust with cinnamon and drink straight away.

title: Blueberry beetroot smoothie with soy protein
instructions: Roughly dice the beetroot and set aside a few blueberries for the top.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass, top with the reserved blueberries and drink straight away.

title: Mango turmeric shake with skyr and ginger
instructions: Peel the mango, cut the flesh off the stone and roughly dice it, then peel the ginger.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Mocha cream with silken tofu and orange segments
instructions: Drain the silken tofu and blend with the cocoa, espresso, maple syrup, soy protein and vanilla for 1 minute until smooth.
Spoon the cream into a dessert glass and chill for at least 30 minutes.
Peel the orange with a knife, cut out the segments and place them on the cream before serving.

title: Cheesecake quark cream with warm plum compote
instructions: Stir the quark with the lemon juice, lemon zest, vanilla and half of the honey until creamy and spoon into a dessert glass.
Stone and quarter the plums and simmer with 2 tbsp water, the remaining honey and the cinnamon for 5 to 6 minutes until soft.
Spoon the warm compote over the quark cream and serve straight away.

title: Air fryer pear with cinnamon walnut crumble and skyr
instructions: Halve the pear lengthwise and scoop out the core with a spoon.
Mix the oats, chopped walnuts, maple syrup and cinnamon and press into the pear halves.
Bake in the air fryer at 180 degrees for 12 to 14 minutes until the pear is soft and the crumble golden.
Serve with the skyr and dust with a little cinnamon.

title: Air fryer edamame with chilli lime salt
instructions: Thaw the edamame and pat them thoroughly dry.
Toss with the oil and roast in the air fryer at 200 degrees for 12 to 14 minutes until crispy, shaking 2 times.
Mix the lime zest with the sea salt and chilli flakes, sprinkle over the hot edamame and serve with a lime wedge.

title: Mango coconut frozen yoghurt bark with raspberries
instructions: Stir the skyr with the maple syrup and vanilla until smooth and spread about 1 cm thick on a small board lined with baking paper.
Cut the mango into small cubes and scatter over with the raspberries and desiccated coconut, pressing lightly.
Freeze for at least 3 hours, then break into irregular pieces and enjoy straight away.

title: Cottage cheese cherry ice cream with almonds
instructions: Blend the cottage cheese with the maple syrup, vanilla and two thirds of the cherries until very smooth, then roughly chop the remaining cherries and fold them in.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Spoon into a bowl and sprinkle with chopped almonds.

title: Beef burrito bowl with paprika rice and pinto beans
instructions: Bring the rice to the boil with 1 tsp paprika and twice its volume of water and cook covered for 12 minutes.
Fry the beef mince in hot oil until crumbly, season with cumin, paprika, salt and pepper and cook through for 6 to 8 minutes.
Warm the pinto beans and sweetcorn in a small pan and dice the pepper and tomato.
Arrange the rice, mince, beans, sweetcorn and vegetables side by side in a large bowl and sprinkle with grated cheddar and coriander.

title: Salmon with mashed sweet potato and broccoli
instructions: Peel and dice the sweet potato and boil in salted water for 12 to 15 minutes until soft.
Divide the broccoli into florets and steam above the pan for the last 5 minutes.
Salt the salmon and fry in hot oil skin side down for 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side until cooked.
Drain the sweet potato, mash with the warm milk, nutmeg, salt and pepper and serve with the salmon and broccoli.

title: Chicken penne with tomato cottage cheese sauce and spinach
instructions: Cook the penne in salted water until al dente according to the packet instructions.
Salt the chicken breast and fry in half of the oil for 5 to 6 minutes on each side until cooked through, then slice.
Sweat the onion and garlic in the remaining oil, add the passata and oregano and simmer for 5 minutes, then stir in the cottage cheese and blend until smooth.
Let the spinach wilt in the sauce, toss in the penne and serve topped with the chicken and basil.

title: Turkey stroganoff with mushrooms, gherkin and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice in salted water according to the packet instructions for 25 minutes.
Sear the turkey strips in half of the oil for 4 to 5 minutes until cooked through, season with salt and remove.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, stir in the paprika, mustard, soured cream and 50 ml water and bring briefly to the boil.
Fold in the turkey and the gherkin cut into strips, season to taste and serve with the rice and parsley.

title: Beef steak with roast potatoes, herb quark and green beans
instructions: Wash the potatoes, cut into wedges, toss with half of the oil, rosemary, paprika and salt and bake at 220 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes until golden.
Stir the quark with the chopped herbs, salt, pepper and 1 tbsp water until creamy.
Cook the green beans in salted water for 7 to 8 minutes.
Pat the steak dry and fry in the remaining oil for 3 to 4 minutes on each side, rest for 5 minutes, season and serve sliced with the potatoes, beans and quark.

title: Lentil ragout with wholewheat spaghetti, aubergine and feta
instructions: Bring the lentils to the boil with 300 ml water and simmer for 20 minutes until just tender.
Dice the aubergine and fry with the onion and garlic in the oil for 6 to 8 minutes.
Add the passata, lentils and oregano, season with salt and pepper and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Cook the spaghetti according to the packet instructions, top with the ragout and sprinkle with crumbled feta and basil.

title: Tuna steak with wild rice, mango salsa and edamame
instructions: Cook the wild rice in salted water according to the packet for 25 to 30 minutes, adding the edamame for the last 4 minutes.
Finely dice the mango and red onion and mix with the lime juice, half of the oil, chopped coriander, chilli and salt to make the salsa.
Pat the tuna dry, season and sear in the remaining oil for 1 to 2 minutes on each side so it stays pink inside.
Slice the tuna and serve with the wild rice, edamame and mango salsa.

title: Chicken thigh peanut curry with basmati
instructions: Bring the basmati rice to the boil with twice its volume of salted water and cook covered for 12 minutes.
Dice the chicken thighs and brown with the onion in a pan without oil for 5 minutes, then briefly fry the curry paste with them.
Add the coconut milk, peanut butter, 100 ml water and pepper strips and simmer for 10 minutes until the meat is cooked through.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and serve the curry with the rice, chopped peanuts and coriander.

title: Green shakshuka with chickpeas, feta and wholegrain bread
instructions: Dice the zucchini, slice the spring onions into rings and fry both in the oil in a pan for 4 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and cumin, wilt the spinach in batches, and season with salt and pepper.
Make three wells, crack in the 3 eggs and cook covered over low heat for 6 to 8 minutes until the whites are set.
Sprinkle with crumbled feta and chilli flakes and serve with the wholegrain bread.

title: Tempeh peanut bowl with rice and edamame
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet for 25 minutes, adding the edamame for the last 4 minutes.
Cut the tempeh into cubes, mix with half of the tamari and fry in the sesame oil for 6 to 8 minutes until golden.
Stir the peanut butter with the remaining tamari, lime juice, chilli and 2 tbsp warm water into a sauce.
Cut the carrot into fine strips and the cucumber into slices and arrange everything with the rice, tempeh and edamame in a bowl, topped with the sauce and sesame.

title: Chicken bulgur box with peppers, parsley and lemon tahini
instructions: Pour 120 ml boiling salted water over the bulgur and leave covered to swell for 15 minutes.
Season the chicken breast with cumin, paprika and salt, fry in the oil for 5 to 6 minutes on each side until cooked through and slice.
Dice the pepper and cucumber, chop the parsley and mix with the bulgur, then stir the tahini with the lemon juice and 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Take the dressing separately in a small screw-top jar.
Eat cold straight from the container, mixing in the dressing just before eating.

title: Yellow split pea dal with carrots and basmati
instructions: Rinse the split peas and bring to the boil with 400 ml water and the turmeric, then simmer for 35 to 40 minutes until soft.
Fry the onion, garlic and diced carrots in the oil with the cumin and garam masala for 5 minutes, add the passata and coconut milk, stir into the dal and simmer for another 10 minutes.
Bring the basmati rice to the boil with twice its volume of salted water and cook covered for 12 minutes.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.
Sprinkle with fresh coriander before eating.

title: Turkey taco box with rice, sweetcorn and bean salad
instructions: Bring the rice to the boil with twice its volume of salted water and cook covered for 12 minutes.
Fry the turkey mince in the oil until crumbly, season with cumin, chilli, oregano, garlic and salt and cook through for 6 to 8 minutes.
Dice the pepper and tomato and mix with the beans, sweetcorn, lime juice, salt and pepper into a bean salad.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Take the yoghurt separately in a small screw-top jar.
Reheat the rice and turkey in the microwave for 2 minutes until piping hot, eat the bean salad cold alongside and top with the yoghurt.

title: Lentil salad with feta, beetroot and walnuts
instructions: Cook the beluga lentils in plenty of water for 20 to 25 minutes until just tender, drain and let cool.
Whisk the cider vinegar, mustard, oil, thyme, salt and pepper into a dressing and mix it into the lentils.
Dice the beetroot and fold it in, then roughly crumble the feta and walnuts over the top.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Pack the rocket separately and mix it in just before eating, then enjoy cold.

title: Soba noodle salad with salmon, edamame and sesame
instructions: Bake the salmon at 180 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes until cooked, let cool and flake into large pieces.
Cook the soba noodles according to the packet, adding the edamame for the last 3 minutes, then rinse everything under cold water.
Cut the cucumber and carrot into fine strips, stir the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, grated ginger and chilli together and toss with the noodles and vegetables.
Lay the salmon on top and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Eat cold straight from the container.

title: Salmon with spinach cream cheese sauce and zucchini
instructions: Cut the zucchini into half-moons and fry in half of the oil for 6 to 8 minutes until golden, season with salt and keep warm.
Salt the salmon and fry in the remaining oil skin side down for 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side until cooked.
Finely chop the garlic and wilt it with the spinach in the pan, stir in the cream cheese and cream and simmer with nutmeg, lemon zest, salt and pepper for 2 minutes until creamy.
Spoon the sauce onto a plate, place the salmon on top and serve with the zucchini.

title: Chicken thighs with lemon garlic butter and asparagus
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper and lay them skin side down in a cold pan, then fry over medium heat for 12 minutes until crisp.
Turn and fry for another 6 to 8 minutes until the meat is cooked through.
Fry the asparagus in the pan juices next to the meat for 5 to 6 minutes.
Let the butter foam briefly with the chopped garlic, thyme and lemon juice, pour over the meat and asparagus and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Grilled halloumi with zucchini, olives and mint oil
instructions: Slice the zucchini lengthwise, brush with a third of the oil and cook in a grill pan for 2 to 3 minutes on each side.
Cut the halloumi into 4 slices and grill without oil for 2 minutes on each side until golden.
Finely chop the mint and stir with the remaining oil, lemon juice and a pinch of salt into a mint oil.
Arrange the zucchini, halloumi, olives and rocket and drizzle with the mint oil.

title: Beef and broccoli skillet with cheddar and spring onions
instructions: Divide the broccoli into small florets, pre-cook in a little salted water for 3 minutes and drain.
Fry the beef mince in the oil in an ovenproof pan until crumbly, season with paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper and cook through for 6 to 8 minutes.
Fold in the broccoli and cream, scatter the grated cheddar over and let it melt covered for 2 to 3 minutes.
Sprinkle with spring onion rings and serve in the pan.

title: Yellow tofu curry with coconut and cauliflower rice
instructions: Pat the tofu dry, dice it and fry in half of the coconut oil for 8 to 10 minutes until golden all over, then season with salt.
Briefly toast the turmeric, cumin and ginger with it, pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes until thick, then season with the lime juice.
Fry the cauliflower in the remaining coconut oil in a second pan for 4 to 5 minutes and season with salt.
Serve the curry next to the cauliflower rice and sprinkle with coriander.

title: Soy skyr with mango, lime and desiccated coconut
instructions: For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, pea protein and lime juice until smooth.
Dice the mango.
Arrange the mango in a bowl and sprinkle with the desiccated coconut.

title: Soy skyr with cherries, cocoa nibs and vanilla
instructions: Let the cherries thaw.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein and vanilla until smooth.
Arrange the cherries in a bowl and sprinkle with the cocoa nibs.

title: Soy skyr with apple, cinnamon and toasted pumpkin seeds
instructions: Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan for 2 minutes.
Dice the apple.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, pea protein and cinnamon until smooth.
Arrange the apple in a bowl and sprinkle with the pumpkin seeds.

title: Pear and ginger soy skyr with walnuts
instructions: Dice the pear and finely grate the ginger.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein and ginger until smooth.
Arrange the pear in a bowl and sprinkle with the walnuts.

title: Blackberry lemon soy skyr with chia seeds
instructions: Rinse and drain the blackberries.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, pea protein, lemon juice and lemon zest until smooth.
Arrange the blackberries in a bowl and sprinkle with the chia seeds.

title: Peach soy skyr with flaked almonds and cinnamon
instructions: Cut the peach into wedges.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr and soy protein until smooth.
Arrange the peach in a bowl and sprinkle with the flaked almonds and cinnamon.

title: Strawberry basil soy skyr with hemp seeds
instructions: Quarter the strawberries and cut the basil into thin strips.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr and pea protein until smooth.
Arrange the strawberries and basil in a bowl and sprinkle with the hemp seeds.

title: Kiwi matcha soy skyr with pumpkin seeds
instructions: For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein and matcha until smooth.
Peel and slice the kiwi.
Arrange the kiwi in a bowl and sprinkle with the pumpkin seeds.

title: Mexican tofu breakfast plate with bean salsa
instructions: Dice the tomatoes and red onion and finely chop the coriander.
Put the kidney beans, tomatoes, red onion, coriander and lime juice in a bowl and mix well.
Pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the tofu and cumin for 5 minutes stirring.
Arrange the tofu in a plate and sprinkle with the coriander.

title: Tofu scramble with kale, mushrooms and turmeric
instructions: Wash the vegetables, tear the kale into bite-sized pieces and slice the mushrooms.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the mushrooms for 4 minutes until well browned.
Pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Add the tofu, kale and turmeric and fry for another 4 minutes until cooked through.
Sprinkle with the nutritional yeast and serve straight away.

title: Tofu scramble with courgette, dill and spring onions
instructions: Wash the vegetables, dice the courgette and slice the spring onions into thin rings.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the courgette and spring onions for 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Add the tofu, nutritional yeast and turmeric and fry for another 3 minutes until cooked through.
Sprinkle with the dill and serve straight away.

title: Tofu scramble with asparagus and lemon
instructions: Wash the vegetables and cut the green asparagus into rough pieces.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the green asparagus for 5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Add the tofu, nutritional yeast and turmeric and fry for another 3 minutes until cooked through.
Season with the lemon juice and chervil, salt and pepper.

title: Tofu scramble with okra, tomato and cumin
instructions: Wash the vegetables, slice the okra and dice the tomatoes and onion.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the onion, okra and cumin for 5 minutes stirring.
Pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Add the tofu, tomatoes and turmeric and fry for another 4 minutes until cooked through.
Sprinkle with the nutritional yeast and serve straight away.

title: Tofu scramble with chard and garlic on sweet potato slices
instructions: Wash the vegetables, slice the sweet potato, cut the chard into strips and finely chop the garlic.
Cook the sweet potato in the air fryer at 200 °C for 10 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
Pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Dry-fry the tofu, chard, garlic, nutritional yeast and turmeric in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes stirring.
Arrange the sweet potato and tofu in a plate.

title: Tofu scramble tacos with red cabbage and lime
instructions: Cut the red cabbage into thin strips and finely chop the coriander.
Toss the red cabbage with the lime juice and leave to marinate for 5 minutes.
Pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Dry-fry the tofu, nutritional yeast, turmeric and cumin in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes stirring.
Fill the corn tortilla with the tofu, red cabbage and coriander.

title: Savoury lupin and tofu breakfast pan with peppers
instructions: Wash the vegetables, dice the red pepper and yellow pepper and slice the spring onions into thin rings.
Rinse and drain the lupins and pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the tofu for 6 minutes until golden all over.
Add the lupins, red pepper, yellow pepper and paprika and fry for another 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Sprinkle with the spring onions and serve straight away.

title: Smoked tofu breakfast salad with cucumber and radishes
instructions: Wash the vegetables, thinly slice the cucumber and radishes, tear the romaine lettuce into bite-sized pieces and dice the smoked tofu.
Blanch the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Put the smoked tofu, edamame, cucumber, radishes, romaine lettuce and lemon juice in a bowl and mix well.
Season with salt and pepper.

title: Pea protein porridge with rhubarb strawberry compote
instructions: Wash the fruit and chop the rhubarb and strawberries.
Add the rhubarb and strawberries to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the gluten-free oats, soy drink, water and vanilla to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 4 minutes.
Stir in the pea protein.
Arrange everything in a bowl and sprinkle with the rhubarb and strawberries.

title: Gingerbread spice porridge with soy protein and pear
instructions: Add the gluten-free oats, soy drink, water and gingerbread spice to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 4 minutes.
Stir in the soy protein.
Cut the pear into thin strips.
Arrange everything in a bowl and sprinkle with the pear.

title: Savoury porridge with spinach, tofu and spring onions
instructions: Dice the tofu and slice the spring onions into thin rings.
Add the gluten-free oats and vegetable stock to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, baby spinach and nutritional yeast and simmer for another 2 minutes until cooked through.
Season with the tamari, salt and pepper.
Sprinkle with the spring onions and serve straight away.

title: Overnight oats with soy yoghurt, sour cherries and pea protein
instructions: Put the gluten-free oats, soy yoghurt, soy drink, pea protein and cinnamon in a screw-top jar and mix well.
Seal the jar and refrigerate overnight, for at least 6 hours.
In the morning top with the sour cherries.

title: Overnight buckwheat with pineapple and soy protein
instructions: Soak the buckwheat in water overnight, then rinse and drain in the morning.
Blend the buckwheat, soy yoghurt, soy drink and soy protein in a blender for 30 seconds until creamy.
Dice the pineapple.
Arrange everything in a screw-top jar and sprinkle with the pineapple.

title: Protein chia pudding with blueberries and lemon
instructions: Put the soy drink, pea protein and lemon zest in a screw-top jar and mix well.
Stir in the chia seeds and leave for 10 minutes.
Seal the jar and refrigerate overnight, for at least 6 hours.
Arrange the blueberries in a screw-top jar.

title: Chocolate chia pudding with soy protein and orange
instructions: Put the soy drink, soy protein and cocoa in a screw-top jar and mix well.
Stir in the chia seeds and leave for 10 minutes.
Seal the jar and refrigerate overnight, for at least 6 hours.
Peel and slice the orange.
Arrange the orange in a screw-top jar.

title: Buckwheat protein pancakes with blueberries
instructions: Whisk the buckwheat flour, pea protein, soy drink and baking powder into a smooth batter and leave to rest for 5 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan with a little oil and cook 4 small pancakes from the batter for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Stack the pancakes and serve with the soy skyr and blueberries.

title: Chickpea pancakes with spinach and tofu herb cream
instructions: Whisk the chickpea flour, water and turmeric into a smooth batter and leave to rest for 5 minutes.
Roughly chop the baby spinach.
Stir the spinach into the batter and cook 2 thin pancakes in a non-stick pan with the oil for 2 minutes per side.
For the cream, blend the silken tofu, pea protein and chives until smooth.
Arrange everything in a plate, drizzle with the cream.

title: Chickpea flour protein waffles with berries
instructions: Whisk the chickpea flour, soy protein, soy drink, baking powder and vanilla into a smooth batter and leave to rest for 5 minutes.
Preheat the waffle iron and cook 2 waffles from the batter for 4 minutes each until golden.
Serve the waffles with the soy skyr and berries.

title: Green protein smoothie bowl with kale, pear and hemp
instructions: Wash the vegetables and fruit, cut the pear into rough pieces and tear the kale into bite-sized pieces.
Blend all the ingredients except the hemp seeds in a blender for 60 seconds until creamy.
Arrange everything in a bowl and sprinkle with the hemp seeds.

title: Pink raspberry beetroot smoothie bowl with soy protein
instructions: Dice the beetroot.
Blend the soy skyr, soy protein, raspberries, frozen banana and beetroot in a blender for 60 seconds until creamy.
Arrange everything in a bowl and sprinkle with the raspberries and desiccated coconut.

title: Chocolate cherry smoothie bowl with pea protein
instructions: Cut the frozen banana into rough pieces.
Blend all the ingredients except the cocoa nibs in a blender for 60 seconds until creamy.
Arrange everything in a bowl and sprinkle with the cocoa nibs.

title: Mango carrot smoothie bowl with soy protein and turmeric
instructions: Cut the carrots into rough pieces.
Blend all the ingredients except the pumpkin seeds in a blender for 60 seconds until creamy.
Arrange everything in a bowl and sprinkle with the pumpkin seeds.

title: Blueberry courgette smoothie bowl with soy protein
instructions: Cut the courgette into rough pieces.
Blend all the ingredients except the flaked almonds in a blender for 60 seconds until creamy.
Arrange everything in a bowl and sprinkle with the flaked almonds.

title: Tofu and lupin breakfast wrap with corn tortilla, avocado and salsa
instructions: Dice the cherry tomatoes, finely chop the coriander and slice the avocado.
Pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers and rinse and drain the lupins.
Dry-fry the tofu, lupins, cumin and chilli in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes stirring.
Fill the corn tortilla with the tofu, lupins, avocado, cherry tomatoes and coriander.

title: Tempeh breakfast pan with mushrooms and spinach
instructions: Thinly slice the tempeh, dice the tofu and slice the mushrooms.
Dry-fry the tempeh, tofu and paprika in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until golden all over.
Add the mushrooms and fry for another 4 minutes until well browned.
Add the leaf spinach and fry for another 2 minutes until soft.
Season with the tamari, salt and pepper.

title: Lupin spread on gluten-free bread with tomato
instructions: Rinse and drain the lupins.
For the dip, blend the lupins, pea protein, lemon juice and garlic with 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Slice the tomatoes.
Spread the gluten-free bread with the lupins.
Top with the tomato slices and sprinkle with cress.

title: Edamame avocado mash on rice cakes with sesame
instructions: Blanch the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Roughly mash the edamame, avocado, soy protein and lime juice with a fork.
Thinly slice the radishes.
Spread the rice cakes with the edamame.
Sprinkle with the radishes and sesame seeds and serve straight away.

title: Green tofu shakshuka with spinach and harissa
instructions: Dice the onion.
Sweat the onion and cumin in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the chopped tomatoes, harissa and baby spinach to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
Pat the tofu dry and cut into 1 cm thick slices.
Lay the tofu in the sauce, leave covered for 5 minutes and sprinkle with the nutritional yeast.

title: Baked tofu breakfast muffins with broccoli
instructions: Wash the vegetables, chop the broccoli and slice the spring onions into thin rings.
Blend the tofu, chickpea flour, nutritional yeast, turmeric and baking powder in a blender for 30 seconds until creamy.
Stir in the broccoli and spring onions.
Spoon the mixture into 6 muffin cases and bake in the preheated oven at 190 °C for 22 minutes until set.

title: Soy mince breakfast hash with peppers and potato cubes
instructions: Pour the vegetable stock over the soy mince, leave to soak for 10 minutes and squeeze out well.
Wash the vegetables and dice the potatoes, red pepper and onion.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the potatoes for 8 minutes until golden all over.
Add the soy mince, red pepper, onion and paprika and fry for another 6 minutes until cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper.

title: Matcha protein pancakes with kiwi and soy skyr
instructions: Blend the gluten-free oats, soy protein, soy drink, matcha and baking powder in a blender for 30 seconds until creamy.
Heat a non-stick pan with a little oil and cook 4 small pancakes from the batter for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Peel and slice the kiwi.
Serve the pancakes with the soy skyr and kiwi slices.

title: Apple cinnamon millet porridge with soy protein
instructions: Dice the apple.
Add the millet, soy drink, water, apple and cinnamon to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Stir in the soy protein.
Arrange everything in a bowl and sprinkle with the walnuts.

title: Quinoa breakfast bowl with tofu, lupins and cherry tomatoes
instructions: Rinse the quinoa in a sieve and cook in twice the volume of lightly salted water for 12 minutes.
Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, halve the cherry tomatoes and rinse and drain the lupins.
Dry-fry the tofu, lupins and paprika in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until golden all over.
Arrange the quinoa, tofu, lupins, cherry tomatoes and rocket in a bowl.
Season with the lemon juice, salt and pepper.

title: Silken tofu vanilla pudding with pea protein and figs
instructions: Blend the silken tofu, pea protein, maple syrup and vanilla in a blender for 30 seconds until creamy.
Cover and chill in the fridge for at least 20 minutes.
Quarter the figs.
Arrange everything in a dessert glass and sprinkle with the figs.

title: Breakfast tofu skewers with melon and mint
instructions: Cut the smoked tofu and honeydew melon into 2 cm cubes and finely chop the mint.
Thread the smoked tofu and honeydew melon alternately onto 4 skewers.
For the dip, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein, mint and lime juice until smooth.
Arrange everything in a plate, drizzle with the dip.

title: Ginger rice congee with tofu, edamame and pak choi
instructions: Cut the ginger into thin strips, dice the tofu, cut the pak choi into strips and slice the spring onions into thin rings.
Add the basmati rice, vegetable stock and ginger to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 25 minutes until soft.
Add the tofu, edamame, pak choi and nutritional yeast and simmer for another 4 minutes until cooked through.
Season with the tamari, salt and pepper.
Sprinkle with the spring onions and serve straight away.

title: Peach vanilla protein shake with gluten-free oats
instructions: Wash the fruit and stone and chop the peach.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Espresso banana protein shake with dates
instructions: Cut the banana into rough pieces and chop the dates.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass, sprinkle with the cinnamon and enjoy straight away.

title: Matcha spinach protein shake with soy skyr and banana
instructions: Cut the banana into rough pieces.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 60 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Raspberry silken tofu shake with vanilla
instructions: Rinse and drain the silken tofu.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 60 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Mango lassi protein shake with cardamom
instructions: Peel and dice the mango.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass, sprinkle with the cardamom and enjoy straight away.

title: Black Forest cherry cocoa shake with soy protein
instructions: Let the cherries thaw.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Pineapple coconut protein shake with lime
instructions: Cut the pineapple into rough pieces.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass, sprinkle with the desiccated coconut and enjoy straight away.

title: Cucumber apple mint protein shake with soy skyr
instructions: Wash the vegetables and fruit and cut the cucumber and apple into rough pieces.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 60 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Carrot orange ginger protein shake
instructions: Cut the carrots into rough pieces, peel and dice the orange and finely grate the ginger.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 60 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Beetroot sour cherry shake with pea protein and ginger
instructions: Cut the beetroot into rough pieces and finely grate the ginger.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 60 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Pumpkin spice protein shake with soy protein
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 45 seconds until creamy.
Taste and thin with a little cold water if needed.
Pour into a glass, sprinkle with the cinnamon and enjoy straight away.

title: Blueberry lemon protein shake with silken tofu
instructions: Rinse and drain the silken tofu.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 60 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Peanut banana cocoa shake with pea protein
instructions: Cut the banana into rough pieces.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Kiwi spinach pear protein shake with linseed
instructions: Wash the vegetables and fruit, peel and slice the kiwi and cut the pear into rough pieces.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 60 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Apricot almond protein shake
instructions: Wash the fruit and stone and chop the apricots.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Plum cinnamon shake with soy skyr and pea protein
instructions: Wash the fruit and stone and chop the plums.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass, sprinkle with the cinnamon and enjoy straight away.

title: Watermelon strawberry lime shake with soy skyr
instructions: Wash the fruit, cut the watermelon into rough pieces and halve the strawberries.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Chocolate mint avocado protein shake with spinach
instructions: Cut the avocado into rough pieces.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 60 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Chai protein shake with soy drink and dates
instructions: Chop the dates.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 60 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass, sprinkle with the cinnamon and enjoy straight away.

title: Green tea mango protein shake with soy skyr
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 45 seconds until creamy.
Taste and thin with a little cold water if needed.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Papaya lime protein shake with soy protein
instructions: Peel and dice the papaya.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Blackberry hemp protein shake with banana
instructions: Cut the banana into rough pieces.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 60 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Redcurrant vanilla shake with silken tofu
instructions: Rinse and drain the redcurrants.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 60 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Fig walnut protein shake with cinnamon
instructions: Quarter the figs.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 60 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Savoury tomato cucumber protein smoothie with pepper
instructions: Wash the vegetables and cut the tomatoes, cucumber and red pepper into rough pieces.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 60 seconds until creamy.
Season with the lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Pour into a glass and enjoy straight away.

title: Chocolate strawberry protein nice cream with soy skyr
instructions: Let the frozen fruit soften for 5 minutes.
Blend with the remaining ingredients in a food processor for 1 to 2 minutes until creamy, scraping down in between.
Spoon into a bowl straight away or freeze for another 30 minutes for a firmer texture.
Sprinkle with the cocoa nibs.

title: Strawberry protein ice lollies with soy skyr
instructions: Wash the fruit and halve the strawberries.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 30 seconds until creamy.
Pour the mixture into 2 ice lolly moulds, insert the sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours.
Briefly hold the moulds under warm water and release the lollies.

title: Mango passion fruit protein sorbet with silken tofu
instructions: Let the frozen fruit soften for 5 minutes.
Blend with the remaining ingredients in a food processor for 1 to 2 minutes until creamy, scraping down in between.
Spoon into a bowl straight away or freeze for another 30 minutes for a firmer texture.
Drizzle with the passion fruit pulp.

title: Matcha pistachio protein ice cream
instructions: Blend all the ingredients except the pistachios in a blender for 30 seconds until creamy.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Sprinkle with the pistachios and serve straight away.

title: Cherry chocolate frozen yoghurt bark with soy skyr
instructions: For the cream, stir together the soy skyr and pea protein until smooth.
Spread the cream 1 cm thick on a board lined with baking paper and scatter the cherries and chopped chocolate over it.
Freeze for at least 3 hours and break into pieces.

title: Blueberry frozen yoghurt with soy protein
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 30 seconds until creamy.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.

title: Espresso granita with soy skyr topping
instructions: Stir the espresso, water and maple syrup together, pour into a shallow dish and freeze for 3 hours, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein and vanilla until smooth.
Layer the espresso and soy skyr in a dessert glass one after the other.

title: Pineapple mint ice lollies with pea protein
instructions: Cut the pineapple into rough pieces.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 30 seconds until creamy.
Pour the mixture into 2 ice lolly moulds, insert the sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours.
Briefly hold the moulds under warm water and release the lollies.

title: Raspberry peach nice cream with silken tofu and coconut
instructions: Cut the fruit into pieces and freeze for at least 4 hours.
Blend with the remaining ingredients in a food processor for 1 to 2 minutes until creamy, scraping down in between.
Spoon into a bowl straight away or freeze for another 30 minutes for a firmer texture.
Sprinkle with the desiccated coconut.

title: Peanut espresso protein ice cream with banana and soy skyr
instructions: Let the frozen fruit soften for 5 minutes.
Blend with the remaining ingredients in a food processor for 1 to 2 minutes until creamy, scraping down in between.
Spoon into a bowl straight away or freeze for another 30 minutes for a firmer texture.

title: Coconut panna cotta with soy protein, agar and mango coulis
instructions: Whisk the agar into the soy drink, coconut milk and maple syrup in a small pan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring.
Stir in the soy protein.
Pour into a glass, cover and leave to set in the fridge for at least 2 hours.
Peel and dice the mango.
Purée the mango finely and spoon it over the panna cotta.

title: Apple cinnamon compote with vanilla soy skyr and flaked almonds
instructions: Peel and dice the apple.
Stew the apple with the lemon juice, 3 tbsp water and the cinnamon, covered, for 6 minutes until soft.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein and vanilla until smooth.
Layer the soy skyr and apple in a dessert glass one after the other.
Sprinkle with the flaked almonds.

title: Rhubarb crumble cream with soy skyr and oat crunch
instructions: Chop the rhubarb.
Simmer the rhubarb with half of the maple syrup for 6 minutes until soft and let it cool.
Toast the gluten-free oats and cinnamon in a dry pan for 3 minutes.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, pea protein and maple syrup until smooth.
Layer the rhubarb, soy skyr and gluten-free oats in a dessert glass one after the other.

title: Red berry pudding with agar and vanilla soy cream
instructions: Wash the fruit and quarter the strawberries.
Bring the agar to the boil with 100 ml water, simmer for 2 minutes and fold in the berries.
Cover and chill in the fridge for at least 60 minutes.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein and vanilla until smooth.
Arrange everything in a dessert glass, drizzle with the cream.

title: Matcha almond panna cotta with soy protein and strawberries
instructions: Whisk the agar into the almond drink, coconut milk and maple syrup in a small pan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring.
Stir in the soy protein and matcha.
Cover and leave to set in the fridge for at least 2 hours.
Quarter the strawberries.
Arrange the strawberries in a dessert glass.

title: Peanut puffed quinoa protein bars with dates
instructions: Finely chop the dates.
Put the pea protein, peanut butter, dates and water in a bowl and mix well.
Stir in the puffed quinoa.
Press the mixture into a small dish lined with baking paper, chill for 1 hour and cut into 2 bars.

title: Coconut almond protein balls with dates
instructions: Finely chop the dates and almonds.
Put the soy protein, dates, almonds and soy drink in a bowl and mix well.
With damp hands shape the mixture into 5 balls.
Roll the balls in the desiccated coconut and chill for 30 minutes.

title: Gingerbread protein balls with hazelnuts and cocoa
instructions: Finely chop the dates and hazelnuts.
Put the pea protein, dates, hazelnuts, apple purée and gingerbread spice in a bowl and mix well.
With damp hands shape the mixture into 5 balls.
Roll the balls in the cocoa and chill for 30 minutes.

title: Baked apple with soy skyr cinnamon filling
instructions: Wash the apple, cut off a lid and generously hollow out the core.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein, maple syrup and cinnamon until smooth.
Bake the apple in the preheated oven at 180 °C for 25 minutes, then fill it with the cream.
Sprinkle with the walnuts and serve straight away.

title: Poached pear with chocolate silken tofu mousse
instructions: Peel and slice the pear.
Poach the pear in a little water with the vanilla and cinnamon for 8 minutes until soft.
Blend the silken tofu, soy protein, cocoa and dates in a blender for 45 seconds until creamy.
Arrange the pear and silken tofu in a plate.

title: Amaranth coconut pudding with soy protein and pineapple
instructions: Add the amaranth, soy drink, coconut milk and vanilla to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 25 minutes until soft.
Stir in the soy protein.
Dice the pineapple.
Arrange everything in a bowl and sprinkle with the pineapple.

title: Protein rice pudding with soy drink and cherry compote
