instructions: Add the short-grain rice, soy drink and vanilla to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 25 minutes until soft.
Stir in the soy protein.
Simmer the cherries with 2 tbsp water for 3 minutes to a compote.
Arrange everything in a bowl and sprinkle with the cherries and cinnamon.

title: Black bean brownies with soy protein
instructions: Rinse and drain the black beans.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for 60 seconds until creamy.
Put everything into a small baking dish and bake in the preheated oven at 180 °C for 22 minutes.
Let cool and cut into 4 pieces.

title: Pumpkin protein muffins with chickpea flour and cinnamon
instructions: Put the pumpkin purée, chickpea flour, soy protein, apple purée, cinnamon and baking powder in a bowl and mix well.
Spoon the mixture into 6 muffin cases and bake in the preheated oven at 180 °C for 22 minutes until set.
Sprinkle with the pumpkin seeds.

title: Banana walnut microwave mug cake with soy protein
instructions: Roughly mash the banana with a fork.
Stir in the gluten-free oats, soy protein, soy drink, baking powder and cinnamon.
Pour the batter into a large mug, sprinkle with the chopped walnuts and cook in the microwave for 2 minutes.
Leave to rest for 1 minute and enjoy warm.

title: Chocolate mug cake with chickpea flour and raspberries
instructions: Put the chickpea flour, soy protein, cocoa, apple purée, soy drink and baking powder in a bowl and mix well.
Pour into a large mug and cook in the microwave for 90 seconds.
Sprinkle with the raspberries and serve straight away.

title: Peach raspberry trifle with soy skyr and puffed quinoa
instructions: Wash the fruit and dice the peach.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr and pea protein until smooth.
Layer the puffed quinoa, soy skyr, peach and raspberries in a dessert glass one after the other.
Cover and chill in the fridge for at least 15 minutes.

title: Poppy seed soy skyr cream with sour cherries and pistachios
instructions: Let the sour cherries thaw.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein and poppy seeds until smooth.
Layer the soy skyr and sour cherries in a dessert glass one after the other.
Sprinkle with the pistachios and serve straight away.

title: Peanut chocolate pudding with banana and soy protein
instructions: Stir the cornflour and cocoa with 4 tbsp of the soy drink until smooth and bring the rest of the soy drink to the boil.
Stir in the cornflour mixture and simmer for 1 minute, stirring, then remove from the heat and stir in the soy protein.
Cover and chill in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Slice the banana.
Top with the banana slices and drizzle with the peanut butter.

title: Vanilla pudding with pea protein and warm berry compote
instructions: Stir the cornflour with 4 tbsp of the soy drink until smooth and bring the rest of the soy drink to the boil with the vanilla.
Stir in the cornflour mixture, simmer for 1 minute and remove from the heat, then stir in the pea protein.
Warm the berries for 3 minutes and spoon them onto the pudding.

title: Mango sticky rice with coconut and soy protein
instructions: Soak the glutinous rice for 1 hour, drain and steam for 20 minutes.
Warm the coconut milk and soy drink in a small pan for 3 minutes without boiling.
Stir in the soy protein.
Peel and slice the mango.
Arrange the glutinous rice and mango in a plate, drizzle with the sauce and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.

title: Matcha cashew protein balls with coconut
instructions: Finely chop the cashews and dates.
Put the pea protein, cashews, dates, matcha and soy drink in a bowl and mix well.
With damp hands shape the mixture into 5 balls.
Roll the balls in the desiccated coconut and chill for 30 minutes.

title: Frozen blueberry coconut drops with soy skyr and lime
instructions: For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein, lime juice and desiccated coconut until smooth.
Place 1 blueberry with 1 tsp of the cream at a time on a board lined with baking paper until everything is used up.
Freeze for at least 2 hours and enjoy frozen.

title: Chocolate strawberries with soy skyr protein dip
instructions: Rinse and drain the strawberries.
Melt the chocolate, dip the strawberries halfway in and leave to set on baking paper.
For the dip, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein and vanilla until smooth.
Arrange the strawberries in a plate, drizzle with the dip.

title: Apple nachos with peanut protein drizzle and cocoa nibs
instructions: Thinly slice the apple.
For the sauce, stir together the peanut butter, pea protein and soy skyr with 3 tbsp water until smooth.
Arrange the apple in a plate, drizzle with the sauce and sprinkle with the cocoa nibs and cinnamon.

title: Baked pear with vanilla protein cream and walnuts
instructions: Halve the pear and roughly chop the walnuts.
Preheat the oven to 190 °C conventional, spread the pear on a lined baking tray and roast until soft for 20 minutes.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, pea protein, maple syrup and vanilla until smooth.
Arrange the pear in a plate, drizzle with the cream and sprinkle with the walnuts.

title: Grilled pineapple with lime soy skyr and mint
instructions: Slice the pineapple.
Dry-fry the pineapple in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes until golden all over.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein, lime juice and lime zest until smooth.
Arrange the pineapple in a plate, drizzle with the cream and sprinkle with the mint.

title: Roasted plums with cinnamon soy skyr and oat crunch
instructions: Halve the plums.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C conventional, spread the plums and cinnamon on a lined baking tray and roast until soft for 15 minutes.
Toast the gluten-free oats in a dry pan for 3 minutes.
Arrange the soy skyr and plums in a dessert glass and sprinkle with the gluten-free oats.

title: Cherry clafoutis with silken tofu and chickpea flour
instructions: Blend the silken tofu, chickpea flour, soy protein, maple syrup, vanilla and baking powder in a blender for 30 seconds until creamy.
Put the cherries in a small baking dish and pour the batter over them.
Bake in the preheated oven at 180 °C for 30 minutes.
Serve lukewarm.

title: Chocolate avocado mousse with soy protein and orange
instructions: Blend the avocado, cocoa, soy protein, soy drink and maple syrup in a blender for 60 seconds until creamy.
Cover and chill in the fridge for at least 20 minutes.
Peel and slice the orange.
Arrange everything in a dessert glass and sprinkle with the orange and orange zest.

title: Espresso vanilla pudding with soy protein
instructions: Stir the cornflour with the espresso until smooth and bring the soy drink to the boil with the maple syrup and vanilla.
Stir in the espresso mixture, simmer for 1 minute and remove from the heat, then stir in the soy protein.
Cover and chill in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with the cocoa and serve straight away.

title: Hazelnut cocoa cream with silken tofu and strawberries
instructions: Toast the hazelnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes.
Blend the silken tofu, soy protein, cocoa, hazelnuts and maple syrup in a blender for 60 seconds until creamy.
Halve the strawberries.
Arrange everything in a dessert glass and sprinkle with the strawberries.

title: Pomegranate pistachio cream with soy skyr
instructions: For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, pea protein, maple syrup and rose water until smooth.
Roughly chop the pistachios.
Arrange everything in a dessert glass and sprinkle with the pomegranate seeds and pistachios.

title: Blueberry agar jelly with vanilla soy skyr
instructions: Bring the blueberries to the boil with 120 ml water, the maple syrup and the agar and simmer for 2 minutes.
Pour into a glass and leave to set in the fridge for 1 hour.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein and vanilla until smooth.
Layer the blueberries and soy skyr in a dessert glass one after the other.

title: Mandarin coconut cream with soy skyr and puffed quinoa
instructions: Peel the mandarins and separate them into segments.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein and desiccated coconut until smooth.
Layer the soy skyr, mandarins and puffed quinoa in a dessert glass one after the other.

title: Lemon silken tofu cream with blueberries and almonds
instructions: Blend the silken tofu, pea protein, lemon juice, maple syrup and lemon zest in a blender for 45 seconds until creamy.
Cover and chill in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Roughly chop the almonds.
Arrange everything in a dessert glass and sprinkle with the blueberries and almonds.

title: Carrot cake protein cream with walnuts
instructions: Finely grate the carrots and roughly chop the walnuts and dates.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein, carrots, dates and cinnamon until smooth.
Arrange everything in a dessert glass and sprinkle with the walnuts and cinnamon.

title: Chocolate protein crêpe with banana slices
instructions: Whisk the buckwheat flour, soy protein, cocoa, soy drink and vanilla into a smooth batter and leave to rest for 5 minutes.
Cook 2 thin crêpes in a dry non-stick pan for 1 minute per side.
Slice the banana.
Spread the crêpes with the soy skyr, top with the banana slices and fold.

title: Persimmon cinnamon cup with soy skyr and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Dice the persimmon.
For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, soy protein and cinnamon until smooth.
Layer the soy skyr and persimmon in a dessert glass one after the other.
Sprinkle with the pumpkin seeds and serve straight away.

title: Apple cranberry porridge bake with soy protein
instructions: Dice the apple.
Put the gluten-free oats, soy drink, soy protein, apple, cranberries, cinnamon and baking powder in a bowl and mix well.
Put everything into a small baking dish and bake in the preheated oven at 180 °C for 25 minutes.
Let cool briefly and serve warm.

title: Coconut lime protein pudding with chia and kiwi
instructions: For the cream, stir together the soy skyr, coconut milk, soy protein and lime juice until smooth.
Stir in the chia seeds and leave for 15 minutes.
Peel and slice the kiwi.
Arrange everything in a dessert glass and sprinkle with the kiwi.

title: Air fryer tofu nuggets with chickpea flour crust and ajvar dip
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into finger-thick sticks.
Toss the tofu with the tamari and leave to marinate for 10 minutes.
Coat the tofu all over in the chickpea flour, paprika and garlic powder.
Cook the tofu in the air fryer at 200 °C for 14 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
For the dip, stir together the soy skyr and ajvar until smooth.
Arrange the tofu in a plate, drizzle with the dip.

title: Air fryer edamame lupin snack mix with smoked paprika
instructions: Let the edamame thaw and rinse and drain the lupins.
Put the edamame, lupins, rapeseed oil and paprika in a bowl and mix well.
Cook the edamame and lupins in the air fryer at 190 °C for 15 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
Add the pumpkin seeds, roast for 2 more minutes and season with salt.

title: Air fryer sesame tofu sticks with sriracha soy skyr
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into finger-thick sticks.
Toss the tofu with the tamari and leave to marinate for 10 minutes.
Coat the tofu all over in the cornflour and sesame seeds.
Cook the tofu in the air fryer at 200 °C for 14 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
For the dip, stir together the soy skyr and sriracha until smooth.
Arrange the tofu in a plate, drizzle with the dip.

title: Stuffed mushrooms with soy mince herb filling
instructions: Pour the vegetable stock over the soy mince, leave to soak for 10 minutes and squeeze out well.
Twist out the mushroom stalks and chop them finely, dice the onion and crumble the tofu.
Dry-fry the soy mince, tofu, onion, tomato purée and thyme in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until crumbly.
Fill the mushrooms with the soy mince, tofu, nutritional yeast and parsley.
Cook the mushrooms in the air fryer at 180 °C for 10 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.

title: Mini peppers filled with lupin hummus
instructions: Rinse and drain the lupins and halve the red pepper.
For the dip, blend the lupins, lemon juice, garlic, nutritional yeast and cumin with 3 tbsp water until smooth.
Fill the red pepper with the lupins.
Sprinkle with the cumin and serve straight away.

title: Edamame hummus with kohlrabi, cucumber and carrot sticks
instructions: Blanch the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes and refresh in cold water.
For the dip, blend the edamame, pea protein, lemon juice, garlic and cumin with 4 tbsp water until smooth.
Wash the vegetables and cut the kohlrabi, cucumber and carrots into sticks.
Arrange the kohlrabi, cucumber and carrots in a plate, drizzle with the dip.

title: Rice paper rolls with tempeh, cucumber, red cabbage and lime dip
instructions: Cut the tempeh into strips and cut the cucumber and red cabbage into thin strips.
Dry-fry the tempeh in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until golden all over.
Dip the rice paper sheets one at a time briefly in warm water, fill and roll up tightly.
For the dip, stir together the soy skyr, pea protein, tamari and lime juice until smooth.
Arrange everything in a plate, drizzle with the dip.

title: Nori wraps with tofu, edamame, cucumber and avocado
instructions: Cut the tofu into strips, cut the cucumber into sticks and slice the avocado.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until golden all over.
Blanch the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Fill the nori sheets, roll up tightly and cut diagonally in half, serve with the tamari and rice vinegar.

title: Iceberg lettuce tacos with chilli soy mince and sweetcorn
instructions: Pour the vegetable stock over the soy mince, leave to soak for 10 minutes and squeeze out well.
Dry-fry the soy mince, tomato purée, chilli and cumin in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until crumbly.
Separate the iceberg lettuce into single leaves and dice the tomatoes.
Fill the iceberg lettuce with the soy mince, sweetcorn and tomatoes.
Season with the lime juice, salt and pepper.

title: Air fryer tofu tikka skewers with cucumber mint raita
instructions: Cut the tofu and red onion into 2 cm cubes.
Toss the tofu with the soy yoghurt, lemon juice and garam masala and leave to marinate for 15 minutes.
Thread the tofu and red onion alternately onto 4 skewers.
Cook the tofu in the air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
Grate the cucumber, squeeze it out and stir with the remaining soy yoghurt and chopped mint to make raita.

title: Air fryer lupin falafel with herb soy yoghurt
instructions: Finely chop the onion and parsley.
Blend the chickpeas, lupin grits, pea protein, onion, parsley and cumin in a blender for 30 seconds until creamy.
With damp hands shape the mixture into 8 falafel.
Brush the falafel thinly with olive oil and cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for 14 minutes until crisp, turning once.
For the dip, stir together the soy yoghurt, lemon juice and parsley until smooth.

title: Air fryer cauliflower wings with chickpea flour and garlic dip
instructions: Cut the cauliflower into small florets.
Whisk the chickpea flour, pea protein and paprika into a smooth batter and leave to rest for 2 minutes.
Coat the cauliflower all over in the chickpea flour.
Cook the cauliflower in the air fryer at 200 °C for 16 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
For the dip, stir together the soy skyr and garlic until smooth.
Drizzle the wings with the sriracha and serve with the dip.

title: Air fryer courgette tofu fritters with dill dip
instructions: Wash the vegetables and coarsely grate the courgette.
Salt the courgette, leave for 10 minutes and squeeze out firmly.
Mix the courgette with the crumbled tofu, chickpea flour and half of the dill and shape 6 flat fritters.
Cook the fritters in the air fryer at 200 °C for 15 minutes until golden, turning halfway.
For the dip, stir together the soy skyr, lemon juice and dill until smooth.

title: Warm garlic chilli edamame with lime and sea salt
instructions: Cook the edamame in boiling water for 4 minutes and drain.
Finely chop the garlic and slice the red chilli into thin rings.
Heat the oil in a wok and fry the garlic, red chilli and edamame for 2 minutes stirring.
Season with the lime juice and sea salt, salt and pepper.

title: Teriyaki tofu skewers with pepper, spring onions and sesame
instructions: Cut the tofu and red pepper into 2 cm cubes and cut the spring onions into rough pieces.
Thread the tofu, spring onions and red pepper alternately onto 4 skewers.
For the sauce, stir together the tamari, maple syrup, ginger and cornflour with 3 tbsp water until smooth.
Fry the skewers in a dry non-stick pan for 8 minutes all round, add the sauce and glaze for 1 minute.
Sprinkle with the sesame seeds and serve straight away.

title: Cucumber rolls with smoked tofu herb cream
instructions: Use a vegetable peeler to cut the cucumber lengthways into 10 thin strips.
For the cream, blend the smoked tofu, silken tofu, soy protein, lemon juice and chives until smooth.
Spread the cucumber strips with the cream and roll them up.
Sprinkle with the chives and serve straight away.

title: Air fryer mushroom tofu patties with mustard dip
instructions: Finely chop the mushrooms and onion.
Dry-fry the mushrooms and onion in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes until well browned.
Crumble the tofu, knead it with the mushrooms, dry soy mince and marjoram and shape 5 patties.
Cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for 14 minutes until golden, turning once.
For the dip, stir together the soy skyr and mustard until smooth.

title: Tofu ceviche with mango, lime, coriander and red onion
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, dice the mango and red onion and finely chop the coriander and green chilli.
Toss the tofu with the lime juice, red onion and green chilli and leave to marinate for 10 minutes.
Put the tofu, edamame, mango and coriander in a bowl and mix well.
Season with salt and pepper.

title: Smoky baked soy chunk bites with cucumber
instructions: Pour the vegetable stock over the soy chunks, leave to soak for 15 minutes and squeeze out well.
Toss the soy chunks with the tamari, tomato purée, maple syrup and paprika and leave to marinate for 10 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C conventional, spread the soy chunks on a lined baking tray and roast for 20 minutes.
Cut the cucumber into sticks.
Arrange the soy chunks and cucumber in a plate.

title: Cabbage tofu okonomiyaki with chickpea flour
instructions: Cut the white cabbage into thin strips, slice the spring onions into thin rings and pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Stir the chickpea flour with 70 ml water until smooth and mix in the cabbage, tofu, dry soy mince and half of the spring onions.
Dry-fry the pancake in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 5 minutes per side until golden.
For the sauce, stir together the soy skyr and tamari until smooth.
Arrange everything in a plate, drizzle with the sauce and sprinkle with the spring onions and nori.

title: Antipasti plate with lupins, grilled vegetables and smoked tofu
instructions: Wash the vegetables, slice the courgette and aubergine, cut the red pepper into strips and dice the smoked tofu.
Dry-fry the courgette, aubergine and red pepper in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until well browned.
Season with the balsamic vinegar and oregano, salt and pepper.
Arrange the courgette, aubergine, red pepper, lupins and smoked tofu in a plate and sprinkle with the basil.

title: Air fryer tofu pizza bites with tomato and oregano
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 1 cm thick slices, thinly slice the cherry tomatoes and slice the black olives into thin rings.
Spread the tofu with the tomato purée.
Top with the tomato slices and olives and sprinkle with the nutritional yeast and oregano.
Cook the tofu in the air fryer at 190 °C for 10 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.

title: Edamame guacamole with pepper and celery sticks
instructions: Blanch the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Roughly mash the edamame, avocado, soy protein and lime juice with a fork.
Wash the vegetables, finely chop the cherry tomatoes and coriander and cut the red pepper and celery into sticks.
Arrange the red pepper and celery in a plate, drizzle with the dip and sprinkle with the cherry tomatoes and coriander.

title: Air fryer BBQ tempeh cubes with coleslaw
instructions: Pour the vegetable stock over the soy chunks, leave to soak for 10 minutes and squeeze out well.
Cut the tempeh into 2 cm cubes and cut the white cabbage and carrots into thin strips.
Toss the tempeh and soy chunks with the tomato purée and paprika and leave to marinate for 10 minutes.
Cook the tempeh and soy chunks in the air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
Put the white cabbage, carrots, soy yoghurt and cider vinegar in a bowl and mix well.
Arrange the tempeh, soy chunks and white cabbage in a plate.

title: Tofu fries with paprika rub and garlic soy skyr
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into finger-thick sticks.
Coat the tofu all over in the cornflour, paprika and thyme.
Cook the tofu in the air fryer at 200 °C for 15 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
For the dip, stir together the soy skyr and garlic until smooth.
Arrange the tofu in a plate, drizzle with the dip.

title: Air fryer rice paper dumplings with tofu shiitake filling
instructions: Finely chop the shiitake, Chinese cabbage and spring onions, finely grate the ginger and pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Dry-fry the tofu, soy mince, shiitake, Chinese cabbage, ginger and tamari in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until crumbly.
Briefly moisten the rice paper, halve it, fold 2 tbsp filling into each piece and form 4 parcels.
Cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 10 minutes until crisp.

title: Courgette boats with soy mince tomato filling
instructions: Pour the vegetable stock over the soy mince, leave to soak for 10 minutes and squeeze out well.
Halve the courgettes lengthways and hollow them out with a spoon, dice the flesh and onion and crumble the tofu.
Dry-fry the soy mince, tofu, onion, chopped tomatoes and oregano in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until crumbly.
Fill the courgette with the soy mince, tofu and nutritional yeast.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C conventional, spread the courgette on a lined baking tray and bake for 20 minutes.

title: Beetroot lupin hummus with cucumber sticks and sesame
instructions: Rinse and drain the lupins and cut the beetroot into rough pieces.
For the dip, blend the lupins, beetroot, pea protein, lemon juice and garlic with 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Cut the cucumber into sticks.
Arrange the cucumber in a plate, drizzle with the dip and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.

title: Air fryer spinach tofu balls with tomato dip
instructions: Blanch the leaf spinach in boiling water for 1 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Squeeze the spinach well, chop it and knead with the crumbled tofu, dry soy mince, chickpea flour and nutmeg.
With damp hands shape the mixture into 10 balls.
Cook the balls in the air fryer at 190 °C for 12 minutes until golden.
Simmer the passata with the garlic and oregano for 5 minutes and serve as a dip.

title: Air fryer chickpea flour tofu pakoras with mint yoghurt
instructions: Dice the tofu, cut the onion into strips and roughly chop the baby spinach and mint.
Stir the chickpea flour with the spices and 50 ml water into a thick batter and mix in the tofu, onion and spinach.
Drop 8 spoonfuls into the air fryer and cook at 200 °C for 12 minutes until crisp.
For the dip, stir together the soy yoghurt and mint until smooth.

title: Air fryer broccoli tofu tots with mustard ketchup
instructions: Cut the broccoli into small florets.
Blanch the broccoli in boiling water for 2 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Finely chop the broccoli and shape it with the crumbled tofu, chickpea flour and nutritional yeast into 12 small cylinders.
Cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 14 minutes until crisp.
For the dip, stir together the tomato purée and mustard with 2 tbsp water until smooth.

title: Miso-glazed tofu dengaku with sesame and cucumber
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 1 cm thick slices and thinly slice the cucumber.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until golden all over.
For the sauce, stir together the miso paste and maple syrup with 1 tbsp water until smooth.
Spread the tofu with the miso paste and caramelise under the oven grill for 3 minutes.
Arrange the tofu and cucumber in a plate and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.

title: Air fryer agedashi tofu with daikon and tamari broth
instructions: Cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes, finely grate the daikon and ginger and slice the spring onions into thin rings.
Coat the tofu all over in the cornflour.
Cook the tofu in the air fryer at 200 °C for 14 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
Warm the vegetable stock and tamari in a small pan for 2 minutes without boiling.
Arrange the tofu, daikon and ginger in a bowl, drizzle with the sauce and sprinkle with the spring onions.

title: Hiyayakko silken tofu with edamame and chilli garlic topping
instructions: Blanch the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Finely chop the garlic and red chilli and slice the spring onions into thin rings.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the garlic and red chilli for 1 minutes stirring.
Place the silken tofu on a plate, scatter the edamame around it, drizzle with the tamari and spoon the chilli garlic oil on top.
Sprinkle with the spring onions and serve straight away.

title: Tomatoes stuffed with tofu herb salad and lupins
instructions: Cut a lid off the tomatoes and hollow out the insides.
Dice the tofu, finely chop the parsley and spring onions and rinse and drain the lupins.
Put the tofu, lupins, parsley, spring onions and lemon juice in a bowl and mix well.
Fill the tomatoes with the tofu and lupins.

title: Kimchi tofu pancake with chickpea flour
instructions: Roughly chop the kimchi, slice the spring onions into thin rings and pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Stir the chickpea flour with 50 ml water until smooth and mix in the kimchi, tofu and spring onions.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the pancake for 4 minutes per side until crisp.
For the dip, stir together the tamari and rice vinegar until smooth.

title: Grilled smoked tofu vegetable skewers with lemon herb marinade
instructions: Wash the vegetables and cut the smoked tofu, tofu, courgette, red pepper and red onion into 2 cm cubes.
Toss the smoked tofu, tofu, courgette, red pepper and red onion with the lemon juice and rosemary and leave to marinate for 10 minutes.
Thread the smoked tofu, courgette, red pepper and red onion alternately onto 4 skewers.
Cook the skewers in the air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes, turning once.

title: Lupin bruschetta on polenta slices with tomato and basil
instructions: Stir the polenta into 100 ml boiling salted water, leave to thicken for 5 minutes, spread 1 cm thick and leave to firm up.
Cut into 4 slices and toast in a dry pan for 3 minutes per side.
Dice the tomatoes, cut the basil into thin strips, finely chop the garlic and rinse and drain the lupins.
Put the lupins, pea protein, tomatoes, basil, garlic and balsamic vinegar in a bowl and mix well.
Arrange the polenta and lupins in a plate.

title: Tofu scramble muffins with peppers for on the go
instructions: Wash the vegetables, dice the red pepper and slice the spring onions into thin rings.
Blend the tofu, silken tofu, chickpea flour, nutritional yeast and turmeric in a blender for 30 seconds until creamy.
Stir in the red pepper and spring onions.
Spoon the mixture into 6 muffin cases and bake in the preheated oven at 190 °C for 22 minutes until set.

title: Baked sweet potato sticks with lupin herb dip
instructions: Cut the sweet potato into sticks.
Cook the sweet potato and paprika in the air fryer at 200 °C for 16 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
Rinse and drain the lupins.
For the dip, blend the lupins, soy skyr, parsley and lemon juice until smooth.
Arrange the sweet potato in a plate, drizzle with the dip.

title: Lemon pepper tofu bites with radishes and cress
instructions: Cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes and quarter the radishes.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the tofu for 8 minutes until crisp.
Season with the lemon juice and lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Arrange the tofu and radishes in a plate and sprinkle with the cress.

title: Air fryer spicy soy chunk taquitos with corn tortillas
instructions: Pour the vegetable stock over the soy chunks, leave to soak for 15 minutes and squeeze out well.
Dry-fry the soy chunks, tomatoes, chilli and cumin in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until crumbly.
Warm the tortillas briefly, fill them, roll up tightly and cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 7 minutes until crisp.
For the dip, stir together the soy skyr and lime juice until smooth.

title: Silken tofu roasted pepper dip with vegetable sticks
instructions: Roast the pepper under the oven grill for 10 minutes until the skin blackens, then peel and deseed.
For the dip, blend the silken tofu, red pepper, pea protein and paprika until smooth.
Cut the courgette and kohlrabi into sticks.
Arrange the courgette, kohlrabi and edamame in a plate, drizzle with the dip.

title: Crispy chickpea crêpe roll with tofu and spinach
instructions: Stir the chickpea flour with 80 ml water and the turmeric until smooth and leave to rest for 5 minutes.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and cook a thin crêpe for 2 minutes per side until crisp.
Pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers and dice the tomatoes.
Dry-fry the tofu, baby spinach, tomatoes, nutritional yeast and cumin in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes stirring.
Spread the filling over the crêpe, roll it up tightly and cut in half diagonally.

title: Savoury tofu waffles with herbs and tomato salsa
instructions: Blend the tofu, chickpea flour, pea protein, parsley and baking powder in a blender for 30 seconds until creamy.
Preheat the waffle iron and cook 2 waffles from the batter for 5 minutes each until golden.
Dice the tomatoes and red onion.
Arrange everything in a plate and sprinkle with the tomatoes and red onion.

title: Steamed pak choi tofu parcels with ginger tamari
instructions: Separate the pak choi leaves and blanch for 30 seconds, crumble the tofu and finely chop the shiitake.
Put the tofu, shiitake, soy mince, ginger and tamari in a bowl and mix well.
Wrap the filling in 2 leaves at a time to make 6 parcels and steam for 8 minutes.
Sprinkle with the sesame seeds and serve straight away.

title: Red lentil carrot soup with ginger and crispy tofu cubes
instructions: Dice the carrots and onion, finely grate the ginger and pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Sweat the onion and ginger in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the red lentils, carrots and vegetable stock to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 18 minutes.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender and season with salt and pepper.
Stir the pea protein with 4 tbsp of the soup until smooth and stir it into the soup off the boil.
Dry-fry the tofu cubes in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until crisp, drizzle the soup with the coconut milk and scatter the tofu on top.

title: White bean and leek soup with smoked tofu and marjoram
instructions: Wash the vegetables, slice the leek into thin rings, dice the potatoes and dice the smoked tofu.
Sweat the leek and potatoes in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 4 minutes until translucent.
Add the white beans, vegetable stock and marjoram to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Blend half of the soup with a stick blender to thicken it and season to taste.
Stir the pea protein with 4 tbsp of the soup until smooth and stir it into the soup off the boil.
Dry-fry the smoked tofu in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until crisp.

title: Hokkaido squash lupin cream soup with toasted pumpkin seeds
instructions: Dice the Hokkaido squash, dice the onion and finely grate the ginger.
Sweat the onion and ginger in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the Hokkaido squash, lupins and vegetable stock to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 18 minutes.
Add the silken tofu and blend everything until smooth with a stick blender, then season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan for 2 minutes.
Sprinkle with the pumpkin seeds and serve straight away.

title: Miso ramen with edamame spaghetti, pak choi and tofu
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, halve the pak choi, thinly slice the shiitake, slice the spring onions into thin rings and finely grate the ginger.
Cook the edamame spaghetti in plenty of salted water for 6 minutes until al dente and drain.
Add the vegetable stock, ginger, shiitake and pak choi to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 4 minutes.
Take the pot off the heat, stir the miso paste with a little stock until smooth and stir it in.
Arrange the edamame spaghetti and tofu in a soup bowl and sprinkle with the spring onions and nori.

title: Thai coconut soup with tofu, oyster mushrooms and lemongrass
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, tear the oyster mushrooms into bite-sized pieces, slice the lemongrass and ginger and slice the green chilli into thin rings.
Add the vegetable stock, coconut milk, lemongrass and ginger to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the tofu, oyster mushrooms and green chilli and simmer for another 6 minutes until cooked through.
Stir the pea protein with 4 tbsp of the soup until smooth and stir it into the soup off the boil.
Season with the lime juice and coriander, salt and pepper.

title: Broccoli pea cream soup with silken tofu and nutritional yeast
instructions: Cut the broccoli into small florets and dice the onion.
Sweat the onion in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the broccoli, peas and vegetable stock to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 10 minutes.
Add the silken tofu and nutritional yeast, blend until smooth with a stick blender and season with nutmeg.
Stir the pea protein with 4 tbsp of the soup until smooth and stir it into the soup off the boil.

title: Tomato soup with beluga lentils, crumbled tofu and basil
instructions: Finely chop the onion and garlic and pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Sweat the onion and garlic in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the beluga lentils, chopped tomatoes, tofu, vegetable stock and oregano to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 25 minutes.
Stir the pea protein with 4 tbsp of the soup until smooth and stir it into the soup off the boil.
Arrange everything in a soup bowl and sprinkle with the basil.

title: Mexican black bean soup with soy skyr and coriander
instructions: Dice the red pepper and onion and finely chop the coriander.
Sweat the onion and red pepper in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 4 minutes until translucent.
Add the black beans, soy mince, chopped tomatoes, vegetable stock and cumin to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Blend half of the soup with a stick blender to thicken it and season to taste.
Season the soup with lime juice, ladle into a soup bowl, add a dollop of soy skyr and sprinkle with coriander.

title: Gluten-free minestrone with chickpea pasta and lupins
instructions: Wash the vegetables and dice the courgette, carrots and celery.
Sweat the carrots and celery in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 4 minutes until translucent.
Add the courgette, chopped tomatoes, vegetable stock, lupins and oregano to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Add the chickpea pasta and simmer for another 8 minutes until tender-crisp.
Arrange everything in a soup bowl and sprinkle with the nutritional yeast and basil.

title: Harira soup with chickpeas, red lentils and tofu
instructions: Dice the celery and onion, pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes and finely chop the coriander.
Sweat the onion and celery in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 4 minutes until translucent.
Add the chickpeas, red lentils, chopped tomatoes, vegetable stock and ras el hanout to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Add the tofu and simmer for another 5 minutes until cooked through.
Stir the pea protein with 4 tbsp of the soup until smooth and stir it into the soup off the boil.
Season with the lemon juice and coriander, salt and pepper.

title: Spinach mung dal soup with tofu and turmeric
instructions: Dice the onion, finely grate the ginger and pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Sweat the onion, ginger and mustard seeds in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the mung dal, vegetable stock and turmeric to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Add the baby spinach and tofu and simmer for another 4 minutes until cooked through.
Stir the pea protein with 4 tbsp of the soup until smooth and stir it into the soup off the boil.
Season with the lemon juice, salt and pepper.

title: Sauerkraut soup with smoked tofu, potato and caraway
instructions: Dice the potatoes, onion and smoked tofu.
Sweat the onion in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the sauerkraut, potatoes, vegetable stock and caraway to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Add the smoked tofu and simmer for another 5 minutes until cooked through.
Stir the pea protein with 4 tbsp of the soup until smooth and stir it into the soup off the boil.
Arrange everything in a soup bowl and sprinkle with the dill.

title: Shiitake mushroom soup with silken tofu cream and thyme
instructions: Slice the mushrooms and shiitake and dice the leek.
Dry-fry the mushrooms, shiitake, leek and thyme in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until well browned.
Add the vegetable stock and soy mince to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 10 minutes.
Add the silken tofu and nutritional yeast, blend half of the soup and stir it back in.
Arrange everything in a soup bowl and sprinkle with the chives.

title: Gazpacho with silken tofu and crispy roasted lupins
instructions: Wash the vegetables and cut the tomatoes, cucumber, red pepper and red onion into rough pieces.
Blend the tomatoes, cucumber, red pepper, red onion, garlic, silken tofu and cider vinegar in a blender for 60 seconds until creamy.
Cover and chill in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C conventional, spread the lupins and paprika on a lined baking tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Pour the gazpacho into a soup bowl and scatter the crispy lupins on top.

title: West African sweet potato peanut soup with tofu and spinach
instructions: Peel and dice the sweet potato, dice the onion, finely grate the ginger and pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Sweat the onion and ginger in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the sweet potato, chopped tomatoes, vegetable stock and peanut butter to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 18 minutes.
Blend half of the soup with a stick blender to thicken it and season to taste.
Add the tofu and baby spinach and simmer for another 4 minutes until cooked through.
Stir the pea protein with 4 tbsp of the soup until smooth and stir it into the soup off the boil.

title: Kale lupin stew with potatoes and smoked paprika
instructions: Wash the vegetables, roughly chop the kale and dice the potatoes and onion.
Sweat the onion in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the potatoes, kale, vegetable stock and paprika to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Add the lupins and simmer for another 5 minutes until cooked through.
Season with the mustard and nutritional yeast, salt and pepper.

title: Paprika goulash soup with soy chunks and marjoram
instructions: Pour boiling water over the soy chunks, leave for 10 minutes and drain.
Dice the red pepper, onion and sweet potato.
Dry-fry the soy chunks and onion in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until well browned.
Add the tomato purée, red pepper and paprika and fry for another 2 minutes stirring.
Add the chopped tomatoes, sweet potato, vegetable stock and marjoram to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 25 minutes.

title: Shirataki noodle soup with tofu, shiitake, Chinese cabbage and soybean sprouts
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, cut the shiitake and Chinese cabbage into thin strips, slice the spring onions into thin rings and finely grate the ginger.
Rinse the shirataki noodles thoroughly in a sieve and drain.
Add the vegetable stock, ginger, tamari, shiitake and Chinese cabbage to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the shirataki noodles, tofu and soybean sprouts and simmer for another 3 minutes until cooked through.
Sprinkle with the spring onions and serve straight away.

title: Cauliflower cream soup with silken tofu and lupin crunch
instructions: Cut the cauliflower into small florets and dice the onion.
Add the cauliflower, onion and vegetable stock to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Add the silken tofu and nutritional yeast, blend until smooth with a stick blender and season with nutmeg.
Dry-fry the lupins, flaked almonds and paprika in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until crisp.
Sprinkle with the lupins and flaked almonds and serve straight away.

title: Lebanese lentil chard soup with lupins and lemon
instructions: Wash the vegetables, cut the chard into strips and finely chop the onion and garlic.
Sweat the onion and garlic in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the beluga lentils, vegetable stock and cumin to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Add the chard and lupins and simmer for another 5 minutes until cooked through.
Stir the pea protein with 4 tbsp of the soup until smooth and stir it into the soup off the boil.
Season with the lemon juice, salt and pepper.

title: Borscht with beetroot, white cabbage and dill soy skyr
instructions: Coarsely grate the beetroot and carrots, cut the white cabbage into thin strips and dice the onion.
Sweat the onion and carrots in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the beetroot, white cabbage, tomato purée, vegetable stock, soy mince and white beans to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 25 minutes.
Season with the cider vinegar, salt and pepper.
Stir the soy skyr with chopped dill and add a dollop on top of the soup.

title: Courgette pea mint soup with edamame and silken tofu
instructions: Dice the courgette and onion and let the edamame thaw.
Add the courgette, peas, onion and vegetable stock to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 10 minutes.
Add half of the edamame, the silken tofu and the mint and blend until smooth.
Add the edamame and simmer for another 3 minutes until cooked through.
Season with the lemon juice, salt and pepper.

title: Roasted pepper tomato soup with tempeh croutons
instructions: Cut the red pepper and tomatoes into rough pieces, cut the onion into rough pieces and dice the tempeh.
Preheat the oven to 220 °C conventional, spread the red pepper, tomatoes, onion and garlic on a lined baking tray and roast for 20 minutes.
Add the vegetable stock to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 5 minutes.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender and season with salt and pepper.
Stir the pea protein with 4 tbsp of the soup until smooth and stir it into the soup off the boil.
Dry-fry the tempeh in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until crisp.

title: Asparagus cream soup with silken tofu and chives
instructions: Wash the vegetables, cut the green asparagus and potatoes into rough pieces and slice the leek into thin rings.
Add the green asparagus, potatoes, leek and vegetable stock to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Add the silken tofu and blend everything until smooth with a stick blender.
Stir the pea protein with 4 tbsp of the soup until smooth and stir it into the soup off the boil.
Arrange everything in a soup bowl and sprinkle with the chives.

title: Kimchi silken tofu stew with edamame and courgette
instructions: Slice the courgette and mushrooms, slice the spring onions into thin rings and let the edamame thaw.
Dry-fry the kimchi, soy mince and gochugaru in a non-stick pan for 3 minutes stirring.
Add the vegetable stock, tamari, courgette, mushrooms and edamame to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 6 minutes.
Spoon the silken tofu into the soup in large pieces and leave to heat through for 3 minutes.
Sprinkle with the spring onions and serve straight away.

title: Fennel potato soup with silken tofu and hemp seeds
instructions: Wash the vegetables and dice the fennel, potatoes and onion.
Add the fennel, potatoes, onion, vegetable stock and fennel seeds to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 18 minutes.
Add the silken tofu and blend everything until smooth with a stick blender.
Stir the pea protein with 4 tbsp of the soup until smooth and stir it into the soup off the boil.
Sprinkle with the hemp seeds and serve straight away.

title: Pho rice noodle soup with tofu, Thai basil and bean sprouts
ingredients: Star anise, cinnamon stick, coriander seeds
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 1 cm thick slices, slice the onion and ginger and slice the red chilli into thin rings.
Add the vegetable stock, onion, ginger, tamari and star anise to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 15 minutes.
Pour boiling water over the rice noodles, leave for 5 minutes and drain.
Add the tofu and bean sprouts and simmer for another 3 minutes until cooked through.
Stir the pea protein with 4 tbsp of the soup until smooth and stir it into the soup off the boil.
Put the rice noodles in a soup bowl, pour over the broth with the tofu and sprouts and serve with Thai basil, chili and lime juice.

title: Hot and sour soup with tofu, shiitake and edamame
instructions: Cut the tofu, shiitake and carrots into thin strips, cut the Chinese cabbage into thin strips, slice the spring onions into thin rings and let the edamame thaw.
Add the vegetable stock, tamari, shiitake, carrots, Chinese cabbage and edamame to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu and simmer for another 2 minutes until cooked through.
Stir the cornflour with the rice vinegar and sambal oelek until smooth, stir it in and simmer for 1 minute until slightly thickened.
Sprinkle with the spring onions and serve straight away.

title: Chilled cucumber dill soup with soy skyr and lupins
instructions: Wash the vegetables, cut the cucumber into rough pieces and dice the radishes.
Blend the cucumber, soy skyr, dill, garlic and lemon juice in a blender for 40 seconds until creamy.
Cover and chill in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Pour the soup into a soup bowl and sprinkle with the lupins, diced radish and dill.

title: Tomato coconut soup with tofu and garam masala
instructions: Finely chop the onion and red chilli and pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Sweat the onion, red chilli and garam masala in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the passata, vegetable stock and coconut milk to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 10 minutes.
Add the tofu and baby spinach and simmer for another 5 minutes until cooked through.
Stir the pea protein with 4 tbsp of the soup until smooth and stir it into the soup off the boil.
Sprinkle with the pumpkin seeds and serve straight away.

title: Lupin tabbouleh with quinoa, parsley and mint
instructions: Rinse the quinoa in a sieve and cook in twice the volume of lightly salted water for 15 minutes.
Wash the vegetables, finely chop the parsley and mint and dice the tomatoes and cucumber.
Put the quinoa, lupins, parsley, mint, tomatoes and cucumber in a bowl and mix well.
Season with the lemon juice and olive oil, salt and pepper.

title: Asian edamame red cabbage salad with tofu and peanut lime dressing
instructions: Cut the red cabbage into thin strips, coarsely grate the carrots, pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes and let the edamame thaw.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
For the dressing, stir together the peanut butter, lime juice and tamari with 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Toss the red cabbage, carrots, edamame and tofu with the dressing.
Sprinkle with the coriander and serve straight away.

title: Beluga lentil rocket salad with smoked tofu and balsamic
instructions: Boil the beluga lentils in salted water for 20 minutes until tender and drain.
Dice the smoked tofu, halve the cherry tomatoes and slice the red onion into thin rings.
Dry-fry the smoked tofu in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until crisp.
For the dressing, stir together the balsamic vinegar, mustard and nutritional yeast with 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Toss the beluga lentils, rocket, cherry tomatoes, red onion and smoked tofu with the dressing.

title: Greek country salad with lemon oregano tofu
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Toss the tofu with the lemon juice, nutritional yeast and oregano and leave to marinate for 15 minutes.
Wash the vegetables, cut the cucumber, tomatoes and green pepper into rough pieces and slice the red onion into thin rings.
Put the cucumber, tomatoes, green pepper, red onion, black olives and cider vinegar in a bowl and mix well.
Put the salad in a bowl, scatter the marinated tofu over it and sprinkle with oregano.

title: Spinach strawberry salad with tempeh and lupins
instructions: Wash the vegetables and fruit, quarter the strawberries and dice the tempeh.
Dry-fry the tempeh in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until golden all over.
Put the baby spinach, strawberries, lupins and tempeh in a bowl and mix well.
Drizzle with balsamic vinegar and sprinkle with flaked almonds.

title: Shirataki glass noodle salad with tofu, lime and herbs
instructions: Rinse the shirataki noodles thoroughly in a sieve, blanch in boiling water for 2 minutes and drain.
Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, cut the cucumber into sticks, halve the cherry tomatoes and slice the red onion and red chilli into thin rings.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
For the dressing, stir together the lime juice, tamari and red chilli until smooth.
Toss the shirataki noodles, tofu, cucumber, cherry tomatoes and red onion with the dressing.
Sprinkle with the coriander, mint and peanuts and serve straight away.

title: Broccoli edamame salad with tofu and sesame ginger dressing
instructions: Cut the broccoli into small florets, pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, finely grate the ginger and slice the spring onions into thin rings.
Blanch the broccoli and edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
For the dressing, stir together the ginger, rice vinegar and tamari until smooth.
Toss the broccoli, edamame and tofu with the dressing.
Sprinkle with the sesame seeds and spring onions and serve straight away.

title: Mexican bean corn salad with lupins and avocado
instructions: Rinse and drain the black beans, sweetcorn and lupins, dice the red pepper and avocado and finely chop the red onion and coriander.
Put the black beans, sweetcorn, lupins, red pepper and red onion in a bowl and mix well.
Season with the lime juice and cumin, salt and pepper.
Arrange everything in a bowl and sprinkle with the avocado and coriander.

title: Waldorf salad with tofu and soy skyr dressing
instructions: Wash the vegetables and fruit, slice the celery, cut the apple into sticks and pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
For the dressing, stir together the soy skyr, lemon juice and mustard until smooth.
Toss the celery, apple and tofu with the dressing.
Sprinkle with the walnuts and serve straight away.

title: Vegan salade niçoise with smoked tofu, green beans and lupins
instructions: Blanch the green beans in boiling water for 5 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Wash the vegetables, dice the smoked tofu, halve the cherry tomatoes and tear the romaine lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
Dry-fry the smoked tofu in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until crisp.
For the dressing, stir together the mustard and lemon juice with 1 tbsp water until smooth.
Arrange the romaine, beans, tomatoes, lupins, smoked tofu, olives and capers on a plate and drizzle with the dressing.

title: Red cabbage orange salad with tempeh and lupins
instructions: Cut the red cabbage into thin strips, peel and slice the orange and dice the tempeh.
Dry-fry the tempeh in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until golden all over.
For the dressing, stir together the cider vinegar and mustard with 1 tbsp water until smooth.
Toss the red cabbage, orange, lupins and tempeh with the dressing.
Sprinkle with the parsley and serve straight away.

title: Cucumber wakame salad with edamame and tofu
instructions: Soak the wakame in cold water for 5 minutes and squeeze out well.
Thinly slice the cucumber and radishes, pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, finely grate the ginger and let the edamame thaw.
For the dressing, stir together the lime juice, tamari and ginger until smooth.
Toss the wakame, cucumber, radishes, edamame and tofu with the dressing.
Sprinkle with the sesame seeds and serve straight away.

title: Roasted squash salad with lupins, tofu and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Cut the Hokkaido squash and tofu into 2 cm cubes.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C conventional, spread the Hokkaido squash, tofu and rosemary on a lined baking tray and roast for 25 minutes.
Put the rocket, lupins, Hokkaido squash and tofu in a bowl and mix well.
Drizzle with balsamic vinegar and sprinkle with pumpkin seeds.

title: Green asparagus salad with edamame and silken tofu herb dressing
instructions: Wash the vegetables, cut the green asparagus into rough pieces and slice the radishes.
Blanch the green asparagus and edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes and refresh in cold water.
For the dressing, blend the silken tofu, parsley and lemon juice until smooth.
Toss the green asparagus, edamame and radishes with the dressing.

title: Buckwheat beetroot salad with lamb's lettuce and lupins
instructions: Rinse the buckwheat in a sieve and cook in twice the volume of lightly salted water for 12 minutes.
Dice the beetroot.
For the dressing, stir together the cider vinegar and mustard with 1 tbsp water until smooth.
Toss the buckwheat, beetroot, lamb's lettuce and lupins with the dressing.
Sprinkle with the walnuts and serve straight away.

title: Som tam salad with tofu, lupins and green beans
instructions: Cut the papaya into thin strips, cut the green beans into rough pieces, halve the cherry tomatoes and pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
For the dressing, stir together the lime juice, tamari, red chilli and garlic until smooth.
Toss the papaya, green beans, cherry tomatoes, lupins and tofu with the dressing.

title: Taco salad with soy mince, romaine and black beans
instructions: Pour the vegetable stock over the soy mince, leave to soak for 10 minutes and squeeze out well.
Dry-fry the soy mince, chipotle powder and cumin in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until crumbly.
Wash the vegetables, tear the romaine lettuce into bite-sized pieces, dice the tomatoes and finely chop the red onion.
For the dressing, stir together the soy skyr and lime juice until smooth.
Arrange the romaine lettuce, tomatoes, sweetcorn, black beans, red onion and soy mince in a bowl, drizzle with the dressing.

title: Chicory orange salad with smoked tofu and mustard dressing
instructions: Separate the chicory into single leaves, peel and slice the orange and dice the smoked tofu.
Dry-fry the smoked tofu in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until crisp.
For the dressing, stir together the mustard and cider vinegar with 1 tbsp water until smooth.
Toss the chicory, orange, lupins and smoked tofu with the dressing.
Sprinkle with the chives and serve straight away.

title: Beluga lentil fennel salad with tempeh and radicchio
instructions: Boil the beluga lentils in salted water for 20 minutes until tender and drain.
Wash the vegetables, thinly slice the fennel, tear the radicchio into bite-sized pieces and dice the tempeh.
Dry-fry the tempeh in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until golden all over.
For the dressing, stir together the nutritional yeast, lemon juice and mustard with 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Toss the beluga lentils, fennel, radicchio and tempeh with the dressing.

title: Vegan Caesar salad with tofu croutons and caper dressing
instructions: Wash the vegetables, tear the romaine lettuce into bite-sized pieces and pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until crisp.
For the dressing, blend the soy skyr, capers, nutritional yeast, mustard, lemon juice and garlic until smooth.
Toss the romaine lettuce with the dressing.
Sprinkle with the tofu and serve straight away.

title: Potato radish salad with lupins and chive soy skyr
instructions: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes until tender and drain.
Wash the vegetables, slice the potatoes and radishes and thinly slice the cucumber.
For the dressing, stir together the soy skyr, mustard, cider vinegar and chives until smooth.
Toss the potatoes, radishes, cucumber and lupins with the dressing.

title: Tofu mango salad with lupins, pepper and chili
instructions: Dice the tofu, mango and red pepper, slice the spring onions into thin rings and finely chop the red chilli.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
For the dressing, stir together the lime juice and red chilli until smooth.
Toss the tofu, mango, red pepper, lupins and spring onions with the dressing.
Sprinkle with the coriander and serve straight away.

title: Coleslaw with soy skyr dressing and BBQ tempeh
instructions: Cut the white cabbage into thin strips, coarsely grate the carrots and cut the tempeh into strips.
Toss the tempeh with the tamari, tomato purée and paprika and leave to marinate for 10 minutes.
Dry-fry the tempeh in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until well browned.
For the dressing, stir together the soy skyr, mustard and cider vinegar until smooth.
Toss the white cabbage and carrots with the dressing.

title: Lamb's lettuce with pear and crispy soy chunks
instructions: Pour boiling water over the soy chunks, leave for 10 minutes and drain.
Toss the soy chunks with the tamari and paprika and leave to marinate for 5 minutes.
Dry-fry the soy chunks in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until crisp.
Wash the vegetables and fruit and thinly slice the pear.
For the dressing, stir together the mustard and cider vinegar with 1 tbsp water until smooth.
Toss the lamb's lettuce, pear and soy chunks with the dressing.

title: Warm aubergine lentil salad with mint and soy yoghurt
instructions: Boil the beluga lentils in salted water for 20 minutes until tender and drain.
Cut the aubergine and tofu into 2 cm cubes.
Preheat the oven to 210 °C conventional, spread the aubergine, tofu and cumin on a lined baking tray and roast for 22 minutes.
For the dressing, stir together the soy yoghurt, lemon juice and mint until smooth.
Arrange the beluga lentils, aubergine and tofu in a plate, drizzle with the dressing and sprinkle with the mint.

title: Three bean salad with lupins and savory
instructions: Blanch the green beans in boiling water for 5 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Rinse and drain the kidney beans, white beans and lupins, finely chop the red onion and finely chop the parsley.
For the dressing, stir together the cider vinegar, mustard and savory with 1 tbsp water until smooth.
Toss the green beans, kidney beans, white beans, lupins and red onion with the dressing.
Sprinkle with the parsley and serve straight away.

title: Warm oyster mushroom spinach salad with tofu and balsamic
instructions: Tear the oyster mushrooms into bite-sized pieces, pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes and slice the red onion into thin rings.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
Add the oyster mushrooms, red onion and thyme and fry for another 5 minutes until well browned.
Spread the baby spinach on a plate, top with the warm mushrooms and tofu and drizzle with balsamic vinegar.

title: Watermelon cucumber salad with mint tofu and lupins
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Toss the tofu with the lime juice and miso paste and leave to marinate for 15 minutes.
Dice the watermelon and cucumber and finely chop the mint.
Put the watermelon, cucumber, lupins and tofu in a bowl and mix well.
Sprinkle with the mint and serve straight away.

title: Kale salad with edamame, lupins, pomegranate and tahini lemon
instructions: Wash the vegetables, tear the kale into bite-sized pieces and let the edamame thaw.
Massage the kale with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt by hand for 2 minutes until soft.
For the dressing, stir together the tahini and nutritional yeast with 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Toss the kale, edamame and lupins with the dressing.
Sprinkle with the pomegranate seeds and serve straight away.

title: Chinese cabbage mandarin salad with tofu and soybean sprouts
instructions: Cut the Chinese cabbage into thin strips, pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, slice the spring onions into thin rings and peel and slice the mandarins.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
For the dressing, stir together the rice vinegar and tamari until smooth.
Toss the Chinese cabbage, mandarins, soybean sprouts and tofu with the dressing.
Sprinkle with the sesame seeds and spring onions and serve straight away.

title: Tofu tikka masala with cauliflower rice and coriander
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, dice the onion and finely grate the ginger and garlic.
Toss the tofu with the soy yoghurt and garam masala and leave to marinate for 15 minutes.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
Sweat the onion, ginger and garlic in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the passata and tofu to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cook the cauliflower rice in a dry non-stick pan for 5 minutes and serve with the curry and coriander.

title: Palak tofu with lupins and ginger
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, dice the onion and finely grate the ginger and garlic.
Sweat the onion, ginger, garlic and cumin in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 4 minutes until translucent.
Add the baby spinach and cook for another 3 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender and season with salt and pepper.
Add the tofu, lupins and soy yoghurt and simmer for another 5 minutes until cooked through.

title: Aloo gobi style cauliflower potato curry with tofu and cumin
instructions: Cut the cauliflower into small florets, dice the potatoes, tomatoes and onion, pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes and finely grate the ginger.
Dry-fry the tofu and turmeric in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
Sweat the onion, ginger and cumin in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the cauliflower, potatoes, tomatoes and peas to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 15 minutes until soft.
Stir the pea protein with 3 tbsp water, fold it in with the tofu and sprinkle with coriander.

title: Tofu jalfrezi with mixed peppers and green chili
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, cut the red pepper, green pepper and onion into rough pieces, dice the tomatoes and slice the green chilli into thin rings.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
Add the red pepper, green pepper, onion, green chilli and garam masala and fry for another 6 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add the tomatoes to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 4 minutes.
Cook the cauliflower rice in a dry pan for 5 minutes and serve next to the jalfrezi.

title: Green Thai curry with tofu, sugar snaps and shirataki rice
instructions: Dice the tofu and aubergine and halve the sugar snap peas.
Rinse the shirataki rice thoroughly and dry-fry in a pan for 3 minutes.
Add the curry paste, coconut milk, vegetable stock and aubergine to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 6 minutes.
Add the tofu and sugar snap peas and simmer for another 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Stir the pea protein with 2 tbsp of the curry until smooth, stir it in and finish with lime juice and Thai basil.

title: Pad kra pao with soy mince, green beans and Thai basil
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice in a sieve and cook in twice the volume of lightly salted water for 12 minutes.
Pour the vegetable stock over the soy mince, leave to soak for 10 minutes and squeeze out well.
Cut the green beans into rough pieces, finely chop the garlic and red chilli and pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Dry-fry the soy mince, tofu, garlic and red chilli in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until crumbly.
Add the green beans and tamari and fry for another 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Fold in the Thai basil and serve with the rice.

title: Tofu larb with mint, lime and lettuce cups
instructions: Toast the glutinous rice in a dry pan for 4 minutes.
Crush the toasted sticky rice coarsely in a mortar.
Pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers, finely chop the red onion and red chilli and cut the green beans into rough pieces.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until crumbly.
Mix the tofu with the lime juice, tamari, onion, chili, herbs and rice powder and serve in romaine leaves with the raw beans.

title: Vietnamese lemongrass tofu stir-fry with pak choi
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, finely chop the lemongrass, garlic and red chilli and halve the pak choi.
Toss the tofu with the lemongrass, garlic, red chilli and tamari and leave to marinate for 10 minutes.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
Add the pak choi and fry for another 3 minutes until tender-crisp.
Rinse the shirataki rice, warm it in the pan with the pea protein and 2 tbsp water and serve with lime juice.

title: Vietnamese caramel tofu with green beans
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, cut the ginger into thin strips, slice the spring onions into thin rings and cut the green beans into rough pieces.
Blanch the green beans in boiling water for 4 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
Add the coconut aminos, tamari, ginger, pea protein and 4 tbsp water and reduce for 3 minutes until glossy, season with pepper.
Arrange the tofu and green beans in a plate and sprinkle with the spring onions.

title: Mapo tofu with soy mince and Sichuan pepper
instructions: Cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes, finely chop the garlic and ginger and slice the spring onions into thin rings.
Dry-fry the soy mince, garlic, ginger and Sichuan pepper in a non-stick pan for 3 minutes until crumbly.
Add the vegetable stock, miso paste, sambal oelek, tamari and tofu to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir the cornflour with 2 tbsp water, stir it in and simmer for 1 minute until thickened, then serve with shirataki rice and spring onions.

title: Kung pao tofu with pepper, courgette and peanuts
instructions: Dice the tofu, red pepper and courgette and slice the spring onions into thin rings.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
Add the red pepper, courgette, red chilli and dried chillies and fry for another 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
For the sauce, stir together the tamari, rice vinegar and cornflour with 3 tbsp water until smooth.
Add the sauce, reduce for 1 minute until glossy and sprinkle with the peanuts and spring onions.

title: Tofu with broccoli and sugar snaps in garlic ginger sauce
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, cut the broccoli into small florets, halve the sugar snap peas and finely chop the garlic and ginger.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
Steam the broccoli and sugar snap peas for 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
For the sauce, stir together the garlic, ginger, tamari and cornflour with 4 tbsp water until smooth.
Pour the sauce into the pan, simmer for 1 minute until thickened, toss the broccoli, sugar snaps and tofu in it and sprinkle with sesame.

title: Yakitori tofu skewers with shiitake, leek and shichimi
instructions: Cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes, halve the shiitake, cut the leek into rough pieces and finely grate the ginger.
Thread the tofu, shiitake and leek alternately onto 4 skewers.
For the sauce, stir together the tamari, coconut aminos, ginger and pea protein with 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Dry-fry the skewers in a griddle pan for 8 minutes, brushing several times with the sauce.
Dry-fry the cauliflower rice in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes until soft.
Arrange the cauliflower rice and tofu in a plate and sprinkle with the shichimi togarashi.

title: Japanese tofu curry with carrots and potatoes
instructions: Cut the tofu, carrots, potatoes and onion into 2 cm cubes.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
Add the onion, carrots, potatoes, vegetable stock and curry powder to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Stir the cornflour and pea protein with the tamari and 3 tbsp water, stir in, add the tofu and simmer for 2 minutes until thickened.

title: Bulgogi tempeh with tofu and cucumber kimchi
instructions: Cut the tempeh into thin strips, finely grate the pear and garlic, slice the cucumber and pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Toss the tempeh with the pear, garlic and tamari and leave to marinate for 15 minutes.
Dry-fry the tempeh and tofu in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until well browned.
Put the cucumber, kimchi and gochugaru in a bowl and mix well.
Arrange the tempeh, tofu and cucumber in a plate and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.

title: Dubu jorim braised chili tofu with spinach namul
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 1 cm thick slices, finely chop the garlic and slice the spring onions into thin rings.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until golden all over.
Add the tamari, garlic, gochugaru and 80 ml water and braise for 6 minutes until the sauce has reduced.
Blanch the baby spinach in boiling water for 1 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Squeeze out the spinach, mix with the sesame oil and sesame seeds and arrange next to the tofu, sprinkle with spring onions.

title: Tempeh sambal stir-fry with green beans and tomatoes
instructions: Dice the tempeh, cut the green beans into rough pieces, dice the tomatoes, slice the onion and pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Dry-fry the tempeh and tofu in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until well browned.
Add the onion and green beans and fry for another 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add the tomatoes, sambal oelek and tamari and cook for another 3 minutes until soft.
Season with the lime juice, salt and pepper.

title: Three cup tofu san bei with Thai basil and pepper
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, slice the ginger and garlic and cut the red pepper into rough pieces.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
Add the sesame oil, ginger and garlic and fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the red pepper and fry for another 3 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add the tamari, coconut aminos, pea protein and 4 tbsp water, reduce for 3 minutes until glossy, fold in the Thai basil and serve with shirataki rice.

title: Tofu rendang with lemongrass and spinach
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes and finely chop the onion, ginger, red chilli and lemongrass.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
Blend the onion, ginger, chili and lemongrass with 3 tbsp water to a fine paste and fry it in the pan for 3 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, tamarind paste, tofu and pea protein to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 12 minutes until glossy.
Add the baby spinach and cook for another 2 minutes until soft.

title: Chili sin carne with soy mince, kidney beans and cocoa
instructions: Dice the red pepper and onion.
Sweat the onion and red pepper in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 4 minutes until translucent.
Add the soy mince, kidney beans, chopped tomatoes, sweetcorn, cocoa, vegetable stock and cumin to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve in a deep plate with a dollop of soy skyr.

title: Tofu tinga lettuce cups with chipotle and coriander
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers, cut the onion into thin strips, separate the romaine lettuce into single leaves and finely chop the coriander.
Dry-fry the tofu and onion in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until crumbly.
Add the chopped tomatoes, pea protein, chipotle powder and oregano to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 8 minutes.
Fill the romaine leaves with the tofu tinga and serve with soy skyr, coriander and lime juice.

title: Fajita skillet with soy chunks, tofu and mixed peppers
instructions: Pour boiling water over the soy chunks, leave for 10 minutes and drain.
Cut the red pepper, yellow pepper, red onion and tofu into strips.
Toss the soy chunks and tofu with the lemon juice and fajita spice and leave to marinate for 5 minutes.
Dry-fry the soy chunks and tofu in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until well browned.
Add the red pepper, yellow pepper and red onion and fry for another 5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Serve in the pan, sprinkle with coriander and add the soy skyr on the side.

title: Mexican stuffed peppers with soy mince and black beans
instructions: Pour the vegetable stock over the soy mince, leave to soak for 10 minutes and squeeze out well.
Halve the red pepper, dice the onion and pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Dry-fry the soy mince, tofu, onion and cumin in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until crumbly.
Stir in the black beans, sweetcorn and chopped tomatoes.
Fill the red pepper with the soy mince, tofu, black beans and sweetcorn.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C conventional, spread the red pepper on a lined baking tray and bake for 25 minutes.

title: Tofu saltado with tomatoes, red onion and oven potatoes
instructions: Cut the potatoes into sticks, cut the tofu into strips and cut the tomatoes and red onion into wedges.
Preheat the oven to 220 °C conventional, spread the potatoes on a lined baking tray and roast for 25 minutes.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden all over.
Add the red onion, tomatoes and ají amarillo and fry for another 3 minutes until tender-crisp.
Stir the tamari, apple cider vinegar and pea protein with 2 tbsp water, mix in and serve with the oven potatoes and coriander.

title: Moqueca with tofu, pepper and coconut milk
instructions: Cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes and slice the red pepper, yellow pepper, onion and tomatoes.
Toss the tofu with the lime juice and garlic and leave to marinate for 10 minutes.
Layer the onion, peppers, tomatoes and tofu in a wide pot.
Stir the coconut milk with the pea protein, paprika and 80 ml water, pour over and braise covered for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle with the spring onions and serve straight away.

title: Jerk tofu with mango salsa and kidney beans
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 1 cm thick slices, dice the mango, red pepper and red onion and finely chop the coriander.
Toss the tofu with the lime juice and jerk seasoning and leave to marinate for 15 minutes.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until well browned.
Mix the mango, pepper, onion and coriander with lime juice into a salsa and warm the beans with the pea protein and 3 tbsp water.
Arrange the tofu on a plate with the beans and salsa.

title: Misir wot with tofu and berbere
instructions: Finely chop the onion, finely grate the garlic and ginger and pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Sweat the onion, garlic and ginger in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 5 minutes until translucent.
Add the tomato purée and berbere spice and fry for another 2 minutes stirring.
Add the red lentils, vegetable stock and tofu to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Add the baby spinach and pea protein and simmer for another 2 minutes until cooked through.

title: Vegetable tagine with lupins, courgette and fresh apricots
instructions: Cut the courgette and carrots into rough pieces, dice the onion and halve the apricots.
Sweat the onion and ras el hanout in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the carrots, courgette, chopped tomatoes and vegetable stock to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Add the lupins, apricots and pea protein and simmer for another 8 minutes until cooked through.
Sprinkle with the coriander and serve straight away.

title: Red tofu shakshuka from the pan with coriander
instructions: Dice the red pepper and spring onions, finely chop the red chilli and pat the tofu dry and cut into 1 cm thick slices.
Sweat the spring onions, red pepper, red chilli and cumin in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 5 minutes until translucent.
Add the chopped tomatoes and pea protein to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes.
Sprinkle the tofu slices with turmeric, nestle them into the sauce and leave covered for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with the coriander and serve straight away.

title: Kafta skewers of soy mince and tofu with tahini yoghurt
instructions: Pour the vegetable stock over the soy mince, leave to soak for 10 minutes and squeeze out well.
Finely chop the onion and parsley and dice the tomatoes and cucumber.
Knead the soy mince, crumbled tofu, onion, parsley, chickpea flour and baharat together and shape into 4 long skewers.
Bake the skewers on a tray at 220 °C for 18 minutes, turning once.
For the dip, stir together the soy yoghurt and tahini until smooth.
Arrange the tomatoes and cucumber in a plate, drizzle with the dip.

title: Vegan karniyarik with soy mince and tofu
instructions: Pour the vegetable stock over the soy mince, leave to soak for 10 minutes and squeeze out well.
Slit the aubergines lengthways and roast at 220 °C for 20 minutes until soft.
Dice the tomatoes, onion and green pepper and pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Dry-fry the soy mince, tofu, onion, green pepper, tomatoes and pul biber in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until crumbly.
Spoon the filling into the aubergines, bake for 10 more minutes and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Taze fasulye with tofu Turkish green bean tomato pan
instructions: Cut the green beans into rough pieces, dice the tomatoes and onion and pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Sweat the onion in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the tomato purée and pul biber and fry for another 1 minutes stirring.
Add the green beans and tomatoes to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 20 minutes until soft.
