instructions: Rinse the quinoa in a sieve and cook in twice the volume of lightly salted water for 12 minutes.
Cut the green beans into rough pieces, halve the cherry tomatoes and pat the light feta dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Steam the green beans for 6 minutes until tender-crisp.
Whisk the egg and egg whites, cook into a thin omelette in a non-stick pan and cut into strips.
Arrange the quinoa, green beans and cherry tomatoes in a container and sprinkle with the light feta.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Air fryer chicken vegetable skewers with lemon herb marinade
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into 2 cm cubes, thinly slice the courgette, cut the red pepper into 2 cm cubes and cut the red onion into wedges.
Toss the chicken breast with the olive oil, lemon juice and oregano and leave to marinate for 15 minutes.
Thread the chicken breast, courgette, red pepper and red onion alternately onto 4 skewers.
Air-fry the skewers at 190 °C for 14 minutes, turning halfway.

title: Larb gai: Thai chicken salad with mint, lime and toasted rice
instructions: Toast the glutinous rice in a dry pan for 4 minutes.
Finely chop the chicken breast, thinly slice the red onion, roughly chop the mint and coriander, slice the cucumber and separate the romaine lettuce into single leaves.
Cook the chicken with 3 tbsp water in a pan for 5 minutes until crumbly.
Coarsely grind the toasted rice in a mortar and mix with the chicken, onions, herbs, lime juice, tamari and chilli flakes.
Arrange the romaine lettuce and cucumber in a plate.

title: Livorno-style cod with tomatoes, capers and courgette
instructions: Dice the tomatoes and courgette, finely chop the garlic, halve the black olives and finely chop the parsley.
Heat the oil in a pot and sweat the garlic and courgette for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the tomatoes, capers and black olives to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 6 minutes.
Place the cod in the sauce and poach covered for 8 minutes.
Sprinkle with the parsley and serve straight away.

title: Chilli prawns with courgette noodles, cherry tomatoes and coriander
instructions: Cut the courgette into thin strips, thinly slice the garlic, slice the red chilli into thin rings, finely chop the coriander and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the prawns, garlic and red chilli for 3 minutes until golden all over.
Add the courgette and cherry tomatoes and fry for another 2 minutes until tender-crisp.
Drizzle with lime juice, season with salt and sprinkle with coriander.

title: Turkey cauliflower curry with spinach and coconut milk
instructions: Cut the turkey breast into 2 cm cubes, cut the cauliflower into small florets, dice the onion and finely chop the ginger.
Dry-fry the turkey breast in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes until well browned.
Sweat the onion and ginger in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the curry paste, coconut milk and cauliflower to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 12 minutes.
Add the turkey breast and baby spinach and simmer for another 2 minutes until soft.

title: Beef mince broccoli stir-fry with ginger and cauliflower rice
instructions: Cut the broccoli into small florets, finely chop the ginger and garlic and slice the spring onions into thin rings.
Dry-fry the lean beef mince in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until crumbly.
Add the broccoli, ginger and garlic and fry for another 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
For the sauce, stir together the tamari and cornflour with 4 tbsp water until smooth.
Stir in the sauce, bring briefly to the boil and serve with the cauliflower rice fried for 4 minutes.
Sprinkle with the spring onions and serve straight away.

title: Pollock with mustard herb topping, green beans and potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 18 minutes until tender and drain.
Finely chop the parsley.
Stir the mustard with the herbs and oil, spread over the pollock and bake at 200 °C for 12 minutes.
Blanch the green beans in boiling water for 6 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Arrange the coley fillet, green beans and potatoes in a plate.

title: Chicken fajita bowl with cauliflower rice and tomato salsa
instructions: Cut the chicken breast, red pepper and onion into strips, dice the tomatoes and avocado and finely chop the coriander.
Dry-fry the chicken breast, red pepper, onion and cumin in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until golden all over.
Put the tomatoes, coriander and lime juice in a bowl and mix well.
Cook the cauliflower rice in a pan for 4 minutes.
Arrange the cauliflower rice and chicken breast in a bowl and sprinkle with the tomatoes and avocado.

title: Niçoise-style tuna salad with green beans, egg and olives
instructions: Blanch the green beans in boiling water for 6 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Boil the egg for 9 minutes, refresh in cold water, peel and quarter.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and black olives and slice the red onion into thin rings.
For the dressing, stir together the olive oil and lemon juice until smooth.
Toss the tuna, green beans, cherry tomatoes, black olives and red onion with the dressing.

title: Pike-perch on leek and carrot vegetables with beluga lentils
instructions: Rinse the beluga lentils in a sieve and cook in twice the volume of lightly salted water for 20 minutes.
Slice the leek into thin rings and thinly slice the carrots.
Heat the oil in a pot and sweat the leek and carrots for 6 minutes until translucent.
Season the pike-perch and fry skin-side down in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes, turn and cook for 2 more minutes.
Arrange the leek, carrots, beluga lentils and pike-perch fillet in a plate and sprinkle with the dill.

title: Turkey pho with rice noodles, pak choi and Thai basil
instructions: Thinly slice the turkey breast, cut the pak choi into rough pieces and slice the ginger.
Add the vegetable stock, ginger, cinnamon and tamari to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 10 minutes.
Pour boiling water over the rice noodles, leave for 8 minutes and drain.
Add the turkey strips and pak choi to the broth and cook for 3 minutes.
Put the noodles in a deep bowl, pour over the soup and serve with sprouts, Thai basil and lime juice.

title: Roast chicken with Brussels sprouts and sweet potato wedges
instructions: Halve the Brussels sprouts and cut the sweet potato into wedges.
Toss the Brussels sprouts and sweet potato with the oil and rosemary and roast at 210 °C for 15 minutes.
Season the chicken with paprika, add to the tray and cook for 18 more minutes.
Arrange everything in a plate.

title: Tom yum soup with prawns, mushrooms and lemongrass
instructions: Quarter the mushrooms, cut the tomatoes into wedges, cut the lemongrass into rough pieces and slice the red chilli into thin rings.
Add the vegetable stock, lemongrass and red chilli to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 8 minutes.
Add the mushrooms, tomatoes and prawns and simmer for another 4 minutes until cooked through.
Season with lime juice and tamari and serve with coriander.

title: Air fryer turkey burger patties in lettuce leaves
instructions: Finely chop the onion, slice the tomatoes and cucumber and separate the iceberg lettuce into single leaves.
Put the turkey mince, onion, egg whites and smoked paprika in a bowl and mix well.
With damp hands shape the mixture into 2 flat patties.
Cook the turkey mince in the air fryer at 190 °C for 12 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
Place the patties in the lettuce leaves with mustard, tomato and cucumber.

title: Air fryer pollock fish fingers with potato cucumber salad
instructions: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 18 minutes until tender and drain.
Pat the coley fillet dry and cut into finger-thick sticks, thinly slice the potatoes and cucumber and finely chop the dill.
Coat the fish sticks in rice flour, egg white and cornmeal, then air-fry at 200 °C for 10 minutes until crisp.
Toss the potatoes and cucumber with apple cider vinegar, dill, salt and pepper.

title: Meal prep: sesame chicken with quinoa, broccoli and carrot sticks
instructions: Rinse the quinoa in a sieve and cook in twice the volume of lightly salted water for 12 minutes.
Cut the chicken breast into strips, cut the broccoli into small florets and cut the carrots into sticks.
Dry-fry the chicken breast in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until golden all over.
Steam the broccoli and carrots for 5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Arrange the quinoa, chicken breast, broccoli and carrots in a container and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Meal prep: turkey mince chilli with black beans and courgette
instructions: Dice the red pepper and onion.
Dry-fry the turkey mince and onion in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until crumbly.
Dice the courgette.
Add the passata, red pepper, black beans, courgette and cumin to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.

title: Turkey breast and egg rolls in romaine leaves with tomato
instructions: Whisk the eggs, egg whites and chives with salt and pepper.
Cook the egg mixture into a thin omelette in a non-stick pan and cut into strips.
Cut the tomatoes into strips and separate the romaine lettuce into single leaves.
Fill the romaine leaves with the turkey breast, omelette strips and tomato and roll up.

title: Turkey broccoli egg white muffins with pepper
instructions: Chop the sliced turkey breast, finely chop the broccoli and dice the red pepper.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites with salt and pepper.
Stir in the sliced turkey breast, broccoli and red pepper.
Spoon the mixture into 6 muffin cases and bake in the preheated oven at 180 °C for 20 minutes until set.

title: Prawn ceviche with mango, cucumber and coriander
instructions: Blanch the prawns in boiling water for 2 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Dice the prawns, mango and cucumber, cut the red onion into thin strips, finely chop the coriander and slice the red chilli into thin rings.
Mix the prawns, mango, cucumber, onion and chilli with lime juice and leave in the fridge for 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with the coriander and serve straight away.

title: Chicken gyros plate with coleslaw and soy tzatziki
instructions: Thinly slice the chicken breast, cut the white cabbage into thin strips, coarsely grate the cucumber and finely chop the garlic.
Dry-fry the chicken breast and oregano in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until well browned.
For the dip, stir together the soy yoghurt, cucumber and garlic until smooth.
Knead the white cabbage firmly with the apple cider vinegar and salt.
Arrange the chicken breast and white cabbage in a plate, drizzle with the dip.

title: Cod teriyaki with pak choi and basmati rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice in a sieve and cook in twice the volume of lightly salted water for 12 minutes.
Halve the pak choi and finely grate the ginger.
For the sauce, stir together the tamari, maple syrup and ginger with 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Fry the cod in a non-stick pan for 3 minutes per side and glaze with the sauce.
Steam the pak choi for 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Arrange the basmati rice, pak choi and cod fillet in a plate and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.

title: Asian chicken Chinese cabbage soup with glass noodles
instructions: Thinly slice the chicken breast, cut the Chinese cabbage into strips, cut the carrots into thin strips, cut the ginger into thin strips and slice the spring onions into thin rings.
Add the vegetable stock, ginger, tamari and chicken breast to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 6 minutes.
Add the Chinese cabbage, carrots and glass noodles and simmer for another 4 minutes until soft.
Sprinkle with the spring onions and serve straight away.

title: Picadillo pan with beef mince, peppers and olives
instructions: Dice the red pepper, onion, tomatoes and potatoes and halve the black olives.
Dry-fry the lean beef mince and onion in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until crumbly.
Add the red pepper, tomatoes, potatoes, black olives and cumin to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 15 minutes.

title: Rice paper breakfast rolls with tofu scramble and spinach
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers and quarter the cherry tomatoes.
Dry-fry the tofu and turmeric, kala namak in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes until golden all over.
Stir the pea protein with 3 tbsp water, stir in and cook the spinach with it for 1 minute.
Briefly dip the rice paper in warm water, fill with the tofu scramble and tomatoes and roll up.

title: Savoury breakfast bowl with smoked tofu, edamame and cucumber
instructions: Dice the smoked tofu, dice the cucumber, halve the cherry tomatoes and let the edamame thaw.
Dry-fry the smoked tofu in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes until crisp.
Blanch the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes and refresh in cold water.
Arrange the smoked tofu, edamame, cucumber and cherry tomatoes in a bowl.
Drizzle with tamari and sprinkle with cress.

title: Chickpea flour omelette with tofu and mushrooms
instructions: Slice the mushrooms and dice the tofu.
Dry-fry the mushrooms and tofu in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes until well browned.
Whisk the chickpea flour, pea protein, spices and 80 ml water until smooth.
Pour the batter over the mushrooms, tofu and spinach, cook covered for 5 minutes until set, then fold over.

title: Tempeh tofu breakfast hash with pepper and kale
instructions: Dice the tempeh, tofu, red pepper and onion and tear the kale into bite-sized pieces.
Dry-fry the tempeh, tofu, onion and smoked paprika in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until well browned.
Add the red pepper and kale and cook for another 4 minutes until soft.
Arrange everything in a plate.

title: Lupin hummus with celery sticks and radishes
instructions: Rinse and drain the lupins, cut the celery into sticks and halve the radishes.
Blend the lupins, tahini, lemon juice, garlic and cumin in a blender for 45 seconds until creamy.
Blend with 4 tbsp water until creamy, sprinkle with paprika and serve with the celery sticks and radishes.

title: Air fryer tempeh sticks with sriracha soy skyr dip
instructions: Cut the tempeh into sticks.
Toss the tempeh with the tamari and garlic powder and leave to marinate for 5 minutes.
Cook the tempeh in the air fryer at 200 °C for 10 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
For the dip, stir together the soy skyr and sriracha until smooth.

title: Date chocolate silken tofu cream with cherries
instructions: Blend the silken tofu, cocoa, pea protein and dates in a blender for 40 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a dessert glass and chill in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with the cherries and serve straight away.

title: Matcha mango ice lollies with soy skyr
instructions: Blend the soy skyr, matcha, pea protein and frozen mango in a blender for 30 seconds until creamy.
Pour into 4 ice lolly moulds, insert sticks and freeze for at least 5 hours.
Briefly hold the moulds under warm water and release the ice lollies.

title: Tom kha soup with tofu, courgette and lemongrass
instructions: Dice the tofu and courgette, quarter the mushrooms and cut the lemongrass into rough pieces.
Add the vegetable stock, coconut milk and lemongrass to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir the pea protein with 3 tbsp water until smooth and stir in.
Add the tofu, courgette and mushrooms and simmer for another 5 minutes until cooked through.
Season with lime juice and tamari and serve with coriander.

title: Clear ginger tofu broth with edamame, shiitake and wakame
instructions: Dice the tofu, slice the shiitake, cut the ginger into thin strips and slice the spring onions into thin rings.
Soak the wakame in cold water for 5 minutes and drain.
Add the vegetable stock, ginger, tamari and shiitake to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, edamame and wakame and simmer for another 3 minutes until cooked through.
Sprinkle with the spring onions and serve straight away.

title: White bean tomato soup with smoked tofu and rosemary
instructions: Dice the red pepper and dice the smoked tofu.
Sweat the red pepper in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the passata, vegetable stock, white beans, pea protein and rosemary to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 12 minutes.
Blend half of the soup with a stick blender to thicken it and season to taste.
Fry the smoked tofu in a dry pan for 4 minutes until crisp and add to the soup.

title: Mexican bean tofu salad with corn, lupins and lime
instructions: Dice the tofu and tomatoes, roughly chop the coriander and rinse and drain the lupins and black beans.
Dry-fry the tofu and cumin in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until golden all over.
For the dressing, stir together the lime juice and chilli flakes until smooth.
Toss the lupins, tofu, black beans, sweetcorn, tomatoes and coriander with the dressing.

title: Tempeh kale salad with apple, lupins and mustard dressing
instructions: Dice the tempeh, tear the kale into bite-sized pieces, thinly slice the apple and rinse and drain the lupins.
Dry-fry the tempeh in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until well browned.
For the dressing, stir together the mustard and cider vinegar with 1 tbsp water until smooth.
Massage the kale with the dressing for 1 minute until soft and toss with the tempeh, lupins and apple.

title: Aubergine tofu stir-fry with Thai basil and chilli
instructions: Cut the aubergine and tofu into 2 cm cubes, slice the red chilli into thin rings and finely chop the garlic.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until crisp.
Add the aubergine, garlic and red chilli and cook for another 6 minutes until soft.
For the sauce, stir together the tamari, lime juice and pea protein with 3 tbsp water until smooth.
Toss in the sauce, fold in the Thai basil and serve straight away.

title: Mushroom soy mince bolognese with courgette noodles
instructions: Soak the soy mince in hot water for 10 minutes and squeeze out well.
Cut the courgette into thin strips, finely chop the onion and garlic, dice the mushrooms and pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Heat the oil in a pot and sweat the onion, garlic, mushrooms, soy mince and tofu for 4 minutes until translucent.
Add the passata and oregano to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 12 minutes.
Arrange the courgette in a deep plate and sprinkle with the basil.

title: Tofu broccoli stir-fry with peanut ginger sauce and shirataki
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, cut the broccoli into small florets and finely grate the ginger.
Dry-fry the tofu in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until crisp.
Add the broccoli and shirataki noodles and fry for another 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
For the sauce, stir together the peanut butter, tamari, ginger and lime juice with 3 tbsp water until smooth.
Toss everything with the sauce.

title: Stuffed courgettes with crumbled tempeh and tomatoes
instructions: Halve the courgette, pat the tempeh and tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers and dice the tomatoes and onion.
Hollow out the courgettes and chop the flesh.
Dry-fry the tempeh, tofu, onion, tomatoes and oregano in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until well browned.
Fill the courgette with the tempeh.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C conventional, spread the courgette on a lined baking tray and bake for 20 minutes.

title: Edamame spaghetti with tofu, spinach, mushrooms and garlic
instructions: Cook the edamame spaghetti in plenty of salted water for 7 minutes until al dente and drain.
Slice the mushrooms, thinly slice the garlic and dice the tofu.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the tofu, mushrooms and garlic for 5 minutes until well browned.
Add the baby spinach and cook for another 1 minutes until soft.
Toss the noodles with the vegetables and sprinkle with nutritional yeast.

title: Smoked tofu sauerkraut pan with lupins and caraway
instructions: Dice the smoked tofu and onion, finely chop the parsley and rinse and drain the lupins.
Dry-fry the smoked tofu and onion in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until well browned.
Add the sauerkraut, lupins and caraway and cook for another 5 minutes until cooked through.
Sprinkle with the parsley and serve straight away.

title: Sichuan-style mapo silken tofu with shiitake
instructions: Soak the soy mince in hot water for 10 minutes and squeeze out.
Cut the silken tofu into 2 cm cubes, dice the shiitake, slice the red chilli and spring onions into thin rings and finely chop the garlic.
Dry-fry the soy mince, shiitake, garlic and red chilli in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes until well browned.
Stir in the tamari, cornflour and 100 ml water, gently slide in the silken tofu and simmer for 3 minutes.
Sprinkle with the spring onions and serve straight away.

title: Seitan gyros with tomato onion salad and soy tzatziki
instructions: Thinly slice the seitan, cut the tomatoes into wedges, slice the red onion into thin rings, coarsely grate the cucumber and finely chop the garlic.
Dry-fry the seitan and oregano in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until well browned.
For the dip, stir together the soy yoghurt, cucumber and garlic until smooth.
Mix the tomatoes and onion rings with a pinch of salt.
Arrange the seitan, tomatoes and red onion in a plate, drizzle with the dip.

title: Wok-fried seitan with broccoli, ginger and pepper
instructions: Cut the seitan and red pepper into strips, cut the broccoli into small florets and cut the ginger into thin strips.
Heat the oil in a wok and fry the seitan and ginger for 4 minutes until well browned.
Add the broccoli and red pepper and fry for another 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Deglaze with tamari and serve straight away.

title: Seitan mushroom strips in soy cream sauce
instructions: Cut the seitan into strips, slice the mushrooms, dice the onion and finely chop the parsley.
Dry-fry the seitan in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes until well browned.
Add the mushrooms and onion and fry for another 5 minutes until well browned.
For the sauce, stir together the soy drink and cornflour until smooth.
Add the soy drink to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer for 3 minutes.
Sprinkle with the parsley and serve straight away.

title: Wholemeal wrap with seitan strips, hummus and romaine
instructions: Cut the seitan and tomatoes into strips and cut the romaine lettuce into thin strips.
Dry-fry the seitan and smoked paprika in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes until well browned.
Spread the wholemeal wrap with the hummus.
Top with romaine, tomato and seitan, roll up tightly and halve.

title: Bulgur tabbouleh with seitan, mint and lemon
instructions: Pour 60 ml hot water over the bulgur and leave to swell for 15 minutes.
Dice the seitan, tomatoes and red pepper and finely chop the parsley and mint.
Dry-fry the seitan in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes until well browned.
Toss the bulgur, seitan, tomatoes, pepper and herbs with lemon juice, salt and pepper.

title: Meal prep: seitan pepper goulash
instructions: Cut the seitan and red pepper into 2 cm cubes and dice the onion.
Dry-fry the seitan and onion in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until well browned.
Add the tomato purée and sweet paprika and fry for another 1 minutes until cooked through.
Add the vegetable stock and red pepper to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.

title: Air fryer seitan schnitzel with cucumber salad
instructions: Finely crumble the wholemeal toast, brush the seitan slices with mustard and coat in the crumbs.
Cook the seitan in the air fryer at 190 °C for 10 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
Thinly slice the cucumber and finely chop the dill.
For the dressing, stir together the soy yoghurt and dill until smooth.
Toss the cucumber with the dressing.

title: Wholemeal couscous with seitan, courgette and harissa
instructions: Pour 60 ml boiling water over the couscous and leave to swell for 5 minutes.
Dice the seitan and courgette and finely chop the coriander.
Dry-fry the seitan, courgette and harissa in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until well browned.
Arrange the wholewheat couscous, seitan and courgette in a plate and sprinkle with the coriander.

title: Soba noodles with seitan, pak choi and sesame
instructions: Cook the soba noodles in plenty of salted water for 5 minutes until al dente and drain.
Thinly slice the seitan, cut the pak choi into rough pieces and finely grate the ginger.
Dry-fry the seitan and ginger in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes until well browned.
Add the pak choi and fry for another 2 minutes until tender-crisp.
Toss in the noodles and tamari and serve with sesame.

title: Seitan satay skewers with peanut coconut sauce and cucumber
instructions: Cut the seitan into 2 cm cubes and slice the cucumber.
Toss the seitan with the tamari and turmeric and leave to marinate for 10 minutes.
Thread the seitan alternately onto 4 skewers.
Fry the skewers in a griddle pan for 6 minutes, turning.
For the sauce, stir together the peanut butter, coconut milk and lime juice with 1 tbsp water until smooth.

title: Tempeh quinoa bowl with peanut lime dressing
instructions: Rinse the quinoa in a sieve and cook in twice the volume of lightly salted water for 12 minutes.
Dice the tempeh, cut the broccoli into small florets and coarsely grate the carrots.
Dry-fry the tempeh in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until well browned.
Steam the broccoli for 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
For the dressing, stir together the peanut butter, lime juice and tamari with 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Arrange the quinoa, tempeh, broccoli and carrots in a bowl, drizzle with the dressing.

title: Tofu chickpea curry with spinach and basmati rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice in a sieve and cook in twice the volume of lightly salted water for 12 minutes.
Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes and dice the onion.
Sweat the onion in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the curry paste, coconut milk, chickpeas and tofu to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 10 minutes.
Add the baby spinach and simmer for another 2 minutes until soft.
Arrange the basmati rice in a plate.

title: Lentil pasta with tomato tempeh ragù
instructions: Cook the lentil pasta in plenty of salted water for 8 minutes until al dente and drain.
Pat the tempeh dry and crumble roughly with your fingers and finely chop the onion.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the tempeh and onion for 5 minutes until well browned.
Add the passata and oregano to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 10 minutes.
Toss the pasta with the ragù and serve with basil.

title: Meal prep: sweet potato bean tofu chilli
instructions: Dice the sweet potato and onion and pat the tofu dry and crumble roughly with your fingers.
Dry-fry the tofu and onion in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until well browned.
Add the passata, sweet potato, black beans, sweetcorn and cumin to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.

title: Pad thai pan with rice noodles, tofu and edamame
instructions: Pour boiling water over the rice noodles, leave for 8 minutes and drain.
Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes, slice the spring onions into thin rings, roughly chop the peanuts and let the edamame thaw.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the tofu for 5 minutes until golden all over.
Add the rice noodles, edamame and bean sprouts and fry for another 3 minutes until tender-crisp.
For the sauce, stir together the tamari, tamarind paste and lime juice until smooth.
Toss in the sauce and serve with peanuts and spring onions.

title: Burrito bowl with soy mince, brown rice, kidney beans and avocado
instructions: Rinse the brown rice in a sieve and cook in twice the volume of lightly salted water for 30 minutes.
Soak the soy mince in hot water for 10 minutes and squeeze out.
Dry-fry the soy mince and cumin in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until well browned.
Dice the avocado and tomatoes.
Arrange the brown rice, soy mince, kidney beans, sweetcorn, tomatoes and avocado in a bowl.

title: Apple cinnamon protein porridge with peanut butter
instructions: Bring the gluten-free oats and soy drink to the boil and simmer for 4 minutes.
Stir the pea protein with 3 tbsp water until smooth and stir in.
Dice the apple.
Sprinkle with the apple, peanut butter and cinnamon and serve straight away.

title: Buckwheat tempeh pan with kale and onions
instructions: Rinse the buckwheat in a sieve and cook in twice the volume of lightly salted water for 12 minutes.
Dice the tempeh and onion and tear the kale into bite-sized pieces.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the tempeh and onion for 5 minutes until well browned.
Add the kale and buckwheat and cook for another 3 minutes until soft.
Season with tamari.

title: Millet lupin patties with roast vegetables
instructions: Rinse the millet in a sieve and cook in twice the volume of lightly salted water for 15 minutes.
Cut the courgette and red pepper into 2 cm cubes.
Preheat the oven to 210 °C conventional, spread the courgette and red pepper on a lined baking tray and roast for 20 minutes.
Roughly mash the lupins with a fork.
Knead the millet, lupins, chickpea flour and spices, shape into 4 patties and fry in the oil for 4 minutes per side.

title: Coconut lentil dal with tofu and basmati rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice in a sieve and cook in twice the volume of lightly salted water for 12 minutes.
Dice the onion, tomatoes and tofu and finely chop the ginger.
Sweat the onion, ginger and garam masala in a pot with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the red lentils, tomatoes and coconut milk to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 18 minutes.
Add the tofu and simmer for another 3 minutes until cooked through.
Arrange the basmati rice in a plate.

title: Gazpacho with roasted chickpeas and tofu croutons
instructions: Cut the tomatoes, cucumber and red pepper into rough pieces.
Blend the tomatoes, cucumber, red pepper, garlic and cider vinegar in a blender for 45 seconds until creamy.
Cover and chill in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Cook the chickpeas and tofu in the air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
Sprinkle with the chickpeas and tofu and serve straight away.

title: Roast pumpkin plate with lupins, hummus and pomegranate
instructions: Cut the Hokkaido squash into wedges and cut the red onion into wedges.
Preheat the oven to 210 °C conventional, spread the Hokkaido squash, red onion and cumin on a lined baking tray and roast for 25 minutes.
Arrange the rocket, Hokkaido squash, red onion and lupins in a plate.
Add the hummus and sprinkle with pomegranate seeds.

title: Cauliflower chickpea soup with cumin and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Cut the cauliflower into small florets and dice the onion.
Heat the oil in a pot and sweat the onion and cumin for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the vegetable stock, cauliflower and chickpeas to the pot, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender and season with salt and pepper.
Sprinkle with the pumpkin seeds and serve straight away.

title: Mango chia pudding with coconut yoghurt
instructions: Put the chia seeds and soy drink in a glass and mix well.
Cover and leave to set in the fridge for at least 4 hours.
Dice the mango.
Layer the coconut yoghurt and mango in a glass one after the other.

title: Red cabbage apple salad with beluga lentils and walnuts
instructions: Rinse the beluga lentils in a sieve and cook in twice the volume of lightly salted water for 20 minutes.
Cut the red cabbage into thin strips, cut the apple into thin strips and roughly chop the walnuts.
For the dressing, stir together the cider vinegar and mustard with 1 tbsp water until smooth.
Toss the red cabbage, apple and beluga lentils with the dressing.
Sprinkle with the walnuts and serve straight away.

title: Mushroom polenta with thyme, spinach and nutritional yeast
instructions: Stir the polenta into 160 ml boiling salted water and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
Slice the mushrooms.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the mushrooms and thyme for 5 minutes until well browned.
Add the baby spinach and cook for another 1 minutes until soft.
Arrange the polenta, mushrooms and baby spinach in a deep plate and sprinkle with the nutritional yeast.

title: Watermelon cucumber salad with edamame, mint and lime
instructions: Dice the watermelon and cucumber, roughly chop the mint and let the edamame thaw.
Toss the watermelon, cucumber, edamame and mint with lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Sprinkle with the pumpkin seeds and serve straight away.

title: Tofu pepper skewers with chimichurri
instructions: Cut the tofu and red pepper into 2 cm cubes, cut the red onion into wedges and finely chop the parsley and garlic.
Thread the tofu, red pepper and red onion alternately onto 4 skewers.
Fry the skewers in a dry griddle pan for 8 minutes, turning.
Stir the parsley, garlic, oil, apple cider vinegar, pea protein, oregano, chilli flakes and 2 tbsp water into a chimichurri and spoon over the skewers.

title: Parsnip and pear cream soup with roasted chickpeas
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Pat the chickpeas dry, toss with half of the oil and the paprika and roast for 20 minutes until crispy.
Peel and dice the parsnips and pear, chop the onion and sweat in the remaining oil for 3 minutes.
Add the parsnips and pear, pour in the stock and simmer covered for 15 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth, season with salt, pepper and thyme and serve sprinkled with the chickpeas and pumpkin seeds.

title: Sweet potato and black bean soup with avocado and cumin
instructions: Chop the onion and garlic and sweat in the oil for 3 minutes, briefly toasting the cumin and chilli with them.
Peel and dice the sweet potato, add with the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 12 minutes.
Add the beans, simmer for 5 more minutes and roughly blend a third of the soup so it becomes thick.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with diced avocado, coriander and a lime wedge.

title: Beetroot and lentil stew with horseradish yoghurt and dill
instructions: Peel and dice the beetroot and carrot, chop the onion and sweat in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the vegetables, lentils, caraway and stock and simmer covered for 25 minutes until the lentils and beetroot are tender.
Stir the yoghurt with the horseradish and a pinch of salt.
Season the stew with salt and pepper and serve with a dollop of horseradish yoghurt and dill.

title: Chicken and wild rice soup with mushrooms and thyme
instructions: Bring the wild rice to the boil in the stock with the bay leaf and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Slice the carrot, celery and leek, quarter the mushrooms and fry in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the whole chicken breast to the soup and simmer gently for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the chicken, shred with two forks, return to the pan and season with thyme, salt and pepper.

title: Brussels sprout winter salad with beluga lentils, apple and walnuts
instructions: Cook the beluga lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until al dente, drain and let cool.
Trim the Brussels sprouts and shave into fine strips with a sharp knife or mandoline and cut the apple into thin wedges.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard, maple syrup, salt and pepper and massage into the Brussels sprouts for 1 minute.
Fold in the lentils and apple and serve sprinkled with roughly chopped walnuts.

title: Kale winter salad with roasted sweet potato, pomegranate and feta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Dice the sweet potato, toss with half of the oil and the cumin and roast for 25 minutes.
Strip the kale from the stalks, tear into small pieces and massage with the remaining oil, lemon juice and salt for 2 minutes until soft.
Fold the chickpeas and warm sweet potato into the kale and season with pepper.
Serve sprinkled with pomegranate seeds and crumbled feta.

title: Red cabbage and orange salad with chicken breast and pecans
instructions: Finely shred the red cabbage and massage with the vinegar, half of the oil and salt for 2 minutes.
Salt the chicken breast and fry in the remaining oil for 5 to 6 minutes on each side until cooked through, then slice.
Segment the orange, catch the juice and mix it into the red cabbage with the mustard and pepper.
Arrange the red cabbage with the lamb's lettuce and orange segments, top with the chicken and sprinkle with pecans.

title: Fennel and cannellini soup with lemon zest
instructions: Trim the fennel, set the fronds aside and chop the bulb. Chop the onion and garlic.
Sweat the onion, garlic and fennel in half of the oil with the rosemary for 5 minutes.
Add the beans and stock and simmer for 15 minutes, then blend two thirds of the soup until creamy.
Season with lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve with lemon zest, fennel fronds and the remaining oil.

title: Coconut fish soup with cod, sweet potato and spinach
instructions: Finely chop the onion and ginger and sweat with the turmeric in a pan with 2 tbsp of the stock for 2 minutes.
Dice the sweet potato, add with the stock and coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cut the cod into large pieces, add to the soup and poach for 5 minutes, adding the spinach for the last minute.
Season with salt and lime juice and serve with chilli, coriander and a lime wedge.

title: Beef and swede stew with carrots and marjoram
instructions: Cut the beef into cubes and brown well all over in the oil for 5 minutes, briefly frying the chopped onion with it.
Pour in the stock, add the bay leaf and braise covered for 50 minutes.
Peel and dice the swede, carrot and potato, add and cook for another 25 minutes until everything is tender.
Season with marjoram, salt and pepper and serve sprinkled with parsley.

title: Jerusalem artichoke and chestnut soup with hazelnuts and thyme
instructions: Scrub or peel the Jerusalem artichokes thoroughly and slice, chop the onion.
Sweat the onion in the oil for 3 minutes, add the Jerusalem artichokes and 50 g of the chestnuts, pour in the stock and simmer for 20 minutes until soft.
Add the soy drink and blend everything until smooth, then season with nutmeg, thyme, salt and pepper.
Roughly chop the hazelnuts and remaining chestnuts, toast in a dry pan for 2 minutes and sprinkle over the soup.

title: Celeriac and apple cream soup with lupin beans and chives
instructions: Peel and dice the celeriac, dice 100 g of the apple and cut the rest into fine matchsticks. Chop the onion.
Sweat the onion in the oil for 3 minutes, add the celeriac and diced apple, pour in the stock and simmer for 20 minutes until soft.
Add the soy drink and half of the lupin beans and blend everything very smoothly, then season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Serve topped with the remaining lupin beans, apple matchsticks and chives.

title: Chana saag with ginger, tomatoes and brown rice
instructions: Bring the brown rice to the boil with twice its volume of water and cook covered for 30 minutes.
Chop the onion, garlic and half of the ginger and fry in the oil for 4 minutes, toasting the spices with them for 1 minute.
Dice the tomato and add with the spinach, let wilt and roughly blend with a splash of water.
Add the chickpeas, simmer for 8 minutes, season with salt and serve with the rice, the remaining ginger strips and coriander.

title: Squash and bean tacos with red cabbage lime slaw
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Dice the squash, toss with half of the oil and the spices and roast for 20 minutes.
Finely shred the red cabbage and massage with the juice of half a lime, the remaining oil and salt.
Warm the beans in a small pan and lightly mash, and warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds on each side.
Fill the tortillas with beans, squash, red cabbage slaw, avocado slices and coriander and serve with a lime wedge.

title: Freekeh tabbouleh with pomegranate, cucumber and chickpeas
instructions: Bring the freekeh to the boil with three times its volume of salted water and simmer for 20 minutes, then drain and let cool.
Finely dice the cucumber and tomato and chop the parsley and mint.
Stir together the lemon juice, oil, sumac, salt and pepper.
Mix the freekeh, chickpeas, vegetables and herbs with the dressing and serve sprinkled with pomegranate seeds.

title: Kabocha nimono with adzuki beans, tofu and brown rice
instructions: Bring the brown rice to the boil with twice its volume of water and cook covered for 30 minutes.
Deseed the squash and cut into wedges with the skin on, cut the ginger into thin strips and dice the tofu.
Bring the water, tamari, maple syrup and ginger to the boil, add the squash and simmer gently covered for 12 minutes.
Add the adzuki beans and tofu, let them simmer for 5 minutes and serve with the rice, sesame and spring onion rings.

title: Azifa – Ethiopian lentil salad with mustard, green chilli and tomato
instructions: Cook the lentils in plenty of water for 20 to 25 minutes until al dente, drain and let cool until lukewarm.
Finely dice the onion and tomato, cut the chilli into thin rings and chop the parsley.
Whisk together the mustard, lemon juice, oil, salt and pepper.
Mix the lentils with the vegetables, chilli and dressing, leave to marinate for 10 minutes and serve with a lemon wedge.

title: Fasolakia – Greek green beans with white beans, tomatoes and feta
instructions: Chop the onion and garlic and sweat in the oil for 4 minutes.
Trim and halve the green beans, dice the potato and add both with the tomatoes, oregano and 100 ml water.
Braise covered for 25 minutes until the beans and potato are tender, adding the white beans for the last 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with crumbled feta and dill.

title: Urad dal with kidney beans, yoghurt and brown rice
instructions: Soak the urad beans overnight, drain and cook in fresh water for 35 minutes until soft. Cook the brown rice for 30 minutes alongside.
Chop the onion, garlic and ginger and fry in the butter for 4 minutes, toasting the spices with them for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, urad beans and kidney beans and simmer for 10 minutes until creamy, mashing some of the beans.
Season with salt and serve with a dollop of yoghurt, coriander and the rice.

title: Maghmour – Lebanese eggplant and chickpea stew with bulgur
instructions: Cut the eggplant into large cubes, salt and fry all over in the oil for 6 minutes.
Chop the onion and garlic, add with the allspice and cinnamon and fry for 2 minutes.
Dice the tomatoes, add with the chickpeas and 100 ml water and braise covered for 25 minutes.
Pour 100 ml boiling salted water over the bulgur and leave to swell for 10 minutes, then serve with the stew and mint.

title: Tinga de pollo with black beans and brown rice
instructions: Bring the brown rice to the boil with twice its volume of water and cook covered for 30 minutes.
Poach the chicken breast in lightly salted water for 15 minutes until cooked through, then shred with two forks.
Slice the onion and fry with the garlic in the oil for 4 minutes, add the tomatoes, chipotle, oregano and cumin and simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm the chicken in the sauce, heat the beans separately and arrange everything with the rice, diced avocado and coriander.

title: Sri Lankan style pumpkin and lentil curry with curry leaves and brown rice
ingredients: Curry leaves, turmeric, cumin, chilli flakes
instructions: Bring the brown rice to the boil with twice its volume of water and cook covered for 30 minutes.
Chop the onion and garlic and fry with the curry leaves, turmeric and cumin in the oil for 3 minutes.
Dice the pumpkin, add with the lentils, coconut milk and 250 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes until the lentils and pumpkin are soft.
Stir in the spinach, season with salt and serve the curry with the rice and chilli flakes.

title: Overnight oats with pear, cardamom and walnuts
instructions: Stir the oats, skyr, milk and cardamom together in a jar and refrigerate covered overnight.
In the morning wash, core and finely dice the pear.
Top the oats with the pear and sprinkle with roughly chopped walnuts and cinnamon.

title: Chickpea flour pancake with courgette and cherry tomatoes
instructions: Whisk the chickpea flour with the water, turmeric, cumin and salt until smooth and stir in the coarsely grated courgette.
Spread the batter in the hot oil in a non-stick pan and cook for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and slice the spring onion into rings.
Serve the pancake with the tomatoes, spring onion, a dollop of soy yoghurt and pepper.

title: Persimmon cinnamon quark with puffed quinoa and pecans
instructions: Stir the quark with the milk, vanilla and a pinch of cinnamon until smooth and spoon into a bowl.
Wash the persimmon, remove the stalk and cut into thin wedges.
Arrange the persimmon wedges, puffed quinoa and pecans on the quark and dust with cinnamon.

title: Salmon scrambled eggs on pumpernickel with chives
instructions: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper and cook in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes, stirring, until creamy and set.
Slice the cucumber thinly and cut the chives into fine rolls.
Spoon the scrambled eggs onto the pumpernickel slices, top with the salmon, sprinkle with chives and serve with the cucumber slices.

title: Skyr bowl with pomegranate, mandarin and hazelnuts
instructions: Stir the skyr until smooth and spoon into a bowl.
Peel the mandarins and divide into segments, then roughly chop the hazelnuts.
Arrange the mandarins, pomegranate seeds and hazelnuts on the skyr and drizzle with honey.

title: Smoked tofu scramble on bread with cherry tomatoes and chives
instructions: Crumble the smoked tofu coarsely with a fork.
Fry in the hot oil with the turmeric, salt and pepper for 4 minutes, stirring, until golden yellow.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and toast the bread if you like.
Spoon the scramble onto the bread, top with the tomatoes and sprinkle with chives.

title: Cottage cheese and pear toast with walnuts and honey
instructions: Toast the bread slices until golden brown.
Core the pear and slice thinly, then chop the walnuts.
Spread the toast with cottage cheese, top with the pear slices, sprinkle with walnuts and cinnamon and drizzle with honey.

title: Pepper and feta omelette with baby spinach and oregano
instructions: Finely dice the pepper and fry in the oil in a non-stick pan for 2 minutes, then add the spinach and let it wilt.
Whisk the eggs with the oregano, salt and pepper, pour over the vegetables and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes until set.
Crumble the feta over it, fold the omelette and serve straight away.

title: Protein semolina pudding with sour cherries and cinnamon
instructions: Bring the milk to the boil with the vanilla, sprinkle in the semolina and simmer for 3 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the quark and maple syrup until smooth.
Spoon into a bowl, top with the sour cherries and dust with cinnamon.

title: Millet porridge with cinnamon apple, almonds and soy drink
instructions: Bring the millet flakes to the boil with the soy drink and simmer for 4 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Take off the heat and stir in the pea protein until smooth.
Dice the apple and meanwhile steam in a small pan with cinnamon and 1 tbsp water for 3 minutes until soft.
Spoon the porridge into a bowl, top with the cinnamon apple and flaked almonds and drizzle with maple syrup.

title: Baked apple quark ice cream with flaked almonds
instructions: Core and dice the apple and bake with cinnamon in a small dish at 200 °C for 15 minutes until soft, then let cool.
Blend two thirds of the baked apple with the quark, honey and vanilla until smooth and fold in the rest.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Scoop into a bowl and sprinkle with toasted flaked almonds and cinnamon.

title: Carrot and mandarin smoothie with soy skyr and turmeric
instructions: Peel and roughly chop the carrot and peel the mandarins.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Air fryer Brussels sprouts with parmesan and lemon
instructions: Trim and halve the Brussels sprouts and toss with the oil, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Roast in the air fryer at 190 °C for 12 to 14 minutes until crispy, shaking halfway through.
Drizzle with lemon juice while hot and sprinkle with finely grated hard cheese and lemon zest.

title: Air fryer plum crumble with walnuts
instructions: Halve and stone the plums and place cut side up in a small air fryer safe dish.
Rub the oats, chopped walnuts, maple syrup, oil and cinnamon together into a crumble and scatter over the plums.
Bake in the air fryer at 180 °C for 10 to 12 minutes until the crumble is golden brown.
Let cool briefly and serve with a dollop of skyr and cinnamon.

title: Chestnut cocoa cream with silken tofu and dark chocolate shavings
instructions: Set one chestnut aside and roughly chop the rest.
Drain the silken tofu and blend with the chestnuts, cocoa, maple syrup and vanilla until very smooth and airy.
Spoon into a dessert glass and chill for at least 30 minutes.
Garnish with grated chocolate and the whole chestnut.

title: Mandarin frozen yoghurt made with skyr and pistachios
instructions: Peel the mandarins, set two segments aside and blend the rest with the skyr, honey and vanilla until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Scoop into a bowl and garnish with the pistachios and mandarin segments.

title: Green kiwi spinach shake with pea protein
instructions: Peel the kiwis and cut into pieces, setting one thin slice aside for the rim of the glass.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Gingerbread chia pudding with orange segments and almonds
instructions: Stir together the chia seeds, soy yoghurt, soy drink, maple syrup and gingerbread spice, leave to swell for 5 minutes and stir again.
Pour into a glass and leave to set in the fridge for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Segment the orange, arrange the segments on the pudding and sprinkle with flaked almonds and cinnamon.

title: Creamy cheddar broccoli soup with chicken strips
instructions: Poach the chicken breast in the stock for 15 minutes until cooked through, then remove and pull into thin strips.
Divide the broccoli into florets, set a few small ones aside, sweat the rest in the butter for 2 minutes and cook in the stock for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the cream, blend until smooth, stir in half of the grated cheddar and cook the remaining florets in it for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken strips, season with nutmeg, salt and pepper and serve sprinkled with the remaining cheddar.

title: Duck breast with Brussels sprouts and walnut butter
instructions: Score the duck skin in a diamond pattern, salt and place skin side down in a cold pan, heat slowly and fry for 8 minutes until crispy.
Turn over, fry for another 4 minutes and leave to rest in foil for 5 minutes.
Halve the Brussels sprouts and fry in the duck fat for 6 minutes until golden, add the butter, chopped walnuts and thyme and toss for 1 minute.
Slice the duck breast, season with pepper and serve with the walnut Brussels sprouts.

title: Trout with almond butter, spinach and cauliflower purée
instructions: Divide the cauliflower into florets, boil in salted water for 12 minutes until soft, drain and blend smoothly with the cream, nutmeg and salt.
Wilt the spinach with the chopped garlic in a pan for 2 minutes and season with salt.
Salt the trout and fry in half of the butter skin side down for 4 minutes, then 1 minute on the other side until cooked.
Foam the remaining butter with the almonds until golden, pour over the trout with the lemon zest and serve with the purée and spinach.

title: Shirataki noodles with tofu, baby pak choi and peanut sauce
instructions: Rinse the shirataki noodles thoroughly and dry-fry in a pan without fat for 3 minutes, then remove.
Dice the tofu and fry in the rapeseed oil for 6 minutes until golden all over, frying the halved pak choi with it for 2 minutes.
Stir the peanut butter with the tamari, sesame oil, ginger, lime juice and 3 tbsp warm water until smooth.
Add the noodles and sauce to the pan, toss briefly and serve with chopped peanuts, chilli and a lime wedge.

title: Lamb fillet with rosemary butter and creamed savoy cabbage
instructions: Cut the savoy cabbage into thin strips, sweat in a third of the butter for 3 minutes, add the cream and braise covered for 8 minutes until soft, then season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden and set aside.
Salt the lamb fillet and fry all over in a third of the butter for 6 to 8 minutes until pink inside, then leave to rest for 3 minutes.
Foam the remaining butter with the chopped garlic and rosemary, slice the lamb, drizzle with the rosemary butter and serve with the creamed cabbage and pine nuts.

title: Meal prep box with tikka chicken, chickpea rice and cucumber salad
instructions: Dice the chicken breast and marinate with 30 g of the yoghurt, tikka spice, garlic and salt for at least 15 minutes. Cook the brown rice for 30 minutes alongside.
Fry the chicken in the hot oil for 8 to 10 minutes until well browned all over and cooked through.
Mix the chickpeas into the rice, dice the cucumber and tomato and stir the remaining yoghurt with mint and salt.
Pack the chicken, chickpea rice and cucumber salad side by side into a container and spoon the mint yoghurt on top.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
At the office eat cold or reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot.

title: Meal prep box with beef kofta, bulgur and cucumber tomato salad
instructions: Knead the beef mince with some of the finely chopped onion, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper and shape into 4 oblong kofta.
Fry the kofta in the oil on all sides for 8 to 10 minutes until cooked through.
Pour 120 ml boiling salted water over the bulgur, leave to swell for 10 minutes and mix with parsley.
Dice the cucumber, tomato and remaining onion, pack everything into a container and spoon the yoghurt on top.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
At the office eat cold or reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot.

title: Meal prep box with teriyaki glazed tempeh, buckwheat and carrot broccoli
instructions: Bring the buckwheat to the boil with twice its volume of salted water and cook covered for 12 minutes.
Divide the broccoli into florets, cut the carrot into thin strips and steam both for 4 minutes.
Slice the tempeh and fry in the oil for 3 minutes on each side, add the tamari, maple syrup and grated ginger and glaze for 1 minute.
Pack the tempeh, buckwheat and vegetables side by side into a container and sprinkle with sesame.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Meal prep box with salmon, quinoa, beetroot and lamb's lettuce
instructions: Rinse the quinoa with hot water and simmer with twice its volume of salted water for 12 minutes, then let the steam escape.
Salt the salmon and bake in the oven at 200 °C for 12 to 14 minutes until cooked.
Dice the beetroot and stir the oil, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper into a dressing and pour into a small screw-top jar.
Pack the salmon, quinoa, beetroot, lamb's lettuce and walnuts side by side into a container.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Eat cold straight from the container, mixing in the dressing just before eating.

title: Meal prep box with turkey mince chili and roasted sweet potato
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Dice the sweet potato, toss with half of the oil and salt and roast for 25 minutes.
Fry the turkey mince with the chopped onion in the remaining oil for 6 minutes until crumbly and cooked through, briefly toasting the spices with it.
Dice the pepper and add with the tomatoes, beans and sweetcorn, simmer for 15 minutes until thick and season.
Pack the chili and sweet potato side by side into a container and sprinkle with coriander.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Soy skyr with pear, tahini and black sesame
instructions: Stir the soy skyr until smooth and spread it in a shallow bowl.
Wash and core the pear, cut it into thin wedges and fan them over the skyr.
Drizzle the tahini over in thin lines, sprinkle with black sesame and cinnamon and eat straight away.

title: Cottage cheese bowl with cherry tomatoes, cucumber, hemp seeds and za'atar
instructions: Halve the cherry tomatoes, wash the cucumber and cut it into small cubes.
Put the cottage cheese into a shallow bowl and spread the vegetables on top.
Sprinkle with hemp seeds and za'atar, drizzle with olive oil and season lightly with salt and pepper.

title: Rye crispbread with smoked trout, apple and horseradish skyr
instructions: Stir the skyr with the horseradish and a little salt and pepper until smooth.
Wash and core the apple and cut it into thin slices, pull the trout fillet into pieces.
Spread the crispbread with the horseradish skyr, top with the trout and apple slices and sprinkle with dill.

title: Skyr with mandarins, cocoa nibs and hazelnuts
instructions: Peel the mandarins and divide them into segments, roughly chop the hazelnuts.
Stir the skyr until smooth and put it into a shallow bowl.
Arrange the mandarin segments on top and sprinkle with cocoa nibs and hazelnuts.

title: Kimchi scrambled eggs with spring onions on wholemeal toast
instructions: Toast the bread. Slice the spring onions into thin rings and roughly chop half of the kimchi.
Fry the chopped kimchi in the oil for 1 minute, add the beaten eggs and let them set over medium heat for 2 minutes into creamy scrambled eggs.
Pile the scrambled eggs onto the toast, sprinkle with spring onions and serve the remaining kimchi beside it.

title: Edamame and pea mash on rye bread with radishes
instructions: Cook the edamame and peas in boiling water for 4 minutes and drain.
Roughly mash with the olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Spread the mash on the bread, top with thin radish slices and sprinkle with a little lemon zest.

title: Pumpkin spice quark with pumpkin purée and pecans
instructions: Stir the quark with half of the pumpkin purée and the spices until smooth.
Layer it in a jar, alternating with the remaining pumpkin purée.
Top with the pecans, drizzle with maple syrup and dust with a little cinnamon.

title: Kale and banana smoothie with soy skyr and hemp seeds
instructions: Wash the kale, remove the tough stalks and roughly tear the leaves. Peel the banana.
Blend the kale, banana, soy skyr, soy drink and 10 g of the hemp seeds in a blender for about 1 minute until very smooth.
Pour into a large glass, sprinkle with the remaining hemp seeds and drink straight away.

title: Microwave porridge with berries, skyr and flaxseed
instructions: Stir the oats and milk together in a large microwave-safe bowl.
Heat at 800 watts for 2 minutes, stir and cook for another 1 minute until the porridge is creamy.
Briefly thaw the berries in the microwave, add them to the porridge with the skyr and sprinkle with flaxseed and flaked almonds.

title: Cinnamon orange skyr with dates and almonds
instructions: Peel the orange with a knife, removing the white pith, and cut it into round slices.
Stir the skyr with half of the cinnamon and put it into a shallow bowl. Finely chop the date.
Lay the orange slices on the skyr, sprinkle with the date and almonds and dust with the remaining cinnamon.

title: Cottage cheese toast with peach, pistachios and thyme
instructions: Toast the bread slices until golden brown.
Wash and stone the peach and cut it into thin wedges.
Spread the toast with cottage cheese, top with the peach, sprinkle with pistachios and thyme leaves and drizzle with honey.

title: Breakfast salad with soft-boiled eggs, rocket, pear and cottage cheese
instructions: Cook the eggs in boiling water for 6 minutes until soft-boiled, rinse under cold water and peel.
Wash the rocket, core the pear and cut it into thin wedges, then spread both on a plate.
Add the cottage cheese in spoonfuls, halve the eggs and place them on top.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar and season with salt and pepper.

title: Grapefruit skyr with mint, pistachios and pomegranate
instructions: Peel the grapefruit, removing the white pith, and cut the segments out from between the membranes.
Stir the skyr with the honey and put it into a shallow bowl.
Arrange the grapefruit segments and pomegranate seeds on top and sprinkle with pistachios and small mint leaves.

title: Scandinavian breakfast plate with tuna, egg, cucumber and crispbread
instructions: Hard-boil the egg in boiling water for 8 minutes, rinse under cold water, peel and halve.
Cut the cucumber into thin slices, halve the cherry tomatoes, flake the tuna with a fork and season with pepper.
Arrange the crispbread, tuna, egg, cucumber and tomatoes on a plate and sprinkle with dill.

title: Silken tofu mango lassi bowl with pea protein and coconut
instructions: Peel the mango and dice the flesh, setting a third of the cubes aside.
Blend the silken tofu, the remaining mango, the pea protein and the cardamom for 30 seconds until thick and creamy.
Pour into a shallow bowl, top with the mango cubes and desiccated coconut and eat straight away.

title: Overnight soy skyr with sour cherries, cocoa and chia
instructions: Stir the soy skyr with the cocoa, pea protein and chia seeds until smooth.
Layer it in a jar, alternating with 80 g of the sour cherries, and place the remaining cherries on top.
Seal the jar and refrigerate overnight, for at least 6 hours.

title: Savoury soy skyr bowl with cucumber, radishes and hazelnut dukkah
instructions: Toast the hazelnuts and sesame in a dry pan for 3 minutes, chop roughly and mix with the cumin, coriander and salt.
Dice the cucumber and cut the radishes into thin slices.
Stir the soy skyr with a little salt and pepper, put it into a shallow bowl, spread the vegetables on top, sprinkle with the dukkah, drizzle with olive oil and garnish with mint.

title: Mozzarella scrambled eggs with cherry tomatoes and basil
instructions: Fry the cherry tomatoes in the oil over high heat for 3 minutes until the skins burst, season with salt and remove. Toast the bread.
Beat the eggs, pour them into the pan and let them set over medium heat for 2 minutes while stirring, then fold in the torn mozzarella and let it melt briefly.
Serve the scrambled eggs with the tomatoes and the toast, season with pepper and sprinkle with basil.

title: Banana egg white omelette with blueberries
instructions: Whisk the egg whites with the oats and cinnamon and let soak for 2 minutes. Slice the banana.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan, pour in the egg white mixture and let it set over medium heat for 3 minutes, then turn and cook for 1 more minute.
Cover one half with the banana slices, fold over and serve with the blueberries and a dollop of skyr, dusted with cinnamon.

title: Cocoa millet flake porridge with skyr and raspberries
instructions: Bring the milk and cocoa to the boil in a small pan and stir in the millet flakes.
Let it swell over low heat for 3 minutes while stirring until creamy and sweeten with the maple syrup.
Spoon into a bowl, add a dollop of skyr and top with the raspberries.

title: Miso caramel banana nice cream with peanuts
instructions: Blend the dates with the miso and 20 ml of the soy drink into a smooth caramel cream and set aside.
Let the frozen banana soften for 5 minutes and blend with the pea protein and the remaining soy drink in a food processor for 1 to 2 minutes until creamy.
Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with the miso caramel cream and sprinkle with the chopped peanuts.

title: Speculoos spice skyr ice cream with almonds
instructions: Stir the skyr with the honey and the spices until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Toast the flaked almonds in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden, spoon the ice cream into a bowl and sprinkle with the almonds.

title: Baked apple protein shake with soy drink and cinnamon
instructions: Core the apple, cut it into pieces, sprinkle with cinnamon and cook covered in the microwave at 800 watts for 4 minutes until soft, then let cool briefly.
Blend the apple with the cold soy drink, soy protein and vanilla in a blender for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass, dust with a little cinnamon and drink straight away.

title: Iced matcha protein latte with pea protein and vanilla
instructions: Whisk the matcha with 30 ml of warm water until free of lumps.
Blend the cold soy drink with the pea protein, almond butter and vanilla for 20 seconds until frothy and briefly blend in the matcha.
Put the ice cubes into a large glass, pour the matcha latte over them and drink straight away.

title: Matcha silken tofu pudding with raspberries
instructions: Stir the agar agar into 50 ml of water in a small pan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes while stirring.
Blend the silken tofu, soy protein, matcha and maple syrup until smooth, add the hot agar mixture and blend briefly.
Pour into a dessert glass and let set in the fridge for at least 2 hours.
Top with the raspberries before serving.

title: Chickpea cookie dough with peanut butter and cocoa nibs
instructions: Rinse the chickpeas thoroughly, drain and pat dry with kitchen paper.
Blend with the peanut butter, maple syrup, pea protein, vanilla and salt in a food processor for 2 minutes into a smooth dough.
Fold in half of the cocoa nibs, spoon into a bowl and sprinkle with the remaining cocoa nibs.

title: Lemon cheesecake shake with low-fat quark and blueberries
instructions: Set aside a little lemon zest and a few blueberries for the top.
Blend the quark, milk, remaining blueberries, lemon juice, lemon zest and honey in a blender for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass, garnish with the blueberries and lemon zest and drink straight away.

title: Cinnamon star soy skyr cream with hazelnuts and orange zest
instructions: Stir the soy skyr with the soy protein, maple syrup and cinnamon until smooth.
Roughly chop the hazelnuts and toast them in a dry pan for 2 minutes.
Spoon the cream into a dessert glass, sprinkle with the hazelnuts and orange zest and dust with a little cinnamon.

title: Kale chips with paprika and nutritional yeast
instructions: Preheat the oven to 140 °C fan. Wash the kale, spin it very dry and tear the leaves off the stalks into large pieces.
Massage with the olive oil, paprika and a little salt and sprinkle with the nutritional yeast and sesame seeds.
Spread on a baking tray lined with baking paper and bake for 15 to 20 minutes until crisp, turning after 10 minutes.
Let cool briefly so the chips crisp up further.

title: Strawberry protein fluff with frozen strawberries and whey
instructions: Let two strawberries thaw and slice them.
Blend the remaining frozen strawberries with the whey and milk into a coarse purée.
Put the purée into a tall bowl and whip with a hand mixer on the highest setting for 5 minutes until airy and about three times the volume.
Spoon into a bowl, top with the strawberry slices and eat straight away.

title: Chocolate orange pudding with agar and soy protein
instructions: Stir the soy drink with the cocoa, agar agar and maple syrup in a small pan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes while stirring.
Remove from the heat and vigorously stir in the soy protein and a little orange zest until smooth.
Pour into a dessert glass and let set in the fridge for at least 2 hours.
Top with the orange segments and serve.

title: Mango and passion fruit yoghurt ice lollies
instructions: Peel the mango, dice the flesh and blend finely with the yoghurt and lime juice.
Stir in the passion fruit pulp with the seeds.
Pour the mixture into 2 ice lolly moulds, insert the sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours.
Briefly hold the moulds under warm water and release the lollies.

title: Tuna and cottage cheese spread with radishes and pepper strips
instructions: Drain the tuna well and mix with the cottage cheese, lemon juice, salt and pepper using a fork until creamy.
Spoon into a small bowl and sprinkle with chopped chives.
Halve the radishes, cut the pepper into strips and arrange them around the spread for dipping.

title: Hazelnut cocoa shake with silken tofu and pea protein
instructions: Chop the date finely.
Blend the silken tofu, soy drink, pea protein, hazelnut butter, cocoa and date in a blender for about 1 minute until very creamy.
Pour into a large glass, dust with a little cocoa and drink straight away.

title: Microwave banana bread in a mug with walnuts
instructions: Set aside two banana slices and mash the rest in a large mug with a fork.
Stir in the egg, oats, quark, baking powder, cinnamon and half of the chopped walnuts.
Top with the banana slices and remaining walnuts and cook in the microwave at 800 watts for 2 minutes until risen and set.
Let rest for 1 minute and enjoy warm.

title: Pineapple mint sorbet with a soy skyr topping
instructions: Let the frozen pineapple soften for 5 minutes.
Blend with the lime juice, maple syrup and a few mint leaves in a food processor for 1 to 2 minutes into a smooth sorbet.
Spoon into a bowl, top with the soy skyr, garnish with mint and a little lime zest and eat straight away.

title: Warm cranberry and pear compote with vanilla quark and pistachios
instructions: Peel, core and dice the pear.
Simmer the pear with the cranberries, honey, cinnamon and 3 tbsp of water in a small pan for 6 minutes until the cranberries burst.
Stir the quark with the vanilla until smooth, put it into a bowl with the warm compote and sprinkle with the pistachios.

title: Oven-baked apple chips with cinnamon and a skyr dip
instructions: Preheat the oven to 100 °C fan. Wash the apples and slice them crosswise very thinly, removing the core.
Lay the slices side by side on two trays lined with baking paper, dust with cinnamon and dry for 90 minutes, keeping the oven door slightly open with a wooden spoon.
Let the chips cool on a rack until crisp. Stir the skyr with the honey and serve as a dip.

title: Mini sweet peppers filled with herb cottage cheese
instructions: Wash the mini peppers, halve them lengthways and remove the seeds.
Mix the cottage cheese with the finely chopped garlic, half of the herbs, salt and pepper.
Fill the pepper halves with the cream and sprinkle with the remaining herbs.

title: Beetroot walnut dip with cucumber sticks
instructions: Roughly dice the beetroot and set aside a few walnuts for the top.
Blend the beetroot, remaining walnuts, skyr, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, salt and pepper into a thick dip.
Spoon into a small bowl, sprinkle with the chopped walnuts and drizzle with olive oil. Cut the cucumber into sticks and serve alongside.

title: Gochujang beef mince rice bowl with fried egg
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions for about 15 minutes.
Fry the beef mince in the sesame oil until crumbly, add the garlic and gochujang with 2 tbsp of water and glaze for 2 minutes.
Fry the egg sunny side up in a second pan. Cut the cucumber into thin slices.
Put the rice into a bowl, arrange the mince, cucumber and fried egg on top and sprinkle with spring onions and sesame.

title: Protein pasta salad with chicken, peas and skyr dressing
instructions: Cook the fusilli in salted water for 10 minutes, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Fry the chicken breast in the oil for 5 to 6 minutes per side until cooked through, season with salt, let cool and dice.
Stir the skyr with the mustard, herbs, salt and pepper into a dressing. Dice the cucumber.
Toss the pasta, peas, chicken and cucumber with the dressing and serve sprinkled with herbs.

title: Beef rump with polenta and chanterelles
instructions: Bring the stock to the boil, sprinkle in the polenta and cook over low heat for 10 minutes while stirring until creamy, then stir in the parmesan.
Pat the steak dry and fry it in the oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side, season with salt and pepper and let rest for 5 minutes.
Clean the chanterelles and fry them with the chopped shallot in the butter for 4 minutes, then season with parsley, salt and pepper.
Slice the steak and serve with the polenta and chanterelles.

title: Turkey escalopes with potato and cucumber salad
instructions: Boil the potatoes in their skins for 20 minutes, peel, let cool slightly and cut into slices.
Stir the yoghurt with the mustard, vinegar, 5 g of the oil, salt and pepper and mix with the potatoes, thin cucumber slices and chives.
Pound the turkey escalopes flat, season with salt and pepper and fry in the remaining oil for 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Serve the escalopes with the salad and a lemon wedge.

title: Tempeh bolognese with wholemeal spaghetti
instructions: Soak the soy mince in 60 ml of hot water for 10 minutes. Crumble the tempeh finely with your fingers and finely dice the carrot and onion.
Fry the tempeh in the oil for 5 minutes, add the onion, carrot, garlic and soy mince and fry for 3 more minutes.
Add the passata and oregano and simmer for 15 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile cook the spaghetti in salted water for 10 minutes until al dente, serve with the sauce and sprinkle with nutritional yeast and basil.

title: Turkey mince and potato pan with peppers and fried egg
instructions: Peel the potatoes, cut them into 1 cm cubes and fry in 8 g of the oil over medium heat for 12 minutes until golden.
Add the turkey mince, diced onion and pepper and fry for 6 minutes until the mince is cooked through, then season with paprika, marjoram, salt and pepper.
Fry an egg sunny side up in the remaining oil, place it on top of the pan and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Beef goulash with wholemeal spaetzle and cucumber salad
instructions: Pat the meat dry and brown it well in the oil in two batches.
Cut the onions into strips and fry them with the meat, briefly toast the tomato paste, paprika and caraway and deglaze with the stock.
Braise covered over low heat for 80 minutes until the meat is tender, then season with salt and pepper.
Heat the spaetzle in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes until golden. Slice the cucumber thinly and dress with dill, salt and a splash of water. Serve everything together.

title: Peanut turkey noodles with broccoli and lime
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the packet instructions, adding the broccoli florets for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Fry the turkey strips in the oil for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Stir the peanut butter with the soy sauce, the juice of half the lime half, grated ginger and 4 tbsp of hot water until smooth.
Toss the noodles, broccoli and turkey with the sauce, sprinkle with chopped peanuts and coriander and serve with a lime wedge.

title: Protein lasagne with turkey mince and cottage cheese
instructions: Fry the turkey mince with the diced onion in the oil until crumbly, add the diced zucchini and passata, season with oregano, salt and pepper and simmer for 10 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Layer sauce, lasagne sheets and cottage cheese alternately in a small baking dish, finishing with sauce.
Top with torn mozzarella and bake for 35 minutes until golden.
Let rest for 5 minutes and serve with basil.

title: Chicken burrito with rice, beans and cheddar
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions for about 30 minutes.
Cut the chicken breast into strips, season with cumin and paprika and fry with the pepper in the oil for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Finely dice the tomato and season with salt. Briefly warm the beans.
Briefly warm the wrap in the pan, fill with rice, beans, chicken, pepper, tomato salsa and cheddar, roll up tightly, cut in half and serve with the yoghurt.

title: Lamb mince bulgur pan with yoghurt and cucumber
instructions: Fry the lamb mince in the oil until crumbly, add the diced onion and fry for 3 more minutes, then briefly toast the tomato paste and spices.
Add the bulgur and diced tomato, pour in the stock and let swell covered over low heat for 12 minutes.
Dice the cucumber. Season the bulgur pan with salt and pepper and serve with the yoghurt, cucumber and mint.

title: Beef and lentil chili with brown rice and yoghurt
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions for about 30 minutes.
Fry the beef mince in the oil until crumbly, add the diced onion, pepper and spices and fry for 3 more minutes.
Add the lentils, passata and 200 ml of water and simmer for 25 minutes, warming the kidney beans for the last 5 minutes, then season with salt.
Serve the chili with the rice, topped with the yoghurt and coriander.

title: Chicken gnocchi in creamy paprika sauce
instructions: Dice the chicken breast, season with salt and fry in the oil for 5 minutes on all sides until cooked through, then remove.
Fry the gnocchi in the same pan for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the onion and pepper cut into strips and fry for 3 minutes, stir in the paprika, passata and cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
Return the chicken to the pan, season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Turkey steak with roasted sweet potato, Brussels sprouts and herb quark
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Cut the sweet potato into wedges and halve the Brussels sprouts, toss both with 8 g of the oil, paprika, rosemary and salt and roast for 25 minutes.
Stir the quark with the chopped herbs, salt and pepper until smooth.
Season the turkey steak with salt and pepper and fry in the remaining oil for 4 to 5 minutes per side until cooked through, then slice.
Serve with the sweet potato, Brussels sprouts and herb quark.

title: Baked salmon with horseradish mashed potatoes and peas
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Season the salmon with salt, drizzle with lemon juice and bake for 15 minutes.
Peel the potatoes, boil them in salted water for 18 minutes until soft, drain and mash with the warm milk, horseradish, nutmeg and salt.
Cook the peas in a little salted water for 3 minutes.
Place the salmon on the mash, arrange the peas beside it and garnish with dill.

title: Meal prep box with fajita chicken, pepper rice and salsa
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet instructions for about 30 minutes, finely dice a quarter of the pepper and mix it into the rice.
