Cut the chicken into strips, mix with the spices and salt and fry with the remaining pepper and onion cut into strips in the oil for 7 minutes until cooked through.
Finely dice the tomato and mix with coriander, lime juice and salt to make the salsa.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Lentil and bulgur box with roasted pepper and feta
instructions: Cook the lentils in plenty of water for 22 minutes until al dente, pour 80 ml of boiling salted water over the bulgur and let it swell for 10 minutes.
Cut the pepper into strips and roast with 3 g of the oil at 220 °C in the oven for 15 minutes until soft.
Mix the lentils and bulgur with the lemon juice, remaining oil, parsley, salt and pepper, dice the cucumber and add it on top with the pepper and crumbled feta.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
At the office eat cold or at room temperature.

title: Tuna and chickpea salad in a jar with pepper and parsley
instructions: Stir the lemon juice with the olive oil, salt and pepper and pour the dressing into the bottom of a large screw-top jar.
Rinse the chickpeas. Dice the pepper and cucumber and slice the onion into thin rings.
Layer in the chickpeas, pepper, cucumber, onion and flaked tuna one after another and finish with parsley.
Keep sealed in the fridge for up to 3 days and shake well or tip into a bowl before eating.

title: Turkey meatballs in tomato sauce with wholemeal pasta
instructions: Knead the turkey mince with the oats, half of the finely chopped onion, salt and pepper and shape into 5 balls.

Brown the balls in the oil for 5 minutes on all sides, add the remaining onion, garlic and diced zucchini, stir in the passata and oregano and simmer for 12 minutes until the meatballs are cooked through.
Cook the penne in salted water for 10 minutes until al dente and drain.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Tofu peanut soba box with carrot and edamame
instructions: Pat the tofu dry, dice it and fry in the oil for 8 minutes until light golden on all sides.
Cook the soba noodles according to the packet instructions, adding the edamame for the last 3 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water. Cut the carrot into thin strips.
Stir the peanut butter with the soy sauce, lime juice, grated ginger and 3 tbsp of water, toss with the noodles, edamame and carrot, place the tofu on top and sprinkle with sesame.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
At the office eat cold straight from the container.

title: Burrito box with soy mince, beans and rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet instructions for about 30 minutes. Soak the soy mince in 100 ml of hot water for 10 minutes and squeeze it out well.
Sweat the diced onion in the oil, fry the soy mince and spices with it for 3 minutes, add the passata, simmer for 5 minutes and season with salt.
Mix the beans, sweetcorn and diced pepper with the lime juice and salt.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Meal prep box with mustard salmon, roast potatoes and broccoli
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with the oil and salt and roast for 30 minutes.
Stir the mustard with the honey and dill, spread it over the salmon and add the salmon to the oven for the last 14 minutes.
Divide the broccoli into florets and steam for 4 minutes.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Layered jar salad with quinoa, chicken, sweetcorn and avocado lime dressing
instructions: Cook the quinoa in twice its volume of salted water for 15 minutes and let cool. Fry the chicken breast in the oil for 5 to 6 minutes per side until cooked through, let cool and dice.
Blend the avocado with the yoghurt, lime juice and salt until smooth and pour the dressing into the bottom of a large jar.
Layer in the quinoa, sweetcorn, halved cherry tomatoes, chicken and torn lettuce one after another.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Before eating shake well or tip into a bowl and eat cold.

title: Chicken couscous box with roast vegetables and feta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Cut the vegetables into pieces, season the chicken with paprika and salt and roast both with the oil and thyme on a tray for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Pour 90 ml of boiling salted water over the couscous, let swell for 5 minutes and fluff up.
Mix the couscous with the roast vegetables, crumble the feta over it, slice the chicken and add it with the parsley.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
At the office eat cold or reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot.

title: Meal prep box with lemon turkey, wild rice and roast pumpkin
instructions: Cook the wild rice according to the packet instructions for about 40 minutes and fold the spinach into the hot rice.
Cut the pumpkin into wedges and roast with 5 g of the oil, rosemary and salt at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Season the turkey breast with lemon zest, garlic, salt and pepper, fry in the remaining oil for 5 minutes per side until cooked through, deglaze with lemon juice and slice.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Salmon with creamed spinach and parmesan
instructions: Pat the salmon dry, season with salt and fry skin side down in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes, then turn and finish cooking for 2 minutes.
Sweat the garlic in the butter, add the spinach and let it wilt for 2 minutes.
Pour in the cream, let it reduce for 2 minutes and season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Place the salmon on the creamed spinach and sprinkle with finely grated parmesan.

title: Oven-baked halloumi with aubergine, olives and mint
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Dice the aubergine, toss with 10 g of the oil, oregano and salt and roast for 15 minutes.
Slice the halloumi, place it on the aubergine with the olives, drizzle with the remaining oil and bake for another 12 minutes until the halloumi is golden.
Serve sprinkled with chilli flakes and fresh mint.

title: Pan-fried mackerel with sour cream cucumbers and dill
instructions: Slice the cucumber thinly, salt lightly and let stand for 10 minutes, then squeeze out.
Mix the cucumber with the sour cream, plenty of dill, lemon juice and pepper.
Pat the mackerel fillets dry, season with salt and fry skin side down in the oil for 4 minutes until crisp, then turn and cook for 1 more minute.
Serve the mackerel with the sour cream cucumbers.

title: Macadamia tofu stir-fry with broccoli and coconut aminos
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and dice it, toast the macadamia nuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes and remove.
Fry the tofu in the coconut oil for 8 minutes until light golden on all sides.
Add the broccoli florets and chilli flakes and cook with 3 tbsp of water for 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Toss in the coconut aminos and macadamia nuts and sprinkle with the spring onion greens.

title: Creamy mushroom pan with turkey strips
instructions: Fry the turkey strips in 5 g of the butter for 5 minutes until cooked through, season with salt and remove.
Slice the mushrooms and fry them well in the remaining butter with the garlic and thyme for 5 minutes.
Pour in the cream and reduce for 3 minutes until creamy, return the turkey strips, season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Chicken thighs with pesto Brussels sprouts and parmesan
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper and roast skin side up for 30 minutes until crisp and cooked through.
Halve the Brussels sprouts, toss with the oil and salt and add them to the tray for the last 20 minutes.
Toss the Brussels sprouts with the pesto, serve with the chicken thighs and sprinkle with grated parmesan.

title: Lamb chops with green beans, feta and mint
instructions: Trim the beans and cook them in salted water for 7 minutes until tender-crisp, then drain.
Season the lamb chops with rosemary, salt and pepper and fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side, then let rest for 3 minutes.
Toss the beans in the butter with the garlic for 2 minutes, crumble the feta over them and sprinkle with mint. Serve with the chops.

title: Pointed cabbage and beef mince pan with crème fraîche
instructions: Remove the core from the pointed cabbage and cut it into thin strips.
Fry the beef mince in the oil until crumbly and season with caraway, paprika, salt and pepper.
Add the cabbage and fry for 6 minutes, turning, until tender-crisp.
Serve with a dollop of crème fraîche and chives.

title: Tuna avocado boats with mayonnaise and capers
instructions: Halve the avocado, remove the stone and drizzle the flesh with a little lemon juice.
Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise, half of the capers, salt and pepper until creamy.
Fill the avocado halves with the tuna cream, sprinkle with the remaining capers and chives and serve with the lemon wedge.

title: Broccoli and cheddar frittata with rocket
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Divide the broccoli into small florets and fry in the butter in an ovenproof pan for 4 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with the cream, half of the cheddar, salt and pepper, pour over the broccoli and scatter over the remaining cheddar.
Bake in the oven for 15 minutes until the frittata is set and golden.
Cut into wedges and serve with the rocket.

title: Hoppin' John: black-eyed peas, brown rice and kale
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet instructions for about 30 minutes.
Dice the onion, celery and pepper and sweat them in the oil with the garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the black-eyed peas, stock, smoked paprika, thyme and cayenne pepper and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes.
Cut the kale into strips, cook it along for the last 4 minutes and season everything with salt. Serve with the rice.

title: Pasulj: Serbian bean stew, peppers and turkey sausages
instructions: Dice the onion, pepper and carrot and sweat them in the oil for 6 minutes, then briefly roast the garlic and tomato paste along.
Stir in the paprika, add the beans, stock and bay leaf and simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
Slice the turkey sausage, brown it in a dry pan for 4 minutes and add it to the stew.
Season with salt and pepper, remove the bay leaf and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Khoresh gheimeh: Persian yellow split pea stew, lamb and basmati rice
instructions: Precook the yellow split peas in water for 30 minutes and drain.
Dice the onion and fry it in the oil until golden, add the lamb and brown it all over, then briefly roast the turmeric, cinnamon and tomato paste along.
Add the strained tomatoes, 200 ml of water, the pierced dried lime and the peas and braise covered for 40 minutes until the meat and peas are tender.
Meanwhile cook the basmati rice and serve it with the stew.

title: Parsi dhansak: chicken, red lentils, aubergine and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet instructions.
Cook the lentils with the diced aubergine, pumpkin and tomato in 400 ml of water for 20 minutes until soft and coarsely purée.
Fry the onion in the oil until golden, roast the ginger, garlic and spices along for 1 minute, add the diced chicken and brown it for 5 minutes.
Add the lentil purée and simmer for 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Season with salt, sprinkle with coriander and serve with the rice.

title: Ndolé: Cameroonian spinach peanut stew, prawns and plantain
instructions: Peel the plantain, slice it and fry in 4 g of the oil for 3 minutes per side until golden, then remove.
Sweat the onion and garlic in the remaining oil, stir in the ground peanuts with 200 ml of water and simmer for 5 minutes into a creamy sauce.
Finely chop the spinach, add it to the sauce and cook for 5 minutes, then season with chilli and salt.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink. Serve with the plantain.

title: Kongbap: Korean bean rice, tofu and spinach namul
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet instructions and mix in the beans for the last 5 minutes.
Blanch the spinach for 1 minute, refresh in cold water, squeeze out and mix with the sesame oil, garlic, half of the tamari and the sesame seeds.
Slice the tofu and fry it in a non-stick pan for 3 minutes per side until light golden, then deglaze with the remaining tamari.
Serve the bean rice with the tofu and spinach namul and sprinkle with spring onion.

title: Moroccan lentil tagine, carrots, apricots and wholegrain couscous
instructions: Dice the onion and sweat it in the oil with the garlic and spices for 3 minutes.
Add the lentils, carrots in chunks, tomatoes, chopped apricots and 300 ml of water and braise covered for 30 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Pour 80 ml of boiling water over the couscous, let it swell for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
Season the tagine with salt, sprinkle with coriander and serve with the couscous.

title: Baião de dois: Brazilian bean rice, grilled cheese slices
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet instructions.
Dice the onion, pepper and garlic and sweat them in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the beans and rice, warm through for 3 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Fry the grilling cheese in a dry grill pan for 2 minutes per side until golden, place on the bean rice and sprinkle with coriander.

title: Kwati: Nepali bean soup, mung beans, chickpeas and ginger
instructions: Precook the mung beans in water for 30 minutes and drain.
Dice the onion and fry it in the oil with the cumin, ajwain, grated ginger and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the diced tomato, turmeric, all the beans, chickpeas and stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and serve sprinkled with coriander.

title: Haleem: Pakistani lentil wheat stew, beef
instructions: Soak the wheat berries overnight, drain and cook with the lentils and mung dal in 600 ml of water for 60 minutes until soft.
Braise the beef with the garlic, half of the ginger, turmeric, chilli and 300 ml of water covered for 90 minutes until it falls apart.
Shred the meat, mix it with the wheat lentil mixture and garam masala and cook down for 10 minutes, stirring, into a thick stew, then add salt.
Slice the onion into rings, fry in the ghee until crisp and golden and serve on the haleem with the remaining ginger in strips, coriander and the lemon wedge.

title: Air fryer smashed potatoes, herb quark
instructions: Boil the potatoes in their skins in salted water for 15 minutes until almost tender and let them steam dry briefly.
Flatten the potatoes with the bottom of a glass, brush with the oil and season with salt and smoked paprika.
Cook in the Airfryer at 200 °C for 15 minutes until crisp and golden.
Stir the quark with the crushed garlic, herbs, salt and 2 tbsp of water until smooth and serve with the potatoes.

title: Air fryer cauliflower bites, sriracha yoghurt dip
instructions: Divide the cauliflower into bite-sized florets.
Whisk the chickpea flour with 50 ml of water, the oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt into a thick batter and coat the florets in it.
Cook in the Airfryer at 190 °C for 16 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway through.
Stir the yoghurt with the sriracha and a pinch of salt and serve as a dip.

title: Air fryer gnocchi, cherry tomatoes and mini mozzarella
instructions: Toss the gnocchi with the cherry tomatoes, oil, chopped garlic, oregano and salt.
Cook in the Airfryer at 200 °C for 14 minutes until the gnocchi are crisp and the tomatoes burst, shaking twice.
Transfer to a bowl, fold in the mini mozzarella, season with pepper and scatter over the basil.

title: Crispy rice salad: air fryer rice, edamame and chicken
instructions: Cook the rice, spread it flat on a plate and let it cool in the fridge for at least 30 minutes or overnight.
Break the rice into pieces, toss with 5 g of the oil and roast in the Airfryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes until crisp. Salt the chicken and cook it alongside for 12 minutes until cooked through.
Thaw the edamame, cut the cucumber into half-moons and the carrot into thin strips. Whisk the tamari, rice vinegar, remaining oil and chilli flakes.
Toss the vegetables and edamame with the dressing, top with the sliced chicken and the crispy rice, sprinkle with sesame and serve with the lime wedge.

title: Air fryer salmon bites, sesame and cucumber salad
instructions: Cut the salmon into 3 cm cubes, toss with the tamari and roll in the sesame seeds all over.
Cook in the Airfryer at 200 °C for 8 minutes until golden.
Slice the cucumber thinly and mix with the rice vinegar, sesame oil, spring onion, chilli flakes and a pinch of salt.
Serve the salmon bites with the cucumber salad.

title: Air fryer stuffed mushrooms, cream cheese and spinach
instructions: Twist the stems out of the mushrooms, chop them finely and sauté with the garlic and spinach in a pan for 3 minutes until the spinach wilts.
Squeeze out the spinach mixture, stir with the cream cheese, nutmeg, salt and pepper and fill into the mushroom caps.
Sprinkle with grated hard cheese and cook in the Airfryer at 180 °C for 10 minutes until the mushrooms are tender and the cheese is lightly browned.

title: Air fryer gochujang tofu cubes, sesame and cucumber
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet instructions.
Pat the tofu dry, dice it and toss in the cornflour. Cook in the Airfryer at 200 °C for 15 minutes until crisp, shaking halfway.
Stir the gochujang with the sesame oil and 1 tbsp of water and toss the hot tofu cubes in it.
Slice the cucumber thinly and drizzle with the rice vinegar. Sprinkle the tofu with sesame and serve with the rice and cucumber.

title: Air fryer turkey skewers, zucchini and tzatziki
instructions: Cut the turkey into cubes and the zucchini into thick slices, toss with the oil, oregano, paprika and salt and thread alternately onto 2 skewers.
Cook in the Airfryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes, turning after 6 minutes, until the turkey is cooked through.
Grate the cucumber, squeeze it out and stir with the yoghurt, crushed garlic, dill and salt to make tzatziki.
Put the pita into the Airfryer for the last 2 minutes and serve everything together.

title: Air fryer sweet potato rösti, smoked salmon and skyr
instructions: Peel the sweet potato, grate it coarsely and squeeze it out firmly with your hands.
Mix with the egg, cornflour and salt, shape into 2 flat rösti and brush with the oil.
Cook in the Airfryer at 190 °C for 14 minutes, turning after 8 minutes, until crisp and golden.
Top the rösti with the skyr and smoked salmon, season with pepper and garnish with dill.

title: Air fryer broccoli, peanut lime sauce and chicken
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet instructions.

Divide the broccoli into florets and toss with the oil and salt. Salt the chicken and cook both in the Airfryer at 200 °C for 14 minutes until the broccoli is charred and the chicken is cooked through.
Stir the peanut butter with the lime juice, tamari, ground ginger, chilli flakes and 2 tbsp of warm water until smooth.
Slice the chicken, arrange with the broccoli and rice and drizzle with the sauce.

title: Lupin tofu patties, cucumber soy skyr dip
instructions: Mash the lupins and tofu finely with a fork, knead with the lupin flour, garlic, cumin, paprika and salt and let it swell for 10 minutes.
Shape into 3 flat patties and fry in the oil in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes per side until golden.
Grate the cucumber, squeeze it out and stir with the soy skyr, dill and salt. Serve with the patties.

title: Soy mince chili in pepper boats
instructions: Soak the soy mince in 100 ml of hot water for 10 minutes. Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Dice the onion and garlic and sweat them in the oil in a non-stick pan for 3 minutes, then add the soy mince and spices and toast for 3 minutes.
Add the strained tomatoes and kidney beans and simmer for 8 minutes until thick, then add salt.
Halve the pepper lengthwise, deseed it, fill with the chili and bake in the oven for 20 minutes. Serve with the soy skyr and coriander.

title: Tempeh shirataki stir-fry, snow peas and chilli
instructions: Rinse the shirataki noodles, blanch them in boiling water for 2 minutes and dry-roast them in a dry pan for 3 minutes, then remove.
Dice the tempeh and fry it in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes until golden on all sides.
Add the snow peas, edamame, grated ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Toss in the noodles and tamari and serve sprinkled with the chilli rings.

title: Smoked tofu, Brussels sprouts and edamame pan
instructions: Trim and halve the Brussels sprouts, precook them in salted water for 4 minutes and drain.
Dice the smoked tofu and fry it in a dry non-stick pan for 5 minutes until crisp.
Add the Brussels sprouts cut side down and brown for 5 minutes, frying the edamame and caraway along for the last 2 minutes.
Deglaze with the tamari, season with chilli flakes and pepper and serve.

title: Broccoli tofu scramble pan, nutritional yeast and turmeric
instructions: Divide the broccoli into small florets and steam them covered in a non-stick pan with 3 tbsp of water for 4 minutes.
Crumble the tofu coarsely with your hands, add it to the pan with the turmeric and nutritional yeast and fry for 5 minutes, turning.
Warm the halved cherry tomatoes through for 1 minute, season with kala namak and pepper and sprinkle with spring onion.

title: Teriyaki salmon bowl with jasmine rice, edamame and cucumber
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions for about 15 minutes, adding the edamame for the last 4 minutes.
Stir the soy sauce, honey and grated ginger with 2 tbsp of water.
Cut the salmon into cubes, fry in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes on all sides, pour in the sauce and glaze for 1 minute.
Put the rice and edamame into a bowl, arrange the salmon and cucumber slices on top and sprinkle with sesame and spring onions.

title: Chicken and egg fried rice with peas, carrot and spring onions
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions for about 15 minutes, spread it on a plate and let it cool, or use rice from the day before.
Dice the chicken and fry in 5 g of the oil for 5 minutes until cooked through, then remove.
Heat the remaining oil, fry the diced carrot, peas, ginger and garlic for 3 minutes, add the rice and stir-fry vigorously for 3 minutes.
Push the rice to the side, add the beaten eggs to the centre and let them set, then mix in the chicken and soy sauce and sprinkle with spring onions.

title: Peri-peri chicken breast with rosemary potatoes and corn and pepper salad
ingredients: Smoked paprika, chilli flakes, garlic powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Quarter the potatoes, toss with 5 g of the oil, rosemary and salt and roast for 35 minutes.
Rub the chicken with 5 g of the oil, paprika, chilli flakes, garlic powder and salt and add it to the potatoes on the tray after 15 minutes, baking for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Finely dice the pepper and onion and mix with the corn, lime juice, remaining oil, salt and pepper to make the salad.
Slice the chicken and serve with the potatoes and salad.

title: Beef pljeskavica with ajvar, oven potatoes and coleslaw
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with 5 g of the oil, paprika and salt and bake for 35 minutes.
Finely shred the cabbage, knead well with the vinegar, 5 g of the oil, caraway and salt and leave to marinate.
Knead the beef mince with the finely chopped onion, salt and pepper and shape into one large flat patty.
Fry the pljeskavica in the remaining oil for 4 minutes per side until cooked through and serve with the ajvar, potatoes and coleslaw.

title: Chicken and sweet potato chilli with kidney beans and yoghurt
instructions: Cut the chicken into small cubes and brown in 5 g of the oil for 5 minutes, then remove.
Dice the onion, garlic, pepper and sweet potato, fry in the remaining oil for 4 minutes and toast the spices with them for 1 minute.
Add the passata, kidney beans and 100 ml of water and simmer covered for 15 minutes until the sweet potato is tender.
Return the chicken to the pot and simmer for 3 minutes until cooked through, season with salt and serve with the yoghurt and coriander.

title: Tuna and tomato penne with olives, capers and rocket
instructions: Cook the penne in salted water according to the packet instructions for about 10 minutes until al dente.
Sweat the garlic in the oil, add the passata, oregano and chilli flakes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Fold in the tuna, halved olives and capers, heat for 2 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Mix in the penne, transfer to a plate and top with the rocket and shaved parmesan.

title: Tempeh peanut curry with broccoli and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet instructions for about 30 minutes.
Dice the tempeh and toast it in a non-stick pan without fat for 5 minutes until golden.
Stir the coconut milk, peanut butter, tamari, grated ginger and spices with 50 ml of water until smooth, add to the tempeh with the broccoli florets and simmer for 6 minutes.
Season with lime juice and serve with the rice.

title: Matar paneer with peas, tomatoes and basmati rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions for about 15 minutes.
Dice the paneer and fry it in a non-stick pan without fat for 4 minutes until golden on all sides, then remove.
Finely chop the onion, ginger and garlic and sweat in the oil for 4 minutes, briefly toast the spices, add the passata and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the peas and paneer, let it simmer gently for 4 minutes, season with salt and serve with coriander and the rice.

title: Garlic prawns with lentil pasta, cherry tomatoes and rocket
instructions: Cook the lentil pasta in salted water according to the packet instructions for about 8 minutes and drain.
Slice the garlic and sweat it with the chilli flakes in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the prawns and fry for 2 minutes per side until pink and cooked through, toss the halved cherry tomatoes in for 2 minutes.
Mix in the pasta, season with lemon juice, parsley, salt and pepper and serve topped with the rocket.

title: Beef steak burrito bowl with black beans, corn and pico de gallo
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet instructions for about 30 minutes.
Finely dice the tomato and onion and mix with coriander, lime juice and salt to make pico de gallo.
Season the steak with cumin, paprika, salt and pepper, fry in the oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side and rest for 5 minutes. Briefly warm the beans and corn.
Arrange the rice, beans, corn, pico de gallo and avocado slices in a bowl and top with the steak cut into strips.

title: Harissa chicken thighs with roasted chickpeas, peppers and couscous
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Rub the chicken thighs with the harissa, 5 g of the oil and salt.
Toss the chickpeas and pepper strips with the remaining oil and cumin, place on a tray with the chicken and bake for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Pour 150 ml of boiling salted water over the couscous, leave to swell for 5 minutes and fluff up with lemon juice and parsley.
Arrange the couscous, chickpeas, peppers and chicken and serve with a dollop of yoghurt.

title: Udon stir-fry with turkey strips, pak choi and egg
instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to the packet instructions for about 8 minutes, drain and rinse under cold water.
Cut the turkey into thin strips and fry in the sesame oil for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Cut the carrot into strips and the pak choi into pieces and fry with the ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles and soy sauce, crack the egg in at the side, let it set while stirring and sprinkle everything with spring onions.

title: Skyr with kiwi, mango and puffed quinoa
instructions: Stir the skyr until smooth and put it into a shallow bowl.
Peel the kiwi and cut it into slices, cut the mango into small cubes.
Spread the fruit over the skyr and sprinkle with the puffed quinoa and a little lime zest.

title: Wholegrain wrap with scrambled eggs, baby spinach and feta
instructions: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper and let them set into creamy scrambled eggs in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Warm the wrap in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Top the wrap with baby spinach, scrambled eggs, quartered cherry tomatoes and crumbled feta, sprinkle with chilli flakes, roll up and cut in half.

title: Mediterranean breakfast plate with hummus, egg, tomato and cucumber
instructions: Cook the eggs in boiling water for 8 minutes until just set, cool under cold water and peel.
Slice the tomato and cucumber and season with salt and pepper.
Spread the hummus on the plate, dust with paprika and arrange with the halved eggs, vegetables, olives and parsley.

title: Strawberry quark with oats and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Mash half of the strawberries with a fork and stir with the quark, vanilla and 2 tbsp of water until smooth.
Halve the remaining strawberries.
Put the strawberry quark into a bowl and top with the oats, halved strawberries and pumpkin seeds.

title: Leek and tomato omelette with cottage cheese and chives
instructions: Cut the leek into fine rings and fry in the oil for 3 minutes until soft, then fry the halved cherry tomatoes with it for 1 minute.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites with salt and pepper, pour over the vegetables and let set covered over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Spoon the cottage cheese onto one half, fold the omelette over and serve sprinkled with chives.

title: Soy skyr with peach, raspberries and walnuts
instructions: Stir the soy skyr until smooth and put it into a shallow bowl.
Cut the peach into wedges and spread over the skyr with the raspberries.
Roughly chop the walnuts, scatter them over and dust with cinnamon.

title: Blueberry oat bran smoothie with quark and cinnamon
instructions: Let the blueberries thaw for 5 minutes.
Put them into a blender with the quark, oat bran, milk and cinnamon and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Cottage cheese with watermelon, cucumber, mint and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Cut the watermelon and cucumber into bite-sized cubes.
Put the cottage cheese into a shallow bowl and spread the melon and cucumber on top.
Finish with lime juice, pumpkin seeds, torn mint and a little pepper.

title: Wholegrain bread with tuna skyr spread, tomato and cress
instructions: Mix the tuna with the skyr, mustard, lemon juice, salt and pepper with a fork until creamy.
Spread the tuna cream over the bread slices.
Slice the tomato, lay it on the bread and sprinkle with cress and pepper.

title: Wholegrain toast with hummus, smoked tofu and cucumber
instructions: Toast the bread until golden and spread with the hummus.
Cut the smoked tofu into thin slices and fry in a non-stick pan without fat for 2 minutes per side.
Slice the cucumber and radishes, arrange on the toast with the tofu and season with chilli flakes, salt and pepper.

title: Pear and tahini ice cream with cocoa nibs and soy skyr
instructions: Peel, core and dice the pear and blend finely with the soy skyr, tahini, maple syrup and cinnamon.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Spoon into a bowl and serve sprinkled with cocoa nibs.

title: Peanut and date shake with skyr and cinnamon
instructions: Roughly chop the dates.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Ajitama – Japanese soy-marinated eggs with cucumber sesame salad
instructions: Cook the eggs in boiling water for 7 minutes, plunge into iced water and peel.
Stir the soy sauce with half of the rice vinegar and 3 tbsp of water and marinate the eggs in it covered in the fridge for at least 2 hours, turning once.
Cut the cucumber into thin slices and mix with the remaining rice vinegar, sesame oil, sesame seeds and chilli flakes.
Halve the eggs and serve with the cucumber salad.

title: Crispy oven-roasted cinnamon chickpeas with cocoa
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Pat the chickpeas thoroughly dry and remove any loose skins.
Toss with the oil and a pinch of salt and roast on a tray for 25 minutes until crispy, turning once.
Toss the hot chickpeas with the maple syrup, cinnamon and cocoa and roast for another 5 minutes.
Leave to cool on the tray so they turn crunchy.

title: Banana skyr bites with dark chocolate coating and peanuts
instructions: Cut the banana into 8 thick slices, top each with a dollop of skyr and freeze on baking paper for 1 hour.
Melt the chocolate over a warm water bath and finely chop the peanuts.
Dip the frozen bites halfway into the chocolate, sprinkle with peanuts and freeze for another 10 minutes.

title: Mango coconut nice cream with lime and pea protein
instructions: Let the mango thaw for 5 minutes.
Blend with the soy skyr, pea protein, coconut milk, lime juice and a little lime zest in a food processor for 1 to 2 minutes until creamy, scraping down in between.
Spoon into a bowl straight away or freeze for another 30 minutes for a firmer texture.

title: Chicken and cucumber skewers with yoghurt dill dip
instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized cubes, toss with the oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt and fry in a pan for 6 minutes on all sides until cooked through.
Cut the cucumber into thick cubes and thread alternately with the chicken and cherry tomatoes onto 4 small skewers.
Stir the yoghurt with chopped dill, lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve as a dip.

title: Raspberry coconut ice lollies with coconut yoghurt
instructions: Blend the raspberries finely with the maple syrup.
Stir the coconut yoghurt and soy yoghurt until smooth and layer alternately with the raspberry purée in the moulds, marbling lightly with a skewer.
Pour the mixture into 2 ice lolly moulds, insert the sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours.
Briefly hold the moulds under warm water and release the lollies.

title: Chicken thighs with herb cream cheese spinach and pine nuts
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper and fry skin side down in a cold pan over medium heat for 12 minutes until crispy, then turn and cook for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden.
Sweat the garlic in the butter, let the spinach wilt for 2 minutes, stir in the cream cheese and herbs and season with salt and pepper.
Put the creamed spinach on a plate, place the chicken thighs on top and sprinkle with the pine nuts.

title: Aubergine and mozzarella stacks with basil oil and pine nuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the aubergine into 6 slices, season with salt, brush with 5 g of the oil and bake on a tray for 15 minutes, turning once.
Cut the mozzarella into 4 slices and stack alternately with the aubergine slices into 2 towers, then bake for 5 minutes.
Blend the basil finely with the garlic, remaining oil and a pinch of salt, and toast the pine nuts in a dry pan until golden.
Drizzle the stacks with the basil oil, sprinkle with the pine nuts and pepper and serve.

title: Smoked salmon cucumber rolls with herb cream cheese and capers
instructions: Use a vegetable peeler to cut the cucumber lengthways into 8 thin strips.
Stir the cream cheese with chopped dill, lemon juice and pepper and spread thinly over the cucumber strips.
Top with the smoked salmon, roll up and sprinkle with the capers.
Cut the avocado into wedges, season with the oil, salt and pepper and arrange next to the rolls.

title: Goat cheese and spinach omelette with walnuts
instructions: Whisk the eggs with salt, pepper and thyme and roughly chop the walnuts.
Wilt the spinach in the butter for 1 minute, pour the eggs over and let them set over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Spread the goat cheese in slices on top, let it melt covered for 2 minutes, fold the omelette and serve sprinkled with the walnuts.

title: Cauliflower cheddar gratin with eggs and chives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Divide the cauliflower into florets and parboil in salted water for 5 minutes, then drain well.
Whisk the eggs with the cream, nutmeg, mustard powder, salt, pepper and half of the cheddar.
Put the cauliflower into a small baking dish, pour the egg mixture over and sprinkle with the remaining cheddar.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and serve sprinkled with chives.

title: Goose breast with cauliflower butter purée and lamb's lettuce
instructions: Divide the cauliflower into florets and cook in salted water for 12 minutes until soft, then drain well.
Season the goose breast with salt and pepper and fry in 5 g of the oil with thyme for 5 minutes per side, then rest for 5 minutes.
Blend the cauliflower finely with 20 g of the butter, the cream, nutmeg and salt.
Dress the lamb's lettuce with the remaining oil, salt and pepper. Slice the goose breast, drizzle with the remaining butter and serve with the purée and salad.

title: Crispy tofu cubes on avocado cucumber salad with peanuts
instructions: Pat the tofu dry, dice it and fry in the rapeseed oil over medium heat for 8 minutes until crispy on all sides, then deglaze with half of the tamari.
Dice the avocado and cucumber and mix with the sesame oil, remaining tamari, lime juice and chilli flakes.
Roughly chop the peanuts.
Put the salad into a bowl, top with the tofu and sprinkle with the peanuts and coriander.

title: Rump steak with creamy mushrooms and garlic spinach
instructions: Pat the steak dry and fry in 5 g of the oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side, add 10 g of the butter and the thyme, baste the steak, season with salt and pepper and rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the mushrooms and fry in the remaining oil for 4 minutes, stir in the crème fraîche and season with parsley, salt and pepper.
Sweat the garlic in the remaining butter, add the spinach and let it wilt for 1 minute, then season with salt.
Slice the steak and serve with the creamy mushrooms and garlic spinach.

title: Meal prep box with turkey kofta, millet and pepper yoghurt dip
instructions: Rinse the millet with hot water, simmer in 120 ml of salted water for 10 minutes and leave to swell for 10 minutes.
Knead the turkey mince with the finely chopped onion, parsley, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper, shape into 6 oblong kofta and fry in the oil for 8 minutes on all sides until cooked through.
Stir the yoghurt with the ajvar and dried mint. Cut the pepper and cucumber into strips.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
At the office eat cold or reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot.

title: Meal prep box with paprika chicken, buckwheat and red cabbage apple salad
instructions: Simmer the buckwheat in 100 ml of salted water for 12 minutes and leave to swell for 5 minutes.
Finely shred the red cabbage, cut the apple into sticks and knead well with the cider vinegar, 5 g of the oil, salt and pepper, then roughly chop the walnuts and mix them in.
Rub the chicken with the paprika, remaining oil and salt and fry in a pan for 5 minutes per side until cooked through, then slice.
Mix the buckwheat with parsley and fill into a container with the chicken and red cabbage salad.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Eat cold straight from the container, mixing in the dressing just before eating.

title: Meal prep box with red lentil spinach dal and basmati rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions for about 15 minutes.
Finely chop the onion, ginger and garlic and sweat in the oil for 3 minutes, toasting the spices with them for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, passata and 250 ml of water and simmer for 15 minutes until thick, then stir in the coconut milk and spinach and season with salt.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Pasta salad box with tuna, white beans, rocket and lemon dressing
instructions: Cook the fusilli in salted water according to the packet instructions for about 10 minutes until al dente, rinse under cold water and drain.
Halve the cherry tomatoes, finely dice the onion and mix with the pasta, beans and flaked tuna.
Stir the oil with the lemon juice, lemon zest, parsley, salt and pepper.
Fill the salad into a container, place the rocket on top and take the dressing separately in a small screw-top jar.
Eat cold straight from the container, mixing in the dressing just before eating.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Meal prep box with beef strips, herb potato salad and green beans
instructions: Cook the potatoes in their skins in salted water for 20 minutes, adding the green beans for the last 7 minutes, then drain and let cool a little.
Stir the mustard, vinegar, 5 g of the oil, finely diced onion, herbs, salt and pepper together, slice the potatoes and mix with the beans and dressing.
Fry the steak in the remaining oil for 3 minutes per side, season with salt and pepper, rest for 5 minutes and cut into strips.
Fill the potato salad and beef strips into a container.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Eat cold straight from the container, mixing in the dressing just before eating.

title: Meal prep box with roast chicken, pearl barley and root vegetables
instructions: Simmer the pearl barley in 200 ml of salted water for 30 minutes until tender and drain. Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Cut the carrot, parsnip and celeriac into sticks, toss with 5 g of the oil, thyme, rosemary and salt and roast for 30 minutes.
Brush the chicken with the mustard, remaining oil, salt and pepper and add it to the vegetables after 10 minutes, baking for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Slice the chicken and fill into a container with the barley, vegetables and parsley.
Let cool, pack into an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Pinakbet – Filipino vegetable stew with squash, okra and tofu
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions for about 15 minutes. Dice the tofu and fry in a non-stick pan without fat for 6 minutes until golden.
Chop the onion, garlic and ginger and sweat in the oil in a pot for 3 minutes, add the diced tomato and cook for 3 minutes until it breaks down.
Dice the squash and aubergine, halve the okra, add with the tamari and 100 ml of water and braise covered for 15 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Fold in the tofu, season with pepper and serve with the rice.

title: Pipián verde – Mexican pumpkin seed sauce with chickpeas, courgette and rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet instructions for about 30 minutes.
Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan for 3 minutes until they pop, setting 1 tbsp aside for sprinkling.
Blend the remaining pumpkin seeds finely with the tomatillos, chilli, onion, garlic, a handful of coriander and the stock, then simmer in a pot for 5 minutes until thick.
Dice the courgette and cook with the chickpeas in the sauce for 8 minutes, season with salt and serve with the rice, remaining pumpkin seeds and coriander.

title: Imam bayildi – braised aubergine with tomatoes, onions and white beans
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Halve the aubergine lengthways, score the flesh in a criss-cross pattern, season with salt and brush with 5 g of the oil.
Cut the onion into strips and sweat with the garlic in the remaining oil for 8 minutes until soft, add the diced tomatoes, cinnamon and paprika and reduce for 5 minutes.
Mix half of the beans into the filling, pile it onto the aubergine halves, put the remaining beans with 50 ml of water into the dish and braise covered for 35 minutes.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve lukewarm sprinkled with parsley.

title: Thoran – Keralan white cabbage coconut stir-fry with mung beans and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet instructions for about 30 minutes. Cook the mung dal in 200 ml of water for 15 minutes until al dente and drain.
Heat the mustard seeds in the oil until they pop and fry the curry leaves and chopped chilli with them for 30 seconds.
Finely shred the cabbage, grate the carrot and add with the turmeric and salt, stir-frying for 6 minutes until al dente.
Fold in the mung dal and grated coconut, warm for 2 minutes and serve with the rice.

title: Tempeh rendang with brown rice and cucumber
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet instructions for about 30 minutes.
Blend the onion, garlic, ginger, chilli and the white part of the lemongrass with the spices and 2 tbsp of water to a paste and toast it in a pan for 3 minutes.
Dice the tempeh, add with the coconut milk and tamari and reduce uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is thick and dark.
Serve with the rice and cucumber slices.

title: Shogayaki-style ginger soy chunks with Chinese cabbage and carrot
instructions: Soak the soy chunks in 200 ml of hot water for 10 minutes and squeeze out well.
Finely grate the ginger and stir with the tamari and rice vinegar, then marinate the soy chunks in it for 5 minutes.
Fry the soy chunks in the sesame oil for 4 minutes until browned, add the onion cut into strips, the carrot cut into sticks and the Chinese cabbage cut into strips and fry for 4 minutes.
Add the remaining marinade, glaze briefly and serve sprinkled with spring onions.

title: Low-fat quark with kiwi, banana and desiccated coconut
instructions: Stir the quark with the mineral water until smooth and put it into a bowl.
Peel the kiwis and slice them, then slice the banana.
Arrange the fruit on the quark and sprinkle with the desiccated coconut.

title: Courgette omelette with light feta and dill
instructions: Cut the courgette into thin slices and fry in the oil in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with salt, pepper and chopped dill, pour over the courgette and let set over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Crumble the feta over it, fold the omelette and slide it onto a plate.

title: Skyr with blackberries, poppy seeds and lemon zest
instructions: Stir the skyr with the honey and half of the lemon zest until smooth.
Wash the blackberries and let them drain.
Put the skyr into a bowl, arrange the blackberries on top and sprinkle with the poppy seeds and remaining lemon zest.

title: Smoked salmon and skyr bread with cucumber and capers
instructions: Season the skyr with salt and pepper and spread it on the slices of bread.
Cut the cucumber into thin slices and arrange them on the skyr.
Lay the smoked salmon on top and garnish with the capers and dill.

title: Fried egg on pumpernickel with tomato and chives
instructions: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the eggs over medium heat for 4 minutes until the whites are set.
Slice the tomato and season with salt and pepper.
Place a fried egg on each slice of pumpernickel, lay the tomato slices alongside and sprinkle everything with chives.

title: Microwave mug omelette with broccoli and feta
instructions: Cut the broccoli into very small florets, cook covered in a large mug with 1 tbsp of water in the microwave for 2 minutes and pour off the water.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites with salt and pepper, pour over the broccoli and stir in half of the feta.
Cook in the microwave for 2 minutes, stirring briefly after 1 minute, and sprinkle with the remaining feta.

title: Soy yoghurt with cherries, cocoa and almonds
instructions: Let the cherries thaw at room temperature or briefly in the microwave.
Stir the soy yoghurt with the soy protein, cocoa and linseed until smooth and put it into a bowl.
Arrange the cherries on top and sprinkle with the flaked almonds.

title: Egg white wrap with spinach, tomato and cottage cheese
instructions: Whisk the egg whites with salt, pour into a large lightly oiled non-stick pan and let set covered over medium heat for 3 minutes into a thin round.
Slide the round onto a plate, spread with the cottage cheese and top with the spinach and diced tomato, then season with pepper.
Roll up and cut in half diagonally.

title: Mango lassi bowl with skyr and pistachios
instructions: Peel the mango and blend 100 g of the flesh with the skyr and cardamom until smooth.
Cut the remaining mango into small cubes and roughly chop the pistachios.
Put the mango cream into a bowl and sprinkle with the mango cubes and pistachios.

title: Yoghurt with orange segments, dates and almonds
instructions: Peel the orange with a knife and cut the segments out from between the membranes.
Cut the dates into small pieces.
Put the yoghurt into a bowl, arrange the orange segments and dates on top and sprinkle with the flaked almonds and cinnamon.

title: Matcha kiwi smoothie with soy protein
instructions: Peel the kiwis and cut them roughly.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Carrot cake quark with walnuts and raisins
instructions: Finely grate the carrot and apple.
Mix the quark with the maple syrup, cinnamon, nutmeg, two thirds of the grated mix and the raisins.
Spoon into a bowl and sprinkle with the remaining carrot and chopped walnuts.

title: Wholemeal toast with peanut butter, strawberries and cottage cheese
instructions: Toast the bread until golden and spread thinly with the peanut butter.
Spread the cottage cheese over it.
Slice the strawberries and arrange them on the toasts.

title: Apple, celery and cucumber smoothie with pea protein
instructions: Core the apple and cut the celery and cucumber roughly.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Hessian sour milk cheese on bread with radishes and chives
instructions: Spread the bread with the quark.
Slice the cheese, lay it on the bread and season with caraway and pepper.
Thinly slice the radishes, arrange them with the onion rings on the cheese and sprinkle with chives.

title: Bresaola rye bread with rocket and pear
instructions: Spread the bread with the cream cheese and season with pepper.
Core the pear and cut it into thin wedges.
Arrange the rocket, bresaola and pear wedges on the bread.

title: Brown shrimp scrambled eggs with dill on rye bread
instructions: Whisk the eggs with salt, pepper and chopped dill.
Heat the oil in a pan, let the eggs set creamily over low heat for 2 minutes and fold in the shrimp during the last minute.
Spoon the scrambled eggs onto the bread and serve with cucumber slices.

title: Skyr with redcurrants, vanilla and almonds
instructions: Wash the redcurrants and strip them from the stalks with a fork.
Stir the skyr with the vanilla and maple syrup and put it into a bowl.
Scatter the redcurrants and flaked almonds on top.

title: Quark with sour cherries and dark chocolate shavings
instructions: Briefly thaw the sour cherries in the microwave.
Stir the quark with the almond drink until smooth and put it into a bowl.
Add the sour cherries on top and grate the chocolate over them.

title: Cottage cheese with papaya, lime and coconut
instructions: Peel and deseed the papaya and cut it into cubes.
Finely grate the lime zest and drizzle the juice over the papaya.
Put the cottage cheese into a bowl, arrange the papaya on top and sprinkle with the coconut and lime zest.

title: Proats with egg white, plums and cinnamon
instructions: Bring the oats and milk to the boil in a small pan and simmer for 3 minutes, stirring.
Quickly stir in the egg whites and keep stirring for another 2 minutes until the porridge is fluffy and creamy.
Stone and quarter the plums, arrange them on the porridge and sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Savoury skyr bowl with cucumber, tomato, olives and za'atar
instructions: Season the skyr with salt and pepper and spread it in a shallow bowl.
Dice the cucumber, halve the tomatoes and slice the olives into rings.
Arrange the vegetables and olives on the skyr, drizzle with the oil and sprinkle with the za'atar.

title: Tuna and sweetcorn toast with pepper
instructions: Toast the bread until golden.
Mix the tuna with the skyr, sweetcorn and finely diced pepper and season with salt and pepper.
Spread over the toasts and sprinkle with sliced spring onions.

title: Swiss chard omelette with goat cheese
instructions: Wash the chard, cut the stalks into small pieces and the leaves into strips.
Fry the stalks in the oil in a non-stick pan for 2 minutes, then the leaves for 1 minute, pour over the whisked and seasoned eggs and let set for 3 minutes.
Crumble the goat cheese over it, fold the omelette and serve.

title: Melon and cucumber smoothie with quark and mint
instructions: Peel and deseed the melon and roughly dice the melon and cucumber.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Peach and ginger lassi with skyr
instructions: Stone the peach and cut it roughly, then peel the ginger.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Breakfast tacos with scrambled eggs, pepper and tomato salsa
instructions: Finely dice the tomato and onion and mix with the lime juice and salt to make the salsa.
Cut the pepper into strips and fry in the oil for 3 minutes, add the whisked eggs and let them set for 2 minutes, stirring.
Briefly warm the tortillas in a dry pan, fill them with the scrambled eggs and top with the salsa and coriander.

title: Turkey slice toast with fried egg and cucumber
instructions: Toast the bread and spread one slice thinly with mustard.
Fry the egg in the oil in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes.
Top the mustard toast with the turkey and fried egg, top the second toast with cucumber slices and season with pepper.

title: Chicken slice wrap with carrot and kohlrabi
instructions: Peel the carrot and kohlrabi and grate them coarsely.
Spread the wrap with the cream cheese, season with chives and pepper and top with the chicken slices and vegetables.
Roll up tightly and cut in half diagonally.

title: Kale scrambled eggs with feta
instructions: Strip the kale from the stalks and cut it into fine ribbons.
Fry in the oil for 3 minutes until wilted, add the whisked and seasoned eggs and let set creamily over low heat for 2 minutes.
Transfer to a plate, crumble the feta over it and sprinkle with chilli flakes.

title: Mushroom toast with poached egg
instructions: Bring water to a simmer in a pan, slide in the eggs one at a time and poach for 4 minutes.
Slice the mushrooms and fry in the oil with thyme, salt and pepper for 4 minutes until golden, and toast the bread.
Spoon the mushrooms onto the toasts, place an egg on each and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Tofu banh mi breakfast roll
instructions: Cut the carrot and daikon into fine matchsticks and mix with the rice vinegar, then cut the cucumber into strips.
Slice the smoked tofu and brown it in a non-stick pan without oil for 2 minutes per side.
Split the roll, fill it with the tofu, vegetables and coriander and drizzle with sriracha.

title: Banana quark pancakes
instructions: Blend half of the banana with the quark, egg and oats until smooth.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and cook 3 small pancakes from the batter for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Slice the remaining banana and arrange on the pancakes with the blueberries.

title: Mozzarella and peach toast with basil
instructions: Toast the bread until golden.
Slice the mozzarella, stone the peach and cut it into wedges.
Top the toasts alternately with mozzarella and peach, add the basil, drizzle with balsamic and season with pepper.

title: Egg and cucumber sandwich with skyr and dill
instructions: Peel the eggs and chop them finely, then mix with the skyr, mustard, chopped dill, salt and pepper.
Cut the cucumber into thin slices.
Layer the egg salad and cucumber slices between the two slices of toast and cut the sandwich in half diagonally.

title: Pak choi scrambled eggs with tamari
instructions: Halve the pak choi lengthways and finely chop the ginger.
Heat the rapeseed oil, fry the pak choi with the ginger for 3 minutes and deglaze with half of the tamari.
Whisk the eggs with the remaining tamari, add to the pan, let set creamily for 2 minutes and sprinkle with spring onions.

title: Apple and kohlrabi smoothie with skyr
instructions: Core the apple, peel the kohlrabi and cut both roughly.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Skyr with apricots, rosemary and almonds
instructions: Stone the apricots and cut them into wedges.
Chop the rosemary needles very finely and stir them into the honey.
Put the skyr into a bowl, arrange the apricots on top, drizzle with the rosemary honey and sprinkle with the chopped almonds.

title: Cranberry and orange quark with walnuts
instructions: Simmer the cranberries with the honey and 2 tbsp of water in a small pan for 4 minutes until they burst, then let cool briefly.
Peel the orange and cut it into segments.
Put the quark into a bowl, arrange the orange segments and cranberries on top and sprinkle with the chopped walnuts.

title: Lamb's lettuce and scrambled egg toast with radishes
instructions: Whisk the eggs and egg whites with salt and pepper and let set creamily in the oil over low heat for 3 minutes.
Toast the bread and thinly slice the radishes.
Lay the lamb's lettuce on the toasts, spoon the scrambled eggs over it and top with the radishes.

title: Dubai-style strawberry cup with pistachio cream and dark chocolate
instructions: Grind 15 g of the pistachios very finely in a blender and stir with the skyr and maple syrup into a pale green cream.
Halve the strawberries and layer them alternately with the pistachio cream in a dessert glass.
Melt the chocolate, pour it over the top layer, chop the remaining pistachios and scatter them over, then chill for 10 minutes until the chocolate has set.

title: Frozen yoghurt bark with mango, coconut and lime
instructions: Stir the yoghurt with the maple syrup and half of the lime zest and spread it about 1 cm thick on a board lined with baking paper.
Cut the mango into small cubes and scatter them over the yoghurt with the coconut and remaining lime zest.
Freeze for at least 3 hours, break into pieces and enjoy straight away.

title: Lime cheesecake cup with kiwi and oat crumbs
instructions: Toast the oats in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden and let them cool.
Stir the quark with the skyr, honey, lime juice and half of the lime zest until creamy.
Put the oat crumbs into a glass, layer the lime cream on top, cover with kiwi slices and sprinkle with the remaining zest.

title: Mini peppers stuffed with curried chicken salad
instructions: Poach the chicken breast in gently simmering salted water for 12 minutes until cooked through, let it cool and dice it finely.
Mix the chicken with the skyr, curry powder, finely diced apple and spring onions and season with salt and pepper.
Halve the mini peppers lengthways, deseed them and fill them with the salad.

title: Cottage cheese flatbread with za'atar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Blend the cottage cheese and egg with a hand blender until smooth.
Spread the mixture thinly in a round on a baking tray lined with baking paper, sprinkle with za'atar and bake for 25 minutes until golden.
Let cool briefly, cut into 4 pieces and serve with the halved tomatoes and cucumber slices.

title: Matcha strawberry latte with soy protein
instructions: Mash the strawberries finely using a fork, put them into a large glass and add the ice cubes.
Froth 200 ml of the almond drink with the soy protein and pour it slowly over the ice cubes.
Whisk the matcha with the remaining almond drink until smooth and pour it carefully on top to create three layers.

title: Strawberry and watermelon granita
instructions: Deseed the watermelon and blend it finely with the strawberries, lime juice and honey.
Pour into a shallow dish and freeze for 3 hours, scraping vigorously with a fork every 30 minutes.
Spoon the fluffy ice crystals into a glass and serve straight away.

title: Protein semolina pudding with cherries
instructions: Bring the milk to the boil, stir in the semolina and let it swell over low heat for 5 minutes, stirring.
Take the pan off the heat, let it cool for 2 minutes and stir in the protein powder until smooth.
Heat the cherries in a small pan for 3 minutes, spoon them over the semolina pudding and sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Cottage cheese pizza bowl with tomato, pepper and olives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Spread the cottage cheese in a small ovenproof dish and spread the passata with oregano on top.
Dice the pepper, slice the olives into rings and scatter them over with the torn mozzarella.
Bake for 12 minutes until the cheese has melted and is lightly browned.

title: Oven-roasted curry chickpea pops
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Rinse the chickpeas and pat them very dry with a tea towel.
Toss with the oil, curry powder, turmeric and salt and spread out on a baking tray.
Roast for 30 minutes until crunchy, turning once, and let cool.

title: Piña colada shake with soy protein
instructions: Peel the pineapple and cut it into pieces.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Coconut lime energy balls with pea protein
instructions: Blend the dates with the almonds, pea protein, 10 g of the coconut, the lime juice and half of the lime zest into a sticky mixture.
Shape into 4 balls with damp hands.
Mix the remaining coconut with the rest of the lime zest, roll the balls in it and chill for 20 minutes.

title: Rice cakes with cottage cheese and strawberries
instructions: Wash the strawberries and slice them.
Spread the rice cakes with the cottage cheese.
Lay the strawberries on top, drizzle with the honey and season with a pinch of pepper.

title: Nutritional yeast popcorn with paprika
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan, add the corn, cover and let it pop over medium heat for 3 minutes, shaking the pan.
Mix the nutritional yeast, paprika and salt.
Sprinkle the popcorn with the mixture straight away and toss well.

title: Mango lime sorbet with chilli
instructions: Let the mango soften for 5 minutes.
Blend with the coconut milk, lime juice and maple syrup in a food processor until creamy, scraping down the sides in between.
Scoop 2 balls into a glass and sprinkle with chilli flakes.

title: Blueberry skyr ice lollies with lemon
instructions: Stir the skyr with the honey and lemon zest, crush half of the blueberries with a fork and swirl them through.
Fold in the remaining blueberries.
Pour the mixture into 2 ice lolly moulds, insert the sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours.
Briefly hold the moulds under warm water and release the lollies.

title: Chocolate hummus with apple wedges
instructions: Blend the chickpeas with the tahini, cocoa, maple syrup, vanilla, a pinch of salt and 3 tbsp of water until very smooth.
Core the apple and cut it into wedges.
Spoon the hummus onto a plate and arrange the apple wedges alongside for dipping.

title: Blood orange skyr cream with almonds
instructions: Peel the blood orange and slice it, catching the juice.
Stir the skyr with the quark, honey and juice until creamy.
Layer the cream and orange slices in a glass and sprinkle with toasted flaked almonds.

title: Mango kulfi with skyr and pistachios
instructions: Peel the mango and blend finely with the skyr, milk, honey and cardamom.
Pour the mixture into 2 ice lolly moulds, insert the sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours.
Release the kulfi from the moulds and sprinkle with chopped pistachios and almonds.

title: Light banana split with skyr ice cream
instructions: Stir the skyr with the honey and vanilla and freeze for 2 hours, stirring every 30 minutes.
Halve the banana lengthways and place it in an oblong dish, halve the strawberries, melt the chocolate and chop the almonds.
Place 2 scoops of the skyr ice cream between the banana halves, add the strawberries, drizzle with the chocolate and sprinkle with the peanuts.

title: Affogato with protein ice cream
instructions: Stir the quark with the milk and protein powder until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Put one large scoop into a glass and pour the freshly brewed hot espresso over it.

title: Turkey and asparagus rolls
instructions: Peel the lower third of the asparagus, trim the woody ends and blanch in salted water for 3 minutes, then refresh in iced water and pat dry.
Mix the cream cheese with the lemon zest and pepper and spread thinly on the turkey slices.
Roll each asparagus spear in a turkey slice and drizzle with the oil.

title: Pear and goat cheese skewers with walnuts
instructions: Quarter and core the pear and cut each quarter into 3 pieces, cut the goat cheese into 6 cubes.
Thread 2 pear pieces and 1 cheese cube alternately onto each of 6 short skewers and lay them on the rocket.
Chop the walnuts, scatter them over and drizzle with the honey, thyme and pepper.

title: Apple donuts with skyr glaze and cocoa nibs
instructions: Cut the apple crossways into 4 thick rings and remove the core with a small cutter.
Stir the skyr with the honey and vanilla until smooth.
Drizzle the apple rings with lemon juice, spread them with the skyr glaze and sprinkle with cocoa nibs.

title: Blueberry quark muffins
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Mix the quark, egg and honey, then stir in the flour with the baking powder and vanilla.
Fold in the blueberries and divide the batter between 2 greased muffin cups.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and let cool in the tin for 5 minutes.

title: Carrot cake energy bites
instructions: Finely grate the carrot and squeeze it well, then chop 5 g of the walnuts very finely.
Blitz the oats, dates, remaining walnuts, pea protein and spices in a blender, then knead in the carrot.
Shape into 5 balls, roll them in the chopped walnuts and chill for 20 minutes.

title: Cocoa peanut protein pudding with chia
instructions: Blend the soy drink with the cocoa and soy protein until smooth.
Stir in the chia seeds, pour into a jar and stir again after 5 minutes.
Chill for at least 2 hours and add the peanut butter and raspberries on top before serving.

title: Strawberry cheesecake nice cream
instructions: Let the frozen fruit soften for 5 minutes.
Blend with the quark, cream cheese and vanilla in a food processor until creamy.
Scoop 2 balls into a glass and serve straight away.

title: Celery sticks with peanut butter and raisins
instructions: Wash the celery, remove the strings and cut each stick into 2 pieces.
Fill the groove of each piece with peanut butter.
Place the raisins in a row on top.

title: Blackcurrant sorbet with skyr
instructions: Let the blackcurrants soften for 5 minutes.
Blend with the honey in a food processor into a creamy sorbet.
Scoop 2 balls into a glass and top with a dollop of skyr.

title: Oven cauliflower popcorn with turmeric
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the cauliflower into very small florets.
Toss with the oil, turmeric, paprika, nutritional yeast and salt and spread out on a baking tray.
Roast for 25 minutes until golden, turning once.

title: Pea and mint dip with vegetable sticks
instructions: Cook the peas in boiling water for 3 minutes, refresh in cold water and drain.
Blend with the skyr, mint, lemon juice, oil, salt and pepper until creamy.
Cut the carrot and cucumber into sticks and serve with the dip.

title: Cherry yoghurt ice lollies with cocoa nibs
instructions: Let the cherries thaw and chop them roughly.
Stir the yoghurt with the honey and fold in the cherries and cocoa nibs.
Pour the mixture into 2 ice lolly moulds, insert the sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours.
Briefly hold the moulds under warm water and release the lollies.

title: Red lentil hummus with cumin and cucumber sticks
instructions: Cook the lentils in 150 ml of water for 12 minutes until soft, then drain and let cool.
Blend with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, salt and 2 tbsp of water until smooth.
Spread the hummus on a plate, dust with paprika and serve with cucumber sticks.

title: Lemon poppy seed muffins with quark
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Mix the skyr, egg, honey and lemon juice and zest.
Stir in the ground oats with the baking powder and poppy seeds and divide between 2 greased muffin cups.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and let cool.

title: Sour cherry kefir shake with oats and vanilla
instructions: Let the sour cherries soften for 5 minutes.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Mandarin and vanilla shake with quark
instructions: Peel the mandarins and divide them into segments.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Persimmon yoghurt cream with speculoos spice
instructions: Peel the persimmon and mash it finely with a fork.
Stir the spice into the yoghurt and layer it alternately with the persimmon purée in a glass.
Chop the walnuts and sprinkle them over the top.

title: Courgette hummus with za'atar and crudités
instructions: Dice the courgette and cook in a non-stick pan without oil for 8 minutes until soft, then let cool.
Blend with the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic and salt until smooth.
Spread the hummus on a plate, sprinkle with za'atar and serve with carrot sticks and halved radishes.

title: Honeydew melon and ginger shake with silken tofu
instructions: Peel, deseed and roughly dice the melon, then peel the ginger.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Chicken tikka with basmati rice and peas
instructions: Dice the chicken, mix it with the yoghurt and half of the spices and leave for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice according to the packet, adding the peas for the last 4 minutes.
Finely chop the onion, ginger and garlic, fry in the oil for 3 minutes, then add the remaining spices and the tomatoes.
Add the chicken to the sauce and simmer for 12 minutes, then serve with the rice and coriander.

title: Rump steak with baked potato and green beans
instructions: Wash the potato, prick it several times and bake at 200 °C for 45 minutes.
Cook the beans in salted water for 7 minutes and toss them with the garlic in 1 tsp oil.
Pat the steak dry, fry in the remaining oil for 3 minutes per side and rest for 5 minutes.
Cut open the potato, fill it with the skyr and chives and serve with the sliced steak and the beans.

title: Cod with beluga lentils and root vegetables
instructions: Cook the lentils in water for 20 minutes until al dente and drain.
Finely dice the carrot, parsnip and onion and sauté in 2 tsp oil for 8 minutes.
Stir in the lentils, mustard and vinegar and season with salt and pepper.
Fry the cod in the remaining oil for 3 minutes per side and serve on the lentils with parsley.

title: Turkey medallions with creamy mushrooms and wholemeal spaetzle
instructions: Cut the turkey breast into 4 medallions, season and fry in 1 tsp oil for 4 minutes per side.
Slice the mushrooms, dice the onion and fry both in the remaining oil for 6 minutes.
Add the cream, reduce for 2 minutes and season.
Warm the spaetzle in the pan and serve with the medallions, creamy mushrooms and parsley.

title: Chicken kebab skewers with freekeh and cucumber salad
instructions: Cook the freekeh in twice the amount of water for 20 minutes.
Dice the chicken and pepper, mix with 1 tsp oil, the lemon juice and spices and thread onto 2 skewers.
Fry the skewers in a grill pan in the remaining oil for 10 minutes, turning them.
Dice the cucumber, finely slice the onion, mix with the yoghurt and mint and serve with the freekeh and skewers.

title: Turkey teriyaki with udon and broccoli
instructions: Cook the udon according to the packet, cut the broccoli into florets, add for 4 minutes and drain.
Mix the soy sauce, honey, grated ginger and garlic.
Cut the turkey into strips and fry in the oil for 5 minutes, add the sauce and glaze for 2 minutes.
Toss in the noodles and broccoli and sprinkle with sesame and spring onion.

title: Pollock with potato and pea mash
instructions: Peel and dice the potatoes and boil in salted water for 15 minutes, adding the peas 4 minutes before the end.
Drain and roughly mash with the warm milk and butter, then season.
Season the pollock, fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side and drizzle with the lemon juice.
Serve the fish on the mash and sprinkle with dill.

title: Beef steak strips with rice noodles and peppers
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in hot water according to the packet and drain.
Cut the steak into thin strips, sear in the hot oil for 2 minutes and remove.
Cut the pepper into strips and the spring onions into rings and fry with the garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the noodles, beef, soy sauce and lime juice, toss briefly and serve with coriander and chilli.

title: Chicken thighs with roast potatoes and Brussels sprouts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C, quarter the potatoes and halve the Brussels sprouts.
Mix the vegetables with 2 tsp oil, thyme, salt and pepper and bake on a tray for 15 minutes.
Mix the mustard, honey, paprika and remaining oil and brush the thighs with it.
Place the thighs on the tray and bake everything for another 22 minutes.

title: Turkey breast with millet and ratatouille
instructions: Rinse the millet with hot water and cook in twice the amount of water for 15 minutes.
Dice the aubergine, courgette, pepper, tomatoes and onion and braise with the garlic in 2 tsp oil for 15 minutes.
Season with the herbs, salt and pepper.
Fry the turkey breast in the remaining oil for 5 minutes per side, slice and serve with the millet and ratatouille.

title: Halloumi and chicken skewers with couscous
instructions: Pour 100 ml boiling water over the couscous, leave to swell for 5 minutes and mix with the lemon juice and mint.
Dice the chicken, halloumi and pepper and cut the courgette into thick slices.
Thread everything alternately with the tomatoes onto 2 skewers and brush with the oil and oregano.
Fry the skewers in a grill pan for 10 minutes, turning, and serve on the couscous.

title: Chicken massaman curry with potatoes and rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Cut the onion into wedges, dice the potatoes and toast the curry paste in a pot for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, 100 ml water, potatoes, onion, tamarind and spices and simmer for 12 minutes.
Dice the chicken, add and cook for 10 minutes, sprinkle with chopped peanuts and serve with the rice.

title: Beef pho with rice noodles
instructions: Halve the onion and toast with the ginger in a dry pan for 4 minutes.
Simmer the broth with the onion, ginger, star anise and cinnamon for 20 minutes, strain and season with the fish sauce.
Cook the rice noodles according to the packet and put them in a bowl, slice the steak very thinly and lay on top.
Pour the boiling broth over it and serve with the sprouts, herbs, chilli and lime juice.

title: Beef kofta curry with basmati rice
instructions: Knead the mince with half of the spices, salt and the garlic and form 8 small balls.
Brown the balls in the oil for 5 minutes and remove, then cook the rice according to the packet.
Chop the onion and ginger, fry for 3 minutes, add the remaining spices and tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cook the balls in the sauce for 10 minutes, fold in the spinach, drizzle with yoghurt and serve with the rice.

title: Steak bowl with chimichurri, rice and black beans
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Finely chop the parsley and garlic and stir with 2 tsp oil, the vinegar, oregano and chilli into a chimichurri.
Season the steak, fry in the remaining oil for 3 minutes per side, rest for 5 minutes and slice.
Arrange the rice, warmed beans, corn, halved tomatoes and steak in a bowl and drizzle with the chimichurri.

title: Tandoori salmon with lentil dal and rice
instructions: Brush the salmon with the yoghurt and half of the spices and cook in the oven at 200 °C for 14 minutes.
Cook the rice according to the packet.
Fry the onion, ginger and garlic in the oil for 3 minutes, add the lentils, diced tomato, remaining spices and 250 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Fold the spinach into the dal and serve with the salmon and rice.

title: Chelo kebab koobideh with saffron rice
instructions: Finely grate the onion, squeeze it well and knead firmly with both kinds of mince, salt and pepper.
Shape the mixture into 2 long flat kebabs and fry in a grill pan with the oil for 4 minutes per side.
Halve the tomatoes and grill them alongside for 5 minutes.
Cook the rice, dissolve the saffron in 1 tbsp hot water, mix it with the butter into part of the rice and serve everything with sumac.

title: Salmon with pearl barley and pea risotto
instructions: Dice the onion and sweat in the oil for 2 minutes, then add the barley.
Gradually add the broth and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring.
Add the peas for the last 5 minutes and stir in the parmesan and lemon juice.
Fry the salmon in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes per side and serve on the risotto.

title: Turkey rolls with sage and polenta
instructions: Pound the escalopes flat, season, top each with 3 sage leaves and roll up.
Fry the rolls in the oil for 10 minutes, turning, adding the tomatoes for the last 4 minutes.
Bring the milk to the boil with 150 ml water, stir in the polenta and leave to swell for 5 minutes.
Stir the parmesan into the polenta and serve with the rolls and tomatoes.

title: Cottage pie with minced beef and sweet potato topping
instructions: Peel and dice the sweet potato, boil for 15 minutes and mash with the milk.
Fry the mince in the oil until crumbly, then fry the diced onion and carrot with it for 4 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, broth, peas and thyme, simmer for 8 minutes and put into a baking dish.
Spread the mash on top, make ridges with a fork and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.

title: Marry me chicken with wholemeal penne
instructions: Cook the penne according to the packet.
Season the chicken breast, fry in the oil for 5 minutes per side and remove.
Fry the garlic and chopped tomatoes for 1 minute, add the broth, cream, oregano and chilli and simmer for 3 minutes.
