Stir in the parmesan and spinach, return the sliced chicken to the sauce and serve with the penne and basil.

title: Salmon burrito with rice, black beans and slaw
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet, rinse the beans and warm briefly with the cumin.
Season the salmon with paprika and salt, fry in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes per side and flake.
Finely shred the red cabbage and mix with the lime juice, yoghurt, coriander and salt.
Warm the wrap, fill with the rice, beans, salmon and slaw, roll up tightly and halve diagonally.

title: Chicken Caesar wrap with parmesan
instructions: Hard-boil the egg for 9 minutes, cool, peel and chop.
Season the chicken, fry in the oil for 5 minutes per side and cut into strips.
Stir the yoghurt with the mustard, lemon juice, grated garlic and half of the parmesan.
Spread the wraps with the dressing, top with lettuce, chicken, egg and the remaining parmesan, roll up and halve diagonally.

title: Peanut noodles with chicken and cucumber
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the packet and rinse under cold water.
Poach the chicken in water for 12 minutes and pull into strips.
Stir the peanut butter with the soy sauce, lime juice, sriracha, ginger, garlic and 3 tbsp water until smooth.
Cut the cucumber and carrot into fine strips, mix everything with the sauce and sprinkle with chopped peanuts and spring onion.

title: Thai pineapple rice with chicken and cashews
instructions: Cook the rice and let it cool completely, ideally use rice from the day before.
Dice the chicken and fry in 1 tsp oil for 5 minutes, toast the cashews with it for 1 minute and remove.
Scramble the egg in the remaining oil, add the rice, peas and curry powder and fry for 4 minutes.
Mix in the diced pineapple, chicken, cashews and soy sauce and sprinkle with spring onion.

title: Sea bass with roasted vegetables and quinoa
instructions: Cut the courgette, pepper and onion into pieces, mix with 2 tsp oil and oregano and roast at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Rinse the quinoa and cook in twice the amount of water for 15 minutes.
Add the tomatoes to the vegetables after 10 minutes.
Fry the fish skin side down in the remaining oil for 4 minutes, turn, cook for 1 minute and serve with lemon juice on the quinoa and vegetables.

title: Minced turkey, pepper and rice skillet with yoghurt
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Fry the minced turkey in the oil until crumbly, then fry the diced onion and pepper with it for 5 minutes.
Toast the tomato paste and spices for 1 minute, add the rice and 50 ml water and fry for 3 minutes.
Serve with a dollop of yoghurt and parsley.

title: Chicken millet bowl with kale and tahini
instructions: Rinse the millet and cook in twice the amount of water for 15 minutes.
Season the chicken with paprika, fry in the oil for 5 minutes per side and slice.
Tear the kale and briefly massage with some lemon juice and salt, then grate the carrot.
Stir the tahini with the remaining lemon juice and 2 tbsp water, arrange everything in a bowl and drizzle over.

title: Prawn and tomato risotto with peas
instructions: Dice the onion and garlic and sweat in 1 tsp oil, then toast the rice with them for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and gradually the broth and simmer for 18 minutes, stirring.
Add the peas for the last 4 minutes and stir in the parmesan.
Fry the prawns in the remaining oil for 3 minutes, put on the risotto and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Soy chunk paprikash with wholemeal pasta
instructions: Soak the soy chunks in 200 ml hot broth for 10 minutes and squeeze out.
Fry the chunks in the oil for 5 minutes, then fry the diced onion and pepper with them for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and spices, deglaze with the remaining broth and braise for 10 minutes, then cook the pasta according to the packet.
Remove from the heat, stir in the soy yoghurt and serve with the pasta and parsley.

title: Sheet-pan gnocchi with chicken, peppers and red onions
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 °C, cut the pepper and onion into wedges and the chicken into cubes.
Mix the gnocchi, vegetables, chicken and chopped garlic with the oil and spices on a tray.
Bake for 25 minutes, turning once after 12 minutes.
Fill into a meal prep box, let cool and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Asian glass noodle salad with chicken, red cabbage and peanuts
instructions: Pour boiling water over the glass noodles, leave for 5 minutes, rinse cold and cut shorter.
Poach the chicken in water for 12 minutes and pull into strips.
Finely shred the red cabbage, cut the carrot and cucumber into fine strips and mix with the lime juice, soy sauce, sesame oil and chilli.
Mix in the noodles and chicken and sprinkle with chopped peanuts and coriander.
Fill into a meal prep box and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days, enjoy cold.

title: Mediterranean lentil salad with tuna and peppers
instructions: Cook the lentils in water for 20 minutes until al dente, drain and let cool.
Dice the pepper and cucumber, finely chop the onion and halve the olives.
Mix everything with the oil, vinegar, parsley, salt and pepper and fold in the roughly flaked tuna.
Fill into a meal prep box and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days, enjoy cold.

title: Tex-Mex quinoa salad with turkey, black beans and corn
instructions: Rinse the quinoa, cook in twice the amount of water for 15 minutes and let cool.
Rub the turkey with the spices, fry in 1 tsp oil for 5 minutes per side and dice.
Rinse the beans, dice the pepper, halve the tomatoes and mix everything with the quinoa, corn, lime juice, remaining oil and coriander.
Fill into a meal prep box and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days, enjoy cold.

title: Buckwheat salad with smoked tofu and red cabbage
instructions: Cook the buckwheat in twice the amount of water for 12 minutes and let cool.
Dice the smoked tofu and fry in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until crisp.
Finely shred the red cabbage, dice the apple, knead with the vinegar, mustard, oil, salt and pepper and mix with the buckwheat, tofu and parsley.
Fill into a meal prep box and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days, enjoy cold.

title: Roasted pumpkin and beluga lentil box with cottage cheese
instructions: Deseed the pumpkin, cut into wedges, mix with 1 tsp oil and rosemary and roast at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Cook the lentils in water for 20 minutes, drain and mix with the balsamic, remaining oil, salt and pepper.
Put the lentils, pumpkin and rocket into the box, add the cottage cheese alongside and sprinkle with pumpkin seeds and chilli.
Fill into a meal prep box, let cool and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Chicken pesto pasta salad with green beans and cherry tomatoes
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the packet, halve the beans and add 6 minutes before the end, drain and rinse cold.
Season the chicken, fry in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes per side and cut into strips.
Halve the tomatoes and mix everything with the pesto, lemon juice and basil.
Fill into a meal prep box and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days, enjoy cold.

title: Minced beef and bulgur box with aubergine and yoghurt
instructions: Pour 120 ml boiling water over the bulgur and leave to swell for 10 minutes.
Dice the aubergine and fry in the oil for 6 minutes, add the mince and diced onion and fry for 5 minutes until crumbly.
Add the tomatoes and spices, simmer for 5 minutes and fill into the box with the bulgur, adding the yoghurt separately.
Fill into a meal prep box, let cool and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Salmon, potato and asparagus box with dill yoghurt
instructions: Halve the potatoes and boil in salted water for 15 minutes.
Place the salmon and asparagus on a tray with the oil, salt and pepper and bake at 200 °C for 12 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt with chopped dill, lemon juice and salt and pack separately.
Fill into a meal prep box, let cool and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Millet and vegetable box with tofu and peanut sauce
instructions: Cook the millet in twice the amount of water for 15 minutes.
Dice the tofu and fry in the oil for 8 minutes until golden, then steam the broccoli and sliced carrot for 5 minutes.
Stir the peanut butter with the soy sauce, lime juice, grated ginger and 2 tbsp water and pour over the tofu and vegetables.
Fill into a meal prep box, let cool and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Black bean and sweet potato box with rice and lime
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Dice the sweet potato, mix with 1 tsp oil and the spices and roast at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Dice the onion and pepper, fry in the remaining oil for 4 minutes, add the beans and season with the lime juice.
Fill into a meal prep box, let cool and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Pearl barley salad with smoked trout and cucumber
instructions: Cook the pearl barley in salted water for 30 minutes, drain and let cool.
Dice the cucumber and radishes and stir the yoghurt with the horseradish, vinegar, oil and chopped dill.
Mix the barley with the vegetables and dressing and lay the trout pieces on top.
Fill into a meal prep box and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days, enjoy cold.

title: Greek orzo box with chicken, cucumber and tzatziki
instructions: Cook the orzo according to the packet and rinse cold.
Season the chicken with oregano, fry in the oil for 5 minutes per side and cut into strips.
Grate a third of the cucumber and stir with the yoghurt, garlic and salt into tzatziki, dice the remaining cucumber and mix into the orzo with the tomatoes, onion and olives.
Fill into a meal prep box, let cool and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Mie noodle box with chicken and sugar snap peas
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the packet and drain.
Cut the chicken into strips and fry in the oil for 5 minutes.
Fry the sugar snap peas, carrot and pepper strips with the ginger and garlic for 4 minutes, mix in the noodles and soy sauce and sprinkle with sesame.
Fill into a meal prep box, let cool and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Chicken and pepper goulash box with potatoes
instructions: Dice the chicken and brown in the oil for 4 minutes, then fry the onion and pepper pieces with it for 4 minutes.
Toast the tomato paste and spices for 1 minute, deglaze with the broth and simmer for 15 minutes.
Dice the potatoes, boil in salted water for 15 minutes and serve the goulash with the yoghurt.
Fill into a meal prep box, let cool and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Chickpea pasta salad with turkey and rocket
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the packet, drain and rinse cold.
Season the turkey, fry in 1 tsp oil for 5 minutes per side and cut into strips.
Halve the tomatoes, dice the cucumber, mix everything with the lemon juice and remaining oil and top with rocket and shaved parmesan.
Fill into a meal prep box and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days, enjoy cold.

title: Sweet chilli tofu box with rice and peppers
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Dice the tofu, toss in the starch and fry in the oil for 8 minutes until crisp.
Fry the pepper and broccoli with it for 4 minutes, add the sweet chilli sauce and soy sauce and sprinkle with spring onion.
Fill into a meal prep box, let cool and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Couscous salad with prawns, courgette and mint
instructions: Pour 90 ml boiling water over the couscous and leave to swell for 5 minutes.
Dice the courgette and fry in 1 tsp oil for 4 minutes, then fry the prawns with the paprika for 3 minutes.
Halve the tomatoes, finely chop the onion and mix everything with the couscous, lemon juice, remaining oil and mint.
Fill into a meal prep box and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days, enjoy cold.

title: Turkey breast and sweet potato box with green beans and herb quark
instructions: Cut the sweet potato into wedges, mix with 1 tsp oil and thyme and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Season the turkey with paprika and fry in the remaining oil for 5 minutes per side, then cook the beans in salted water for 7 minutes.
Stir the quark with the milk, chopped herbs and salt and pack separately.
Fill into a meal prep box, let cool and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Lentil and spinach box with roasted carrots and tahini
instructions: Halve the carrots lengthways, mix with the oil and cumin and roast at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Cook the lentils in water for 20 minutes, drain and fold in the spinach and chopped garlic until it wilts.
Stir the tahini with the lemon juice, 2 tbsp water and salt and drizzle over the lentils and carrots.
Fill into a meal prep box, let cool and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Kohlrabi carbonara with chicken strips
instructions: Peel the kohlrabi and cut it into spaghetti with a spiraliser.
Cut the chicken into strips and fry in 2 tsp oil for 5 minutes, briefly frying the garlic with it.
Sauté the kohlrabi spaghetti in the remaining oil for 3 minutes until al dente.
Whisk the egg yolks with the cream, parmesan and pepper, take the pan off the heat and stir in the sauce and chicken until creamy.

title: Creamy mushroom chicken with spinach
instructions: Season the chicken thighs, fry in the oil for 5 minutes per side and remove.
Melt the butter in the pan and fry the sliced mushrooms and chopped shallot for 5 minutes.
Add the cream and thyme, reduce for 2 minutes and stir in the spinach and parmesan.
Return the chicken to the sauce and leave to simmer gently for 4 minutes.

title: Egg roll in a bowl with minced turkey and white cabbage
instructions: Cut the white cabbage into fine strips and chop the ginger and garlic.
Fry the minced turkey in the rapeseed oil for 5 minutes until crumbly, frying the ginger and garlic with it for 1 minute.
Add the cabbage and stir-fry for 5 minutes, then season with the tamari and sesame oil.
Stir the mayonnaise with the chilli, drizzle over the bowl and sprinkle with spring onion.

title: Beef burger in a lettuce wrap with cheddar
instructions: Shape the mince with salt and pepper into a flat patty.
Fry the patty in a hot pan for 4 minutes per side, topping it with the cheddar for the last minute to melt.
Stir the mayonnaise with the mustard and spread on 2 lettuce leaves.
Place the patty with the tomato and pickle on the lettuce leaves and cover with the remaining leaves.

title: White asparagus with salmon and butter hollandaise
instructions: Peel the asparagus, cut off the woody ends and cook in salted water for 12 minutes.
Season the salmon and fry in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes per side.
Melt the butter, whisk the egg yolk with the lemon juice and 1 tbsp water over a hot water bath until foamy and slowly stir in the butter.
Arrange the asparagus with the salmon, spoon the hollandaise over and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Chicken Alfredo with courgette noodles
instructions: Cut the courgette into noodles with a spiraliser.
Cut the chicken into strips, season and fry in the oil for 6 minutes, then remove.
Sweat the butter and chopped garlic for 1 minute, add the cream, simmer for 2 minutes and stir in the parmesan.
Toss the courgette noodles in the sauce for 2 minutes, mix in the chicken and season with pepper.

title: Gambas al ajillo with courgette
instructions: Cut the courgette into half-moons, fry in 1 tbsp oil for 4 minutes and remove.
Warm the remaining oil with the thinly sliced garlic and chilli over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink.
Mix in the courgette and halved cherry tomatoes, warm for 1 minute and season with salt and parsley.

title: Salmon trout with herb butter and fennel
instructions: Cut the fennel into thin wedges and fry in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Mix the soft butter with the chopped herbs, lemon juice and salt.
Fry the salmon trout skin side down for 4 minutes, turn and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the fish on the fennel and top with the herb butter.

title: Sea bass with olive tapenade and green beans
instructions: Chop the olives, capers, garlic, pine nuts and 1 tbsp oil into a coarse tapenade.
Cook the beans in salted water for 7 minutes and toss in 1 tsp oil.
Fry the sea bass skin side down in the remaining oil for 4 minutes, turn and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the fish with the beans and spoon the tapenade on top.

title: Cod in mustard cream with spinach
instructions: Season the cod and fry in the oil in a non-stick pan for 3 minutes per side, then remove.
Finely dice the shallot and sweat in half of the butter, stir in the cream and mustard and reduce for 3 minutes.
Wilt the spinach in the remaining butter for 2 minutes and season.
Lay the fish on the spinach and pour over the mustard sauce.

title: Mackerel and avocado salad with radishes
instructions: Wash the lamb's lettuce, slice the radishes and dice the cucumber.
Dice the avocado and drizzle with the lemon juice.
Skin the mackerel and pull it into rough pieces.
Mix everything with the oil, salt and pepper and sprinkle with chives.

title: Chicken thighs with roasted cauliflower and herb butter
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 °C, cut the cauliflower into florets and mix with 2 tsp oil, salt and thyme.
Rub the chicken thighs with the remaining oil and paprika and place on a tray with the cauliflower.
Bake for 25 minutes.
Mix the butter with the chopped parsley and garlic and let it melt on the hot meat.

title: Lamb skewers with tzatziki and cucumber
instructions: Dice the lamb, mix with 2 tsp oil, oregano and cumin and thread onto 2 skewers.
Grate a third of the cucumber, squeeze it out and stir with the yoghurt, garlic, mint and salt.
Fry the skewers in a grill pan for 8 minutes, turning.
Slice the remaining cucumber, mix with the onion, olives and remaining oil and serve with the skewers and tzatziki.

title: Hake with beurre blanc and chard
instructions: Finely dice the shallot and reduce with the white wine to 1 tbsp.
Take the pan off the heat, gradually whisk in 30 g cold butter in pieces and season with salt.
Cut the chard into strips and sauté with the garlic in the remaining butter for 4 minutes.
Fry the hake in the oil for 3 minutes per side and serve with the chard and beurre blanc.

title: Tuna steak with sesame crust and pak choi
instructions: Season the tuna and coat it all over in the sesame seeds.
Sear in the rapeseed oil for 1 minute per side so that it stays pink inside and slice.
Halve the pak choi and fry with the grated ginger in the sesame oil for 3 minutes, then deglaze with the tamari.
Serve the tuna with the pak choi and avocado slices.

title: Minced beef and spinach skillet with feta and pine nuts
instructions: Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden and set aside.
Fry the mince in the oil for 5 minutes until crumbly, frying the diced onion, garlic and spices with it for 2 minutes.
Add the spinach and let it wilt for 2 minutes, then season.
Crumble the feta over it and sprinkle with the pine nuts.

title: Tofu walnut tacos in lettuce leaves
instructions: Crumble the tofu finely with your hands and roughly chop the walnuts.
Fry the tofu in the oil for 6 minutes until crisp, add the walnuts, spices and tamari and fry for another 2 minutes.
Mash the avocado with the lime juice and salt and finely dice the tomato.
Fill the lettuce leaves with the tofu walnut filling, avocado and tomato.

title: Chicken breast stuffed with spinach and cream cheese
instructions: Wilt the spinach with the garlic in 1 tsp oil, squeeze out and mix with the cream cheese and parmesan.
Cut a pocket into the side of the chicken breast and fill it with the spinach mixture.
Brown in the remaining oil for 3 minutes per side and cook in the oven at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Cut open and sprinkle with toasted pine nuts.

title: Porcini omelette with vegetarian hard cheese
instructions: Slice the porcini and fry in half of the butter for 5 minutes until golden, then season.
Whisk the eggs with the cream, half of the hard cheese, salt and pepper.
Melt the remaining butter in a pan, add the eggs, let set for 3 minutes, spread the mushrooms over them and fold.
Sprinkle with the remaining hard cheese and parsley and serve with lamb's lettuce in oil.

title: Redfish with caper butter and kohlrabi
instructions: Peel the kohlrabi, cut into sticks and fry in 2 tsp oil for 8 minutes, then season.
Season the redfish and fry in the remaining oil for 3 minutes per side.
Brown the butter lightly in a small pan and add the capers and lemon juice.
Serve the fish with the kohlrabi, pour over the caper butter and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Dal tadka with yellow lentils and brown rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Rinse the lentils and cook with the turmeric in 400 ml water for 20 minutes until soft, then salt.
Fry the onion, ginger and diced tomato in 1 tsp oil for 5 minutes and stir into the lentils.
For the tadka heat the remaining oil, toast the cumin, mustard seeds, garlic and chilli for 1 minute, pour over the dal and serve with the rice and coriander.

title: Succotash with lima beans, corn and chicken
instructions: Dice the chicken, season with paprika and fry in 1 tsp oil for 6 minutes, then remove.
Dice the onion, pepper and courgette and fry in the remaining oil for 5 minutes.
Add the lima beans, corn and thyme and heat for 4 minutes.
Mix in the chicken, season and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Monggo guisado – Filipino mung bean stew with spinach
instructions: Rinse the mung beans and cook in 600 ml water for 30 minutes until soft.
Fry the onion, garlic, ginger and diced tomato in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add to the beans, then add the prawns and fish sauce and simmer for 4 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts and season with pepper.

title: Dal dhokli – Gujarati lentil stew with wholemeal dough diamonds
instructions: Rinse the dal and cook with the turmeric in 500 ml water for 25 minutes until soft.
Knead the flour with a pinch of salt, cumin and 30 ml water, roll out thinly and cut into diamonds.
Heat the oil, fry the mustard seeds, chilli, peanuts and diced tomato for 2 minutes and add to the dal.
Add the dough diamonds to the simmering dal, cook for 10 minutes and serve with the lemon juice and coriander.

title: Ghugni – Bengali yellow pea curry with wholemeal chapati
instructions: Soak the peas overnight and cook in fresh water for 35 minutes until soft.
Dice the potato, chop the onion and ginger and fry in the oil with the spices for 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomato, peas and 150 ml cooking water and simmer for 12 minutes.
Sprinkle with coriander and serve with the warmed chapati.

title: Adasi – Persian lentil stew with cumin and yoghurt
instructions: Cook the lentils with the diced potato and turmeric in 500 ml water for 30 minutes until soft.
Slice the onion into rings and fry in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Season the lentils with cumin and salt and mash lightly.
Serve with the fried onions, yoghurt, mint and warm pita.

title: Kabuli pulao with chickpeas, carrots and raisins
instructions: Dice the onion and fry in 1 tsp oil for 5 minutes, then toast the rice and spices with it for 1 minute.
Add the broth and chickpeas and cook covered for 30 minutes.
Cut the carrots into fine sticks and fry with the raisins in the remaining oil for 4 minutes.
Plate the rice and top with the carrots, raisins and toasted almonds.

title: Cocka na kyselo – Czech sour lentils with fried egg
instructions: Cook the lentils with the bay leaf and allspice in 500 ml water for 25 minutes until soft.
Dice the onion, fry in 1 tsp oil for 4 minutes, sprinkle in the flour and stir smooth with some cooking water.
Add the lentils, season tangy with the vinegar, mustard and salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Fry the egg sunny side up in the remaining oil and serve with the lentils, pickle and bread.

title: Jamaican rice and peas with kidney beans, coconut and pumpkin
instructions: Bring the rice to the boil with the coconut milk, 100 ml water, thyme, allspice and garlic.
Add the kidney beans and diced pumpkin and cook covered for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and leave to rest for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with spring onion and chilli.

title: Westphalian blind hen – bean, pear and potato stew
instructions: Dice the onion and sweat in the oil for 3 minutes.
Dice the potatoes and carrots, cut the green beans into pieces and simmer with the broth and savory for 15 minutes.
Cut the pear into wedges and add with the white beans, then cook for another 8 minutes.
Season and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Frijoles de la olla with pinto beans, egg and corn tortilla
instructions: Dice the onion, garlic and tomato and bring to the boil with 300 ml water, oregano and cumin.
Add the beans, simmer for 15 minutes and salt.
Boil the egg for 7 minutes until jammy, peel and halve, then warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Serve the beans with the egg, avocado, chilli and coriander, with the tortillas on the side.

title: Vegetarian haggis with lentils, oats and swede mash
instructions: Cook the lentils in the broth for 20 minutes.
Finely chop the onion, carrot and mushrooms, fry in the oil for 6 minutes and toast the oats and spices with them for 2 minutes.
Add the lentils with the broth and reduce for 8 minutes, stirring, to a compact mixture, then season with pepper.
Dice the swede and potato, boil for 18 minutes, mash with the milk and nutmeg and serve with the haggis.

title: Hutspot with white beans and chicken
instructions: Dice the potatoes, carrots and onion and boil in salted water for 20 minutes until soft.
Add the beans for the last 3 minutes, drain and roughly mash with the milk, half of the butter and nutmeg.
Season the chicken, fry in the remaining butter for 5 minutes per side and slice.
Serve the mash with the chicken and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Kadala curry – Keralan chickpea coconut curry with brown rice
ingredients: Curry leaves, mustard seeds, turmeric, cinnamon, chilli
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet and toast the desiccated coconut in a dry pan until golden.
Toast the mustard seeds and curry leaves in the oil for 1 minute, then fry the onion, ginger and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the tomato, remaining spices, chickpeas and coconut milk and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the toasted coconut and serve with the rice.

title: Tamale pie with black beans and cornbread crust
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, dice the onion and pepper and fry in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes.
Add the beans, corn, tomatoes, cumin and chilli, simmer for 5 minutes and put into a small baking dish.
Stir the cornmeal with the milk, egg, baking powder and salt, spread over the filling and sprinkle with cheddar.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden.

title: Pasta e lenticchie with wholemeal pasta
instructions: Finely dice the carrot, celery and onion and sweat in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, rosemary and broth and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook for 10 minutes until al dente and the soup is thick.
Sprinkle with chilli and hard cheese.

title: Tempe orek – Indonesian tempeh with green beans, peanuts and brown rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Cut the tempeh into thin sticks and fry in the oil for 6 minutes until crisp.
Fry the beans, pepper strips, garlic and chilli with it for 4 minutes.
Add the tamari, maple syrup and peanuts, glaze for 1 minute and serve with the rice.

title: Bolani – Afghan wholemeal flatbreads with lentil and leek filling and yoghurt
instructions: Knead the flour with salt and 50 ml water into a smooth dough and leave to rest for 15 minutes.
Cook the lentils for 20 minutes until soft, finely slice the leek and sauté with the lentils and spices for 3 minutes.
Halve the dough, roll into 2 thin circles, fill one half of each and fold into half-moons.
Fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side until golden and serve with the yoghurt and mint.

title: Kapusta z grochem – Polish sauerkraut with yellow peas
instructions: Cook the peas in 400 ml water for 35 minutes until soft.
Simmer the sauerkraut with the bay leaf, caraway and 100 ml water for 20 minutes.
Dice the onion and mushrooms, fry in the oil for 6 minutes and season with marjoram.
Mix the peas, sauerkraut and mushrooms, season and serve with the bread.

title: Arroz con gandules – Puerto Rican rice with pigeon peas
instructions: Soak the pigeon peas for 2 hours and precook in fresh water for 25 minutes.
For the sofrito chop the onion, pepper, garlic and coriander and fry in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, spices, rice, pigeon peas and 250 ml water and cook covered for 30 minutes.
Fold in the halved olives and leave to rest for 5 minutes.

title: Air fryer salmon with mustard crust and green asparagus
instructions: Halve the potatoes, toss them with half of the oil and salt and precook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes.
Brush the salmon with mustard and press the panko and chopped parsley on top.
Toss the asparagus with the remaining oil, place it with the salmon next to the potatoes in the air fryer and cook at 200 °C for 10 minutes.
Season everything with salt and pepper and serve together.

title: Air fryer stuffed sweet potato with chicken, spinach and feta
instructions: Halve the sweet potato lengthwise, prick it several times and cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for 25 minutes until soft.
Dice the chicken, season with paprika and salt, fry in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the spinach and let it wilt.
Fluff up the sweet potato halves with a fork, fill them with the chicken spinach mixture, crumble the feta on top and bake in the air fryer for 3 minutes.
Serve with the yogurt and spring onion rings.

title: Air fryer chicken Kiev with herb butter and broccoli
instructions: Knead the butter with chopped parsley, garlic and salt and chill for 10 minutes.
Cut a pocket into the side of the chicken breast, fill it with the herb butter and close with a toothpick.
Coat the chicken in beaten egg and then in panko and cook with the potato wedges in the air fryer at 190 °C for 20 minutes.
Steam the broccoli florets for 4 minutes and serve with the Kiev and potatoes.

title: Air fryer salmon skewers with zucchini and herb quinoa
instructions: Cook the quinoa in salted water for 15 minutes according to the package and drain.
Cube the salmon, slice the zucchini and thread alternately with the tomatoes onto 4 skewers, brush with oil and salt.
Cook the skewers in the air fryer at 200 °C for 9 minutes.
Mix the quinoa with the herbs and lemon juice and serve with the skewers.

title: Air fryer chicken crust pizza with tomato and mozzarella
instructions: Knead the chicken mince with the egg, parmesan, oregano and salt and press into a thin round base of about 20 cm on baking paper.
Prebake the base on the paper in the air fryer at 190 °C for 10 minutes.
Spread with the strained tomatoes, top with the mozzarella and halved cherry tomatoes and bake for another 6 minutes.
Serve topped with the rocket and basil.

title: Air fryer smash burger tacos with beef mince and pickles
instructions: Divide the beef mince into 3 portions, salt them and press each one very thinly onto a tortilla.
Cook the tortillas meat side up in the air fryer at 200 °C for 7 minutes, sprinkle the cheddar on top and let it melt for 1 minute.
Stir the yogurt with the mustard, cut the lettuce into strips and slice the pickle and tomato.
Top the tacos with the lettuce, pickles, tomato and sauce and fold them.

title: Air fryer smoky tempeh bowl with rice, avocado and cucumber
instructions: Cook the rice for 30 minutes according to the package.
Cut the tempeh into very thin strips and marinate them for 5 minutes in the tamari, maple syrup and smoked paprika.
Cook the strips in the air fryer at 190 °C for 8 minutes until crisp, turning halfway.
Put the rice into a bowl, arrange the avocado, cucumber, red cabbage, edamame and tempeh on top and sprinkle with sesame.

title: Air fryer jacket potato with tuna sweetcorn cream
instructions: Wash the potato, prick it several times, rub with oil and salt and cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 40 minutes.
Stir the tuna, sweetcorn, quark, spring onion, salt and pepper into a cream.
Cut a cross into the potato, push it open and fill with the cream.
Sprinkle with chives and serve with the lamb's lettuce.

title: Air fryer Cajun chicken with corn on the cob and coleslaw
instructions: Rub the chicken with half of the oil and the Cajun seasoning and brush the corn cob with the remaining oil.
Cook both in the air fryer at 200 °C for 16 minutes, turning halfway.
Finely shred the cabbage, grate the carrot and mix with the yogurt, vinegar, mustard and salt into a coleslaw.
Slice the chicken and serve with the corn cob and coleslaw.

title: Air fryer pointed cabbage steaks with chicken and peanut sauce
instructions: Cut the pointed cabbage lengthwise into 2 thick steaks, brush with half of the oil and salt.
Cook the cabbage steaks in the air fryer at 190 °C for 14 minutes until the edges are browned.
Cut the chicken into strips and fry them in the remaining oil for 6 minutes.
Stir the peanut butter with the tamari, lime juice, grated ginger and 3 tbsp water until smooth, pour over the cabbage and chicken and sprinkle with chopped peanuts and coriander.

title: Air fryer pike-perch with potato scales and spinach
instructions: Slice the potato very thinly, toss with half of the oil and layer it like scales on the skin side of the pike-perch fillet.
Salt the fish and cook it potato side up in the air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes until the scales are crisp.
Sweat the garlic in the remaining oil, add the spinach, let it wilt for 2 minutes and season with nutmeg and salt.
Arrange the pike-perch on the spinach and drizzle with lemon juice.

title: Air fryer turkey steak with za'atar and lentil tomato salad
instructions: Cook the lentils in water for 25 minutes until al dente and drain.
Rub the turkey steak with half of the oil, za'atar and salt and cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes, turning halfway.
Dice the tomatoes, cucumber and onion and mix with the lentils, lemon juice, remaining oil, parsley and salt.
Slice the steak and serve on the salad.

title: Air fryer smoked tofu skewers with peppers and bulgur
instructions: Pour 120 ml of boiling salted water over the bulgur and let it soak for 10 minutes.
Cut the smoked tofu, peppers and onion into large cubes, thread them alternately onto 4 skewers and brush with the oil and spices.
Cook the skewers in the air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes, turning halfway.
Fluff up the bulgur with the lemon juice and parsley and serve with the skewers.

title: Air fryer crunchwrap with chicken, beans and lettuce
instructions: Dice the chicken finely, season with cumin, chilli and salt and fry in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes, warming the beans along for 1 minute.
Place the chicken bean mixture and cheddar in the centre of the wrap, lay the corn tortilla on top, spread with yogurt and add the lettuce and tomato.
Fold the wrap all around towards the centre and cook it fold side down in the air fryer at 190 °C for 6 minutes until crisp.
Halve and serve.

title: Air fryer lentil balls in tomato sauce with wholewheat spaghetti
instructions: Cook the lentils in 120 ml of water for 10 minutes until soft and the water is absorbed, then let them cool slightly.
Knead the lentils with the oats, nutritional yeast, oregano and salt, shape into 8 balls, brush with oil and cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for 12 minutes.
Finely dice the onion and garlic, sweat them in a pot for 2 minutes, add the strained tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes. Cook the spaghetti according to the package.
Add the balls to the sauce and serve with the spaghetti and basil.

title: Air fryer red cabbage steaks with feta, walnuts and lentils
instructions: Cut the red cabbage into 2 thick slices, brush with half of the oil, salt and sprinkle with thyme.
Cook the cabbage steaks in the air fryer at 190 °C for 18 minutes, turning halfway.
Cook the lentils in water for 25 minutes, drain and mix with the balsamic, remaining oil and salt.
Arrange the cabbage steaks on the lentils, crumble the feta over them and sprinkle with chopped walnuts.

title: Air fryer mackerel with beetroot potatoes and horseradish yogurt
instructions: Cut the potatoes and beetroot into wedges, toss with the oil and salt and cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Salt the mackerel, add it skin side up and cook for another 7 minutes.
Stir the yogurt with the horseradish, chopped dill and salt.
Serve the mackerel with the vegetables and the horseradish yogurt.

title: Air fryer chicken zucchini patties with yogurt dip
instructions: Grate the zucchini, salt it, leave for 5 minutes and squeeze it out well.
Knead with the chicken mince, egg, oats, cumin and salt and shape into 6 flat patties.
Cook the patties in the air fryer at 190 °C for 12 minutes, turning halfway.
Stir the yogurt with grated garlic, mint and salt and serve with the patties, cucumber slices and pita.

title: Air fryer pistachio-crusted chicken with pomegranate couscous
instructions: Salt the chicken breast, brush it with mustard and press the chopped pistachios on firmly.
Cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for 16 minutes.
Pour 90 ml of boiling salted water over the couscous, let it soak for 5 minutes and mix with the oil, lemon juice, parsley and pomegranate seeds.
Slice the chicken and serve with the couscous and rocket.

title: Air fryer edamame tofu patties with cucumber salad
instructions: Crumble the tofu and chop it coarsely with the edamame in a blender.
Knead with the chickpea flour, spring onion, tamari and pepper and shape into 6 patties.
Brush with oil and cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for 14 minutes, turning halfway.
Slice the cucumber thinly and mix with the soy yogurt, dill and salt, then serve with the patties.

title: Pointed cabbage tofu stir-fry with edamame and ginger
instructions: Cut the tofu into cubes and fry in a dry non-stick pan for 6 minutes until golden on all sides, then remove.
Cut the pointed cabbage into strips and finely chop the ginger and garlic.
Stir-fry the cabbage, ginger, garlic and edamame in the pan for 4 minutes.
Return the tofu to the pan, deglaze with the tamari and serve sprinkled with chilli flakes.

title: Lupin cauliflower curry with spinach
instructions: Finely dice the onion and ginger and toast them with the curry paste in a pot for 2 minutes.
Divide the cauliflower into small florets, add with the strained tomatoes, coconut milk and 100 ml of water and simmer for 12 minutes.
Add the lupins and simmer for 3 more minutes.
Fold in the spinach, let it wilt and season with salt and lime juice.

title: Edamame spaghetti with zucchini, lemon and mint
instructions: Cook the edamame spaghetti in salted water for 6 minutes according to the package and drain.
Cut the zucchini into thin half-moons and fry with the garlic in the oil for 4 minutes.
Stir the soy skyr with the lemon juice, lemon zest and salt.
Toss the spaghetti with the zucchini and lemon skyr and serve with mint and pepper.

title: Smoked tofu kohlrabi salad with lupins and dill
instructions: Peel the kohlrabi and cut it into fine sticks, slice the cucumber.
Dice the smoked tofu and fry it in a dry non-stick pan for 4 minutes.
Stir the soy skyr with the mustard, vinegar, chopped dill and salt.
Mix the kohlrabi, cucumber, lupins and tofu with the dressing and serve.

title: Soy mince aubergine pan with mint
instructions: Soak the soy mince in 120 ml of hot water for 10 minutes.
Dice the aubergine and fry it in the oil in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes, then add the onion and garlic and fry for 2 more minutes.
Add the soy mince, spices and diced tomatoes and braise for 8 minutes.
Season with salt, add a dollop of soy skyr and serve sprinkled with mint.

title: Lupin tofu vegetable soup with turmeric
instructions: Dice the carrot and celery and slice the leek into rings.
Sweat the vegetables with the turmeric in a pot without fat for 2 minutes, pour in the stock and simmer for 12 minutes.
Dice the tofu, add it with the lupins to the soup and let it steep for 4 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with parsley.

title: Tofu pumpkin pan with sage and edamame
instructions: Deseed the pumpkin and cut it with the skin into small cubes, dice the tofu.
Fry the pumpkin in the oil in a covered non-stick pan for 8 minutes until al dente.
Add the tofu and fry uncovered for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the edamame, garlic and sage leaves, fry for 3 more minutes and season with salt and pepper.

title: Tofu pepper goulash with lupins
instructions: Cut the tofu into cubes and fry in a dry non-stick pan for 6 minutes on all sides, then remove.
Dice the onion and garlic and sweat for 3 minutes, toasting the tomato paste and paprika along for 1 minute.
Add the pepper strips, deglaze with the stock, add the caraway and marjoram and braise for 12 minutes.
Fold in the tofu and lupins, heat for 3 minutes and season to taste.

title: Tom yum with tofu, edamame and oyster mushrooms
instructions: Bring the stock to the boil with the bruised lemongrass and ginger slices and simmer for 8 minutes.
Tear the oyster mushrooms, cut the tomato into eighths, dice the tofu and add everything with the edamame to the stock.
Simmer for 5 minutes and season with the tamari, lime juice and chilli rings.
Remove the lemongrass and ginger and serve with coriander.

title: Zucchini noodles with tempeh tomato sauce and basil
instructions: Crumble the tempeh finely and finely dice the onion and garlic.
Toast the tempeh in a dry non-stick pan for 5 minutes, frying the onion and garlic along for 2 minutes.
Add the strained tomatoes and oregano, simmer for 8 minutes and salt.
Spiralize the zucchini into noodles, toss in the sauce for 1 minute and serve with the nutritional yeast and basil.

title: Skyr bowl with blackberries, figs and pistachios
instructions: Stir the skyr until smooth and put it into a shallow bowl.
Wash the figs and cut them into wedges, rinse the blackberries.
Spread the fruit over the skyr and sprinkle with the chopped pistachios and a pinch of cinnamon.

title: Savoury cottage cheese with kohlrabi, radishes and wholemeal bread
instructions: Peel the kohlrabi and cut it into thin sticks, slice the radishes thinly.
Stir the cottage cheese with salt, pepper and finely chopped chives and put it on a plate.
Arrange the kohlrabi and radishes alongside and serve with the slice of wholemeal bread.

title: Scrambled eggs with mushrooms, baby spinach and rye wholemeal bread
instructions: Slice the mushrooms and fry them in the oil in a non-stick pan for 3 minutes.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites with salt and pepper, add the baby spinach to the mushrooms and let it wilt briefly.
Pour in the egg mixture and let it set until creamy over medium heat for 2 minutes, stirring.
Arrange the scrambled eggs on a plate with the rye wholemeal bread.

title: Crispbread with herby skyr cream, tomato and egg
instructions: Stir the skyr with chopped parsley, chives, salt and pepper into a herb cream.
Slice the tomato and cucumber, peel the egg and cut it into slices.
Spread the crispbreads thickly with the herb cream and top with the tomato, cucumber and egg.

title: Soy skyr with papaya, lime and hemp seeds
instructions: Peel and deseed the papaya, cut it into cubes and drizzle with the lime juice.
Stir the soy skyr until smooth and put it into a shallow bowl.
Spread the papaya on top and sprinkle with the hemp seeds and lime zest.

title: Egg white omelette with chard, tomato and cottage cheese
instructions: Cut the chard into strips and sauté it in the oil in a non-stick pan for 2 minutes, dice the tomato.
Whisk the egg whites and egg with salt, pepper and nutmeg and pour over the chard.
Cover and let it set over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Put the cottage cheese and diced tomato on one half, fold the omelette and serve.

title: Greek yoghurt with orange, pomegranate and almonds
instructions: Peel the orange, remove the white pith and cut the fruit into slices or segments.
Put the yoghurt into a shallow bowl and spread the orange pieces on top.
Sprinkle with the pomegranate seeds, chopped almonds and a pinch of cinnamon.

title: Smoked trout bread with beetroot and horseradish skyr
instructions: Stir the skyr with the horseradish, salt and pepper.
Cut the beetroot into thin slices and flake the trout fillet into pieces.
Spread the bread with half of the horseradish skyr, top with the beetroot, trout and dill and serve with the lamb's lettuce and the remaining skyr.

title: Chocolate protein porridge with cherries
instructions: Bring the oats to the boil with the milk and cocoa in a small pot and simmer for 4 minutes until creamy, stirring.
Warm the cherries in a small pan for 3 minutes until they release their juice.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the protein powder until smooth.
Spoon the porridge into a bowl and serve with the warm cherries.

title: Turkey breast wholemeal bread with tomato, rocket and cottage cheese
instructions: Spread the bread with the cottage cheese.
Slice the tomato and season with salt and pepper.
Top the bread with the rocket, turkey breast and tomato slices and serve.

title: Bean breakfast plate with fried egg, tomato coriander salsa and cucumber
instructions: Finely dice the tomato and onion and mix with chopped coriander, lime juice and salt into a salsa.
Warm the beans in a small pot with 2 tbsp of water for 3 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Fry the eggs in the oil in a non-stick pan for 3 minutes.
Arrange the beans, fried eggs, salsa and cucumber slices on a plate.

title: Turmeric tofu scramble with courgette, cherry tomatoes and nutritional yeast
instructions: Cut the courgette into small cubes and fry in the oil in a pan for 3 minutes.
Crumble the tofu into the pan with your hands, season with turmeric, paprika, salt and pepper and fry for 3 minutes.
Fold in the halved cherry tomatoes and nutritional yeast, warm for 1 minute and serve.

title: Apricot skyr nice cream with flaked almonds
instructions: Stone the apricots, cut them into pieces and freeze for at least 4 hours.
Let the frozen apricots soften for 5 minutes and blend with the skyr and vanilla in a food processor for 1 to 2 minutes until creamy.
Toast the flaked almonds in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden.
Spoon the nice cream into a bowl and serve straight away sprinkled with the flaked almonds.

title: Cocoa silken tofu mousse with orange and cacao nibs
instructions: Roughly chop the chocolate and melt it over a warm water bath.
Blend the silken tofu with the melted chocolate, cocoa, maple syrup and orange zest in a blender for 1 minute until smooth.
Spoon the mousse into a dessert glass and chill for at least 1 hour.
Segment the orange, place the segments on the mousse and sprinkle with the cacao nibs.

title: Coconut matcha protein shake with banana
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Taste and thin with a little cold soy drink if needed.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Kiwi cucumber smoothie with mint and soy skyr
instructions: Peel and quarter the kiwis and cut the cucumber into rough pieces.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Cherry chocolate protein ice lollies
instructions: Let the cherries thaw for 10 minutes and chop them roughly.
Stir the skyr with the cocoa and maple syrup until smooth and fold in the cherries and finely chopped chocolate.
Pour the mixture into 2 ice lolly moulds, insert the sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours.
Briefly hold the moulds under warm water and release the lollies.

title: Cottage cheese ice cream with strawberries and vanilla
instructions: Blend the cottage cheese with the maple syrup, vanilla and 100 g of the strawberries in a blender for 1 minute until completely smooth.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Let the remaining strawberries thaw, cut them into pieces and spread them over the ice cream.

title: Pear cardamom kefir shake
instructions: Quarter and core the pear and cut it into rough pieces.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Cranberry orange smoothie with skyr
instructions: Peel the orange and divide it into pieces, slice the banana.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Raspberry coconut chia pudding with pistachios
instructions: Stir the chia seeds with the coconut milk, soy skyr and maple syrup, leave to swell for 10 minutes and stir again.
Cover and leave to set in the fridge for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Crush half of the raspberries with a fork and swirl them through the pudding.
Spoon into a glass and garnish with the remaining raspberries and chopped pistachios.

title: Redcurrant quark cream with toasted oats
instructions: Toast the oats in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden and let them cool.
Stir the quark with the maple syrup, vanilla and 2 tbsp of water until creamy.
Strip the redcurrants from their stalks and fold half into the cream.
Spoon the cream into a dessert glass and sprinkle with the remaining redcurrants and the oats.

title: Oven-baked salmon with almond broccoli and lemon butter
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Season the salmon with salt and pepper and bake in a small baking dish for 14 minutes.
Divide the broccoli into florets, cook in salted water for 4 minutes until tender-crisp and drain.
Foam the butter with the chopped garlic in a pan, toast the flaked almonds in it for 2 minutes until golden and briefly toss the broccoli in it.
Arrange the salmon with the almond broccoli and drizzle with lemon juice and the butter from the pan.

title: Aubergine and beef mince bake with mozzarella
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the aubergine into 1 cm thick slices, brush with 10 g of the oil, season with salt and bake on a tray for 15 minutes.
Fry the beef mince in the remaining oil until crumbly, add the garlic and strained tomatoes and simmer with oregano, salt and pepper for 5 minutes.
Layer the aubergine and mince sauce alternately in a small baking dish and top with mozzarella slices.
Bake in the oven for 15 minutes until the cheese is golden and serve with basil.

title: Halloumi with chard, olives and pine nuts
instructions: Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden and remove.
Cut the halloumi into 4 slices and fry in the pan without fat for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Cut the chard into strips and sauté with the garlic in the oil for 3 minutes, add the olives and season with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Put the chard on a plate, place the halloumi on top and sprinkle with the pine nuts.

title: Pan-fried mackerel with buttered savoy cabbage and mustard
instructions: Cut the savoy cabbage into fine strips and steam in a pot with 10 g of the butter and 3 tbsp of water, covered, for 8 minutes.
Stir in the cream and mustard, season with nutmeg, salt and pepper and reduce uncovered for 2 minutes.
Season the mackerel fillets with salt and fry skin side down in the remaining butter with thyme for 3 minutes until crisp, then turn and cook for 1 more minute.
Arrange the mustard savoy cabbage on a plate and place the mackerel on top.

title: Tofu in peanut coconut sauce with leaf spinach and coriander
instructions: Cut the tofu into cubes and fry in the oil in a pan for 6 minutes until golden on all sides.
Stir the peanut butter with the coconut milk, tamari, grated ginger and 3 tbsp of water until smooth.
Pour the sauce over the tofu, simmer for 2 minutes and let the spinach wilt in it.
Serve sprinkled with coriander and chilli flakes.

title: Oven-baked goat cheese mushrooms with thyme
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Twist the stalks out of the mushrooms and chop them finely.
Mix the chopped stalks with the crumbled goat cheese, chopped walnuts, garlic and thyme and fill the mushroom caps.
Place the mushrooms on a tray, drizzle with the oil and bake for 15 minutes until the cheese is golden.

title: Avocado egg boats with smoked trout
instructions: Halve and stone the avocado and drizzle with the lemon juice.
Peel and finely chop the egg, flake the trout and mix both with the crème fraîche, chives, salt and pepper.
Fill the avocado halves with the mixture and serve straight away.

title: Creamy cauliflower and leek soup with mountain cheese
instructions: Slice the leek into rings and sweat in the butter for 3 minutes.
Divide the cauliflower into florets, add with the stock and simmer covered for 15 minutes until soft.
Add the cream and 30 g of the mountain cheese, blend until smooth and season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan for 2 minutes and sprinkle them over the soup with the remaining cheese.

title: Rump steak with parsley garlic butter and green asparagus
instructions: Mix the soft butter with finely chopped parsley, crushed garlic and a pinch of salt and chill.
Pat the rump steak dry and fry it in a hot pan in 5 g of the oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side, then let it rest for 5 minutes.
Trim the woody ends off the asparagus and fry it in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Slice the steak, arrange it with the asparagus and let the herb butter melt on top.

title: Cauliflower cheese patties with chive sour cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Finely grate the cauliflower and squeeze it out well in a cloth.
Mix the cauliflower with the egg, cheddar, almond flour, paprika, salt and pepper and shape 6 flat patties on baking paper brushed with the oil.
Bake in the oven for 20 minutes until golden, turning once after 12 minutes.
Stir the sour cream with finely chopped chives and salt and serve with the patties.

title: Chicken buckwheat box with red cabbage, carrot and sesame dressing
instructions: Cook the buckwheat in twice its volume of salted water for 12 minutes, drain and let cool.
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper and fry in a dry non-stick pan for 6 minutes per side until cooked through, let cool and cut into strips.
Finely shred the red cabbage and coarsely grate the carrot. Stir the tamari, sesame oil, rice vinegar and grated ginger into a dressing.
Pack the buckwheat, vegetables and chicken side by side into a container, sprinkle with sesame and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Take the dressing separately in a small screw-top jar.

title: Lentil kale salad with apple, feta and mustard dressing
instructions: Cook the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until al dente, drain and let cool.
Strip the kale from the stalks, chop it finely and massage with a pinch of salt for 1 minute until soft.
Dice the apple, finely chop the onion and mix with the lentils and kale. Stir the oil, mustard and vinegar into a dressing.
Pack the salad into a container, crumble the feta over it and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.
Eat cold straight from the container, mixing in the dressing just before eating.

title: Lemon oregano turkey with bulgur, courgette and feta dip
instructions: Cut the turkey breast into cubes and mix with 5 g of the oil, half the lemon juice, oregano, salt and pepper.
Pour twice its volume of boiling salted water over the bulgur and leave covered to swell for 15 minutes.
Fry the turkey in the remaining oil for 6 minutes until cooked through, add the diced courgette and fry for 3 more minutes.
Mash the feta with the yoghurt, crushed garlic and remaining lemon juice and pack it separately as a dip.
Pack the bulgur, turkey and courgette into a container, let cool and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
At the office eat cold or reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot.

title: Gochujang tofu box with brown rice, cucumber and edamame
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the package for about 25 minutes and let it cool.
Cut the tofu into cubes and fry in the oil for 6 minutes until golden, stir the gochujang with 2 tbsp of water and glaze the tofu in it for 1 minute.
Cook the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes and cut the cucumber and carrot into thin sticks.
Pack the rice, tofu, edamame and vegetables into a container, sprinkle with sesame and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
At the office eat cold or reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot.

title: Wholewheat couscous salad with chickpeas, cucumber and mint
instructions: Pour 90 ml of boiling salted water over the couscous, leave covered to swell for 5 minutes and fluff up with a fork.
Dice the cucumber and tomato and finely chop the parsley and mint.
Mix the couscous with the chickpeas, vegetables, herbs, oil, lemon juice, cumin, salt and pepper.
Pack into a container, keep in the fridge for up to 4 days and eat cold.

title: Salmon potato box with green beans and mustard dill sauce
instructions: Cook the potatoes in their skins in salted water for 18 minutes, adding the beans for the last 6 minutes, then drain and let cool.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C, season the salmon with salt and pepper and bake for 12 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt with the mustard, chopped dill and a pinch of salt and pack it separately.
Pack the halved potatoes, beans and salmon into a container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Eat cold or reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes, adding the sauce only afterwards.

title: Beef and broccoli box with jasmine rice and ginger
instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to the package for about 12 minutes.
Cut the beef into thin strips and mix with the cornflour and 5 g of the tamari, divide the broccoli into small florets.
Sear the beef in the hot oil for 2 minutes and remove. Cook the broccoli with the ginger, garlic and 4 tbsp of water for 4 minutes, then add the beef and remaining tamari.
Pack the rice and beef and broccoli into a container, sprinkle with spring onions, let cool and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
To eat, reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until piping hot, stirring once.

title: Lentil pasta salad with tuna, capers and tomato
instructions: Cook the lentil pasta in salted water according to the package for about 7 minutes, drain, rinse under cold water and leave to drain.
Halve the cherry tomatoes, finely dice the onion and flake the tuna.
Mix the pasta with the tomatoes, onion, tuna, capers, oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper and pack into a container.
Put the rocket on top, keep in the fridge for up to 3 days and eat cold.

title: Sai bhaji – Sindhi spinach lentil vegetables with brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the package for about 25 minutes.
Finely chop the onion, ginger and garlic and fry them in the oil with the cumin for 3 minutes.
Add the lentils, diced potato, tomato, turmeric, chilli and 300 ml of water and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Roughly chop the spinach, stir it in and cook for 5 more minutes, then mash lightly and season with salt.
Serve the sai bhaji with the brown rice.

title: Masoor dal with aubergine, tomato and wholemeal chapati
instructions: Cut the aubergine into cubes and fry them in the oil in a pot for 5 minutes.
Finely chop the onion and garlic, add them and fry with the cumin and turmeric for 2 minutes.
Add the lentils, diced tomatoes and 350 ml of water and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Season with garam masala and salt and serve with the chapati warmed in a dry pan.

title: Diri ak pwa nwa – Haitian rice with black beans and thyme
instructions: Finely dice the onion, pepper and garlic and fry in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the rice, thyme and allspice, top up with the coconut milk and 200 ml of water and cook covered for 25 minutes.
Fold in the beans and cook for 5 more minutes until the rice has absorbed the liquid.
Season with lime juice, salt and pepper and serve.

title: Usal – Maharashtra mung bean curry with coconut and millet
instructions: Boil the mung beans in plenty of water for 25 minutes until soft and drain, keeping 150 ml of the cooking water.
Bring the millet to the boil with 100 ml of salted water and leave covered to swell for 15 minutes.
Toast the mustard seeds and curry leaves in the oil until the seeds pop, add the onion, garlic and tomato and braise for 5 minutes.
Add the mung beans, desiccated coconut, turmeric and cooking water, simmer for 5 minutes, season with salt and serve with the millet.

title: Avial – Keralan coconut yoghurt vegetables with black-eyed beans
instructions: Cut the carrot, beans and pumpkin into sticks of equal length and cook covered with the turmeric and 150 ml of salted water for 10 minutes until tender-crisp.
Grind the desiccated coconut with the cumin, chilli and 3 tbsp of water into a coarse paste in a mortar or blender.
Add the black-eyed beans and coconut paste to the vegetables and heat for 3 minutes, take off the heat and stir in the yoghurt.
Fry the curry leaves in the coconut oil for 30 seconds until crisp and pour over the avial.

title: Vegetarian plov with carrots, chickpeas and brown rice
instructions: Cut the carrots into long thin sticks and slice the onion into half rings.
Fry the onion in the oil in a heavy pot for 5 minutes until golden, add the carrots and cumin and fry for 5 more minutes.
Add the chickpeas, raisins, coriander seeds and salt, scatter the rice over the top and pour in 200 ml of water without stirring.
Push the unpeeled garlic cloves into the rice and cook covered over low heat for 35 minutes, then mix loosely before serving.

title: Vegetarian lagman – Uyghur wholewheat noodles with peppers, beans and tomato
instructions: Cook the wholewheat spaghetti in salted water according to the package for about 9 minutes and drain.
Cut the onion, pepper and garlic into strips and fry them briskly in the oil for 5 minutes.
Toast the tomato paste, cumin and chilli flakes for 1 minute, add the diced tomato, beans and stock and reduce for 8 minutes.
Put the noodles into a deep bowl and spoon the vegetable sauce over them.

title: Vegetarian fasolka po bretońsku – Polish beans in tomato sauce with smoked tofu
instructions: Cut the smoked tofu into small cubes and fry in the oil for 4 minutes until crisp.
Add the diced onion and fry for 3 more minutes, then toast the tomato paste and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the strained tomatoes, beans, bay leaf and marjoram, simmer for 15 minutes until thick and season with salt and pepper.
Spoon into a deep bowl and serve with the rye wholemeal bread.

title: Kenchinjiru – Japanese root vegetable tofu soup with edamame
instructions: Cut the daikon and carrot into thin half-moons, slice the shiitake and cut the leek into rings.
Fry the vegetables and mushrooms in the sesame oil in a pot for 4 minutes, crumble in the tofu with your hands and fry for 2 more minutes.
Pour in the stock and simmer covered for 15 minutes until the daikon is soft.
Add the edamame and wakame, leave to steep for 3 minutes and season with tamari.

title: Vegetarian solyanka with kidney beans, gherkins and peppers
instructions: Dice the smoked tofu and fry in the oil in a pot for 4 minutes, cut the onion and pepper into strips, add them and fry for 4 more minutes.
Toast the tomato paste and paprika for 1 minute, deglaze with the strained tomatoes and stock and add the bay leaf.
Cut the gherkins into strips, add them with the beans and simmer for 15 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Ladle into a soup bowl and serve with a dollop of sour cream and dill.

title: Millet quark bake with sour cherries and almonds
instructions: Rinse the millet with hot water and let it swell in 200 ml water for 15 minutes, then let it cool slightly.
Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Stir the low-fat quark, egg, maple syrup, vanilla and cinnamon until smooth and fold in the millet.
Pour the mixture into a small baking dish, spread the sour cherries on top and press them in lightly.
Sprinkle with the flaked almonds and bake for 30 minutes until golden, let cool briefly and serve.

title: Scrambled egg plate with smoked salmon, cottage cheese, avocado and rye bread
instructions: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper and cook in the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 3 minutes into creamy scrambled eggs.
Slice the avocado and thinly slice the cucumber, toast the bread.
Arrange the scrambled eggs, smoked salmon, cottage cheese, avocado, cucumber and bread on a plate and sprinkle with dill.

title: Tofu scramble breakfast plate with edamame, roasted tomatoes and wholemeal toast
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Roast the cherry tomatoes with half the oil and a little salt on a tray for 15 minutes.
Cook the edamame in boiling water for 4 minutes and drain.
Crumble the tofu into the remaining hot oil, season with turmeric, paprika, nutritional yeast, salt and pepper and fry for 5 minutes.
Toast the bread and arrange it on a plate with the tofu scramble, edamame and roasted tomatoes.

title: Breakfast tacos with scrambled eggs, turkey breast and pico de gallo
instructions: Finely dice the tomato and onion and mix with lime juice, chopped coriander and salt to make pico de gallo.
Cut the turkey breast into small strips and fry in the oil for 5 minutes until cooked through, season with salt and pepper.
Whisk the eggs, add them to the turkey in the pan and let them set for 2 minutes while stirring.
Briefly warm the tortillas in a dry pan and fill with the scrambled eggs, pico de gallo and avocado slices.

title: Chicken kebab skewers with bulgur pilaf, ezme and garlic yoghurt
instructions: Cut the chicken into cubes, mix with half the oil, tomato purée, pul biber, salt and pepper and thread onto skewers.
Bring the bulgur to the boil with 160 ml hot water and a little salt and leave covered to swell for 15 minutes.
For the ezme, chop the tomato, pepper, onion and parsley very finely and mix with the remaining oil, sumac and salt.
Cook the skewers in a grill pan for 10 minutes, turning, until cooked through. Stir the yoghurt with the crushed garlic and serve everything together.

title: Gochujang beef strips with sushi rice, spinach and cucumber
instructions: Wash the rice and cook it with 120 ml water for 12 minutes, then leave covered to rest for 10 minutes.
Cut the beef into thin strips and mix with the gochujang, tamari, sesame oil and chopped garlic.
Wilt the spinach in 1 tsp oil for 1 minute and slice the cucumber thinly.
Fry the beef in the remaining oil over high heat for 3 minutes and serve with the rice, spinach and cucumber, sprinkled with sesame and spring onion.

title: Oven-baked sea bream with giant beans, tomatoes and feta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Slice the onion and put it into a baking dish with the giant beans, halved cherry tomatoes, garlic, oregano and 10 g of the oil.
Bake the beans in the oven for 15 minutes.
Season the sea bream fillets with salt and pepper, brush with the remaining oil and lay them skin side up on the beans, crumble the feta over the top.
Bake for another 12 minutes and serve with dill and lemon juice.

title: Chicken chop suey with mung bean sprouts, peppers and basmati rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Cut the chicken into thin strips and mix with 1 tsp tamari and the cornflour.
Fry the chicken in the hot oil in a wok for 4 minutes, add the pepper, carrot, ginger and garlic and fry for another 3 minutes.
Add the pak choi and sprouts, toss with the remaining tamari and 50 ml water for 2 minutes and serve with the rice.

title: Lamb fillet with freekeh, roasted aubergine and mint yoghurt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Dice the aubergine, mix with 10 g of the oil, cumin and salt and roast for 25 minutes.
Cook the freekeh in three times its volume of salted water for 20 minutes and drain.
Season the lamb fillet with salt and pepper, fry in the remaining oil for 6 to 8 minutes on all sides, rest for 5 minutes and slice.
Stir the yoghurt with the garlic and chopped mint. Arrange the freekeh, aubergine and lamb and serve with the yoghurt and pomegranate seeds.

title: Soy chunk rogan josh with kidney beans and basmati rice
ingredients: Kashmiri chilli, garam masala, cardamom, fennel seeds
instructions: Soak the soy chunks in hot water for 10 minutes and squeeze them out well. Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Finely chop the onion, ginger and garlic and fry in the oil for 4 minutes, then toast the spices for 1 minute.
Add the soy chunks and fry for 3 minutes, add the strained tomatoes and kidney beans and simmer for 12 minutes.
Remove from the heat, stir in the soy yoghurt, season and serve with the rice.

title: Paneer chickpea masala with wholemeal chapati and cucumber raita
instructions: Dice the paneer and fry in the oil for 3 minutes until golden, then remove.
Finely chop the onion, garlic and ginger, sweat them in the pan for 4 minutes and toast the spices for 1 minute.
Add the strained tomatoes, chickpeas and 50 g of the yoghurt, simmer for 10 minutes and fold in the paneer.
Grate the cucumber, stir it with the remaining yoghurt and salt to make raita and serve everything with the warmed chapati.

title: Beef mince enchilada skillet with black beans and rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Fry the beef mince in the oil until crumbly, add the diced onion, pepper and garlic and fry for another 4 minutes.
Mix in the spices, strained tomatoes, beans, corn and rice and simmer for 8 minutes.
Sprinkle the cheddar over the top, let it melt covered for 2 minutes and serve.

title: Air fryer chickpea and peanut mix with chilli and lime
instructions: Drain the chickpeas well and pat them dry with kitchen paper.
Mix with the oil, paprika and salt and roast in the air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes, shaking twice.
Add the peanuts and roast for another 3 minutes.
Toss with the chilli flakes, lime zest and lime juice and let cool briefly so everything turns crunchy.

title: Air fryer turkey meatballs with tomato yoghurt dip
instructions: Finely grate the onion and knead with the turkey mince, oats, half the garlic, paprika, oregano, salt and pepper.
Shape 8 small balls with wet hands.
Cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for 10 to 12 minutes until browned and cooked through, turning halfway.
Stir the yoghurt with the tomato purée, remaining garlic and salt and serve with the meatballs and parsley.

title: Crispy edamame falafel with lemon soy yoghurt
instructions: Thaw the edamame and pulse coarsely in a mini chopper with the chickpea flour, garlic, herbs, cumin and salt.
Shape the mixture into 8 small falafel and brush thinly with the oil.
Bake in the air fryer at 190 °C for 12 minutes until crisp, turning halfway.
Stir the soy yoghurt with lemon juice, salt and chopped herbs and serve with the falafel.

title: Chocolate hazelnut protein shake with quark and oat drink
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Taste and thin with a little cold oat drink if needed.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Blood orange and carrot smoothie with soy skyr
instructions: Peel the blood oranges and break them into rough pieces, peel the carrot and cut it into chunks.
Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend for about 45 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a large glass and drink straight away.

title: Plum and cinnamon protein ice cream with cottage cheese
instructions: Stone the plums and blend 100 g of them with the cottage cheese, maple syrup, cinnamon and vanilla until very smooth.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Spoon into a bowl and serve with the remaining plums cut into wedges and the chopped walnuts.

title: Cherry silken tofu ice cream with dark chocolate shavings
instructions: Blend the silken tofu, cherries, soy protein, maple syrup and vanilla in a blender until very smooth.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe tub and freeze for at least 12 hours.
Let the block soften for 10 minutes, break it into pieces and blend in a food processor until creamy.
Spoon into a bowl and serve sprinkled with finely grated dark chocolate.

title: Mandarin quark tartlet in a glass with an oat base
instructions: Toast the oats in a dry pan for 3 minutes and knead them with the almond butter and cinnamon into crumbs.
Press the crumbs into a glass as the base.
Stir the low-fat quark with the maple syrup and vanilla until smooth and layer it over the base.
Peel the mandarins, divide them into segments, arrange them on top and chill for 15 minutes.

title: Vegan chai chia cream with pear
instructions: Stir the chia seeds with the soy drink, maple syrup and chai spices and leave to swell in the fridge for at least 4 hours.
Blend the chia mixture with the soy skyr in a blender into a smooth cream.
Cut the pear into small cubes, spoon the cream into a glass and serve with the pear and a pinch of cinnamon.

title: Light air fryer quark cinnamon rolls
instructions: Knead the spelt flour, baking powder, 40 g of the low-fat quark, 5 g of the oil and a pinch of salt into a smooth dough.
Roll the dough out thinly, brush with the remaining oil, spread with cinnamon and maple syrup, roll up and cut into 4 rolls.
Bake in the air fryer at 170 °C for 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown.
Stir the skyr with the remaining low-fat quark until smooth and spoon it over the warm rolls as a topping.

title: Paprika chicken with roasted pumpkin and herb quark
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Deseed the pumpkin, cut it into wedges, mix with half the oil and salt and roast for 25 minutes.
Rub the chicken with the remaining oil, paprika, salt and pepper and fry in a pan for 6 minutes per side until cooked through.
Stir the low-fat quark with the chopped herbs, salt and 1 tbsp water until smooth.
Slice the chicken and serve with the pumpkin and herb quark.

title: Cod tagine with peppers, tomato and coriander
instructions: Slice the onion and peppers and fry in the oil in a shallow pan for 5 minutes, then toast the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the strained tomatoes and olives and simmer for 8 minutes.
Divide the cod into large pieces, season with salt, place in the sauce and poach covered for 8 minutes.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve sprinkled with fresh coriander.

title: Turkey stir-fry with Chinese cabbage, shiitake and ginger
instructions: Cut the turkey breast into thin strips, the Chinese cabbage into wide strips, the shiitake into slices and the carrot into fine sticks.
Sear the turkey in the hot rapeseed oil in a wok for 4 minutes and remove.
Stir-fry the ginger, garlic, shiitake and carrot for 3 minutes, add the Chinese cabbage and cook for another 2 minutes.
Return the turkey to the wok, season with tamari, rice vinegar and sesame oil and serve with spring onion greens and chilli flakes.

title: Prawn and courgette pan with garlic, chilli and cherry tomatoes
instructions: Halve the courgette lengthways and cut it into half-moons, halve the cherry tomatoes and slice the garlic and spring onions.
Fry the courgette in the oil in a large pan for 4 minutes, then fry the garlic and chilli for 1 minute.
Add the prawns, tomatoes and spring onions and fry for 3 to 4 minutes until the prawns are pink and cooked through, then fold in the baby spinach.
Season with salt, lemon juice and parsley and serve straight away.

title: Edamame tofu salad with radish and miso dressing
instructions: Cook the edamame in boiling water for 4 minutes, refresh in cold water and drain.
Pat the tofu dry, dice it and fry in a dry non-stick pan for 6 minutes until golden on all sides.
Cut the radish and cucumber into fine sticks. Stir the miso, rice vinegar, grated ginger and 1 tbsp water together.
Toss the vegetables, edamame and tofu with the dressing and sprinkle with spring onion rings.

title: Courgette cottage cheese bake with eggs and tomatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Coarsely grate the courgette, salt it, leave for 5 minutes and squeeze it out firmly.
Whisk the egg and egg whites with the cottage cheese, oregano and pepper and fold in the courgette.
Pour the mixture into a small baking dish, top with tomato slices and sprinkle with the hard cheese.
Bake for 30 minutes until golden, rest for 5 minutes and serve with basil.

title: Chipotle chicken with pinto beans, peppers and coriander
instructions: Cut the chicken into strips and mix with the chipotle powder, cumin, salt and pepper.
Fry in the oil in a pan for 5 minutes until cooked through and remove.
Fry the peppers and onion in strips for 4 minutes, add the pinto beans, strained tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 5 minutes.
Fold in the chicken, season with lime juice and serve with coriander.

title: Tandoori pollock with cucumber raita and cauliflower rice
instructions: Coat the pollock with 50 g of the yoghurt, tandoori spice and salt and leave for 10 minutes. Preheat the oven to 220 °C.
Bake the fish on a tray for 12 minutes.
Finely grate the cauliflower and fry it in the oil with turmeric and salt for 5 minutes.
Grate the cucumber, stir with the remaining yoghurt, mint and salt and serve everything with lemon and coriander.

title: Red lentil and parsnip soup with cumin yoghurt
instructions: Peel and dice the parsnip, carrot and onion and finely grate the ginger.
Sweat the vegetables in the oil in a pot for 4 minutes, then toast the ginger and half the cumin for 1 minute.
Rinse the lentils, add them with the stock and simmer for 20 minutes, then blend until smooth and season.
Stir the yoghurt with the remaining cumin and a pinch of salt and add it to the soup as a dollop.

title: Beef and pearl barley stew with leek and carrots
instructions: Cut the beef into small cubes and brown it in the oil in a pot for 5 minutes on all sides.
Deglaze with the stock, add the bay leaf and marjoram and braise covered for 50 minutes.
Dice the carrot and celeriac, slice the leek into rings and add them with the rinsed pearl barley.
Simmer for another 25 minutes until the beef and barley are tender, season and serve with parsley.

title: Hokkaido pumpkin and chestnut stew with lentils and kale
instructions: Deseed the pumpkin and dice it with the skin on, chop the onion and garlic and halve the chestnuts.
Sweat the onion and garlic in the oil for 3 minutes, then toast the tomato purée and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, pumpkin, thyme and stock and simmer for 25 minutes.
Strip the kale from the stalks, tear it roughly, add it with the chestnuts, cook for 5 minutes and season.

title: Savoy cabbage and chickpea soup with ras el hanout
instructions: Dice the onion, garlic and carrot and sweat in the oil in a pot for 4 minutes, then toast the spices for 1 minute.
Cut the savoy cabbage into fine strips and add it with the chickpeas, strained tomatoes and stock.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the cabbage is tender.
Season with salt and lemon juice and serve with parsley.

title: Brussels sprout quinoa salad with pomegranate and feta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Halve the Brussels sprouts, mix with 5 g of the oil and salt and roast for 20 minutes until golden.
Rinse the quinoa and cook it in twice its volume of salted water for 15 minutes, then drain.
Stir the remaining oil with the lemon juice, salt and pepper and mix with the quinoa, Brussels sprouts and chopped herbs.
